            times = ["Morning", "Afternoon", "Evening"]

            for i in range(activities_per_day):
                time_slot = times[i % 3]
                attr_idx = ((day - 2) * 3 + i) % attr_count
                attr_name = attractions[attr_idx]

                slot_templates = matched_pool.get(time_slot, default_templates[time_slot])
                template_str = slot_templates[(day + i) % len(slot_templates)]
                title = template_str.format(attraction=attr_name)

                retry_count = 0
                while title in used_titles and retry_count < 5:
                    retry_count += 1
                    alt_attr = attractions[(attr_idx + retry_count) % attr_count]
                    alt_template = slot_templates[(day + i + retry_count) % len(slot_templates)]
                    title = alt_template.format(attraction=alt_attr)

                used_titles.add(title)

                if time_slot == "Morning":
                    act_cost = round(dest.avg_activity_cost * (0.6 if comfort_score < 50 else 1.0), 2)
                elif time_slot == "Afternoon":
                    act_cost = round(dest.avg_activity_cost * (0.8 if comfort_score < 50 else 1.2), 2)
                else:
                    act_cost = round(dest.avg_activity_cost * 0.5, 2)

                day_activities.append({
                    "time": time_slot,
                    "title": title,
                    "cost": act_cost
                })

            day_themes = [
                f"Discovering the famous landmarks and hidden gems of {dest.name}.",
                f"Immersing in the local culture, cuisine, and scenery of {dest.name}.",
                f"A full day of exploration, photography, and regional flavors around {dest.name}.",
                f"Uncovering historical heritage and scenic landscapes in {dest.name}."
            ]
            description = day_themes[(day - 2) % len(day_themes)]

        itineraries.append({
            "day_number": day,
            "activities": day_activities,
            "description": description
        })

    return itineraries

@router.post("/plan")
def generate_trip_plan(req: schemas.TripPlanRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    # Fetch either the selected destination or the full catalog to rank dynamically
    query = db.query(models.Destination)
    if req.destination_id is not None:
        query = query.filter(models.Destination.id == req.destination_id)

    destinations = query.all()
    if not destinations:
        if req.destination_id is not None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Selected destination not found in database.")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="No destinations found in database. Seed database first.")

    matched_plans = []
    for dest in destinations:
        costs = calculate_costs(dest, req.days, req.travelers_count, req.comfort_score, req.starting_city)
        score = calculate_weighted_score(dest, costs, req.budget, req.days, req.travel_type, req.comfort_score)
        under_budget = costs["total_estimated_cost"] <= req.budget

        matched_plans.append({
            "destination": dest,
            "costs": costs,
            "value_score": score,
            "savings": round(req.budget - costs["total_estimated_cost"], 2),
            "under_budget": under_budget
        })

    # --- Strict budget enforcement ---
    if req.destination_id is not None:
        # A specific destination was requested - check if it fits the budget
        selected_plan = matched_plans[0]
        if not selected_plan["under_budget"]:
            est = round(selected_plan["costs"]["total_estimated_cost"], 2)
            dest_obj = selected_plan["destination"]
            
            # Try to find viable alternatives (different day counts)
            alternatives = []
            for alt_days in [req.days - 1, req.days - 2, req.days + 1, req.days + 2]:
                if alt_days > 0 and alt_days <= 30:
                    alt_costs = calculate_costs(dest_obj, alt_days, req.travelers_count, req.comfort_score, req.starting_city)
                    if alt_costs["total_estimated_cost"] <= req.budget:
                        alternatives.append({
                            "days": alt_days,
                            "cost": round(alt_costs["total_estimated_cost"], 2),
                            "savings": round(req.budget - alt_costs["total_estimated_cost"], 2)
                        })
            
            # Sort by days (prefer closest to original request)
            alternatives.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x["days"] - req.days))
            
            alt_msg = ""
            if alternatives:
                best_alt = alternatives[0]
                alt_msg = f" However, {best_alt['days']} days would work (estimated â‚¹{best_alt['cost']:,.0f}). Consider {best_alt['days']} days instead."
            
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422,
                detail=(
                    f"'{dest_obj.name}' for {req.days} days exceeds your budget of â‚¹{req.budget:,.0f} "
                    f"(estimated â‚¹{est:,.0f}).{alt_msg} "
                    f"Or try: increasing budget, reducing comfort level, or choosing another destination."
                )
            )
    else:
        # Full catalog mode - only consider under-budget destinations
        under_budget_plans = [p for p in matched_plans if p["under_budget"]]

        if not under_budget_plans:
            # No destination fits - find the closest one for a helpful message
            matched_plans.sort(key=lambda x: x["costs"]["total_estimated_cost"])
            cheapest = matched_plans[0]
            cheapest_cost = round(cheapest["costs"]["total_estimated_cost"], 2)
            
            # Try alternative days for cheapest destination
            alt_days_msg = ""
            for alt_days in [req.days - 1, req.days - 2]:
                if alt_days > 0:
                    alt_costs = calculate_costs(cheapest["destination"], alt_days, req.travelers_count, req.comfort_score, req.starting_city)
                    if alt_costs["total_estimated_cost"] <= req.budget:
                        alt_days_msg = f" Try {alt_days} days (â‚¹{alt_costs['total_estimated_cost']:,.0f}) or "
                        break
            
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422,
                detail=(
                    f"No destination fits your budget of â‚¹{req.budget:,.0f} for {req.days} days. "
                    f"Most affordable: {cheapest['destination'].name} (â‚¹{cheapest_cost:,.0f}). "
                    f"{alt_days_msg}try: increasing budget, reducing trip duration, or lowering comfort level."
                )
            )

        # Sort under-budget destinations by value score (best fit first)
        under_budget_plans.sort(key=lambda x: x["value_score"], reverse=True)
        selected_plan = under_budget_plans[0]

    # --- Generate all plan components ---
    dest = selected_plan["destination"]

    # 1. Daily itinerary
    itineraries = generate_itinerary_days(dest, req.days, req.comfort_score, req.travel_type)

    # 2. Weather intelligence
    dest.weather_intelligence = calculate_weather_intelligence(dest, None)

    # 3. Carbon footprint
    carbon_intel = calculate_carbon_footprint(
        selected_plan["costs"]["transport_mode"],
        selected_plan["costs"]["transport_cost"]
    )

    # 4. Score breakdown (explainability) - MUST be computed before return
    breakdown = calculate_score_breakdown(
        dest,
        selected_plan["costs"],
        req.budget,
        req.days,
        req.travel_type,
        req.comfort_score
    )

    return {
        "destination": dest,
        "costs": selected_plan["costs"],
        "savings": selected_plan["savings"],
        "value_score": selected_plan["value_score"],
        "under_budget": selected_plan["under_budget"],
        "itineraries": itineraries,
        "budget": req.budget,
        "days": req.days,
        "travelers_count": req.travelers_count,
        "comfort_score": req.comfort_score,
        "travel_type": req.travel_type,
        "breakdown": breakdown,
        "carbon_footprint": carbon_intel
    }

@router.post("/", response_model=schemas.TripOut)
def save_trip(
    trip_data: dict, # Accepts raw dict representing output of /plan
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    # Extract destination_id
    dest_id = trip_data["destination"]["id"]
    costs = trip_data["costs"]

    # Create Trip
    db_trip = models.Trip(
        user_id=current_user.id,
        destination_id=dest_id,
        budget=trip_data["budget"],
        days=trip_data["days"],
        travelers_count=trip_data["travelers_count"],
        travel_type=trip_data["travel_type"],
        comfort_score=trip_data["comfort_score"],
        total_estimated_cost=costs["total_estimated_cost"],
        hotel_tier=costs["hotel_tier"],
        transport_mode=costs["transport_mode"],
        status=trip_data.get("status", "Planned"),
        start_date=trip_data.get("start_date"),
        is_public=False,
        share_token=uuid.uuid4().hex
    )
    db.add(db_trip)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_trip)

    # Save Budget Allocation
    db_allocation = models.BudgetAllocation(
        trip_id=db_trip.id,
        transport_cost=costs["transport_cost"],
        hotel_cost=costs["hotel_cost"],
        food_cost=costs["food_cost"],
        activities_cost=costs["activities_cost"],
        local_transport_cost=costs["local_transport_cost"],
        taxes_fees_cost=costs["taxes_fees_cost"],
        emergency_reserve=costs["emergency_reserve"]
    )
    db.add(db_allocation)

    # Save Itinerary days
    for it_day in trip_data["itineraries"]:
        db_itinerary = models.Itinerary(
            trip_id=db_trip.id,
            day_number=it_day["day_number"],
            activities=it_day["activities"],
            description=it_day.get("description", "")
        )
        db.add(db_itinerary)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_trip)

    # Generate default checklist items
    month_val = None
    if db_trip.start_date:
        try:
            month_val = int(db_trip.start_date.split("-")[1])
        except Exception:
            pass

    dest = db.query(models.Destination).filter(models.Destination.id == db_trip.destination_id).first()
    weather_intel = calculate_weather_intelligence(dest, month_val)
    season_name = weather_intel["current_season"]

    default_packing_items = generate_default_packing_list(
        category=dest.category,
        season=season_name,
        duration=db_trip.days,
        comfort=db_trip.comfort_score
    )

    for item_name in default_packing_items:
        db_item = models.PackingItem(
            trip_id=db_trip.id,
            name=item_name,
            checked=False
        )
        db.add(db_item)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_trip)

    # Log Trip creation notification
    notif_msg = f"Your trip to {dest.name} has been planned successfully."
    if db_trip.start_date:
        notif_msg = f"Your trip to {dest.name} starts on {db_trip.start_date}."
    db.add(models.Notification(
        user_id=current_user.id,
        type="Upcoming Trip",
        message=notif_msg
    ))
    db.commit()
    
    # Reload with relationships
    from sqlalchemy.orm import joinedload
    db_trip = db.query(models.Trip).options(
        joinedload(models.Trip.destination),
        joinedload(models.Trip.itineraries),
        joinedload(models.Trip.budget_allocation),
        joinedload(models.Trip.packing_items)
    ).filter(models.Trip.id == db_trip.id).first()
    
    return db_trip

def auto_update_trip_status(trip: models.Trip, db: Session):
    if not trip.status:
        trip.status = "Planned"
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(trip)
        
    if trip.status in ["Planned", "In Progress"] and trip.start_date:
        try:
            start_dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(trip.start_date, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
            today = datetime.date.today()
            end_dt = start_dt + datetime.timedelta(days=trip.days)
            
            new_status = trip.status
            if today >= end_dt:
                new_status = "Completed"
            elif today >= start_dt:
                new_status = "In Progress"
                
            if new_status != trip.status:
                trip.status = new_status
                db.commit()
                db.refresh(trip)
        except Exception:
            pass

def attach_trip_intelligence(t: models.Trip, db: Session):
    auto_update_trip_status(t, db)
    actual_spent = sum([e.amount for e in t.expenses])
    t.actual_spending = round(actual_spent, 2)
    # Savings = money left if you stick to the estimated cost (projected savings)
    # NOT actual remaining budget after spending
    t.savings = round(max(0.0, t.budget - t.total_estimated_cost), 2)
    
    month_val = None
    if t.start_date:
        try:
            month_val = int(t.start_date.split("-")[1])
        except Exception:
            pass
    t.destination.weather_intelligence = calculate_weather_intelligence(t.destination, month_val)
    
    cost_val = t.budget_allocation.transport_cost if t.budget_allocation else (t.total_estimated_cost * 0.25)
    t.carbon_footprint = calculate_carbon_footprint(t.transport_mode, cost_val)

@router.get("/", response_model=List[schemas.TripOut])
def get_user_trips(
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    from sqlalchemy.orm import joinedload
    trips = db.query(models.Trip).options(
        joinedload(models.Trip.destination),
        joinedload(models.Trip.itineraries),
        joinedload(models.Trip.budget_allocation),
        joinedload(models.Trip.packing_items)
    ).filter(models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id).order_by(models.Trip.created_at.desc()).all()
    for t in trips:
        attach_trip_intelligence(t, db)
    return trips

    trip_id: int,

    ).first()

    return trip

@router.put("/{trip_id}", response_model=schemas.TripOut)
def update_trip(
    trip_id: int,
    payload: dict,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
        models.Trip.id == trip_id,
        models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
    
    # Track if parameters that affect cost calculation have changed
    needs_recalculation = False
    old_travelers = trip.travelers_count
    old_days = trip.days
    old_comfort = trip.comfort_score
    
    if "budget" in payload:
        trip.budget = float(payload["budget"])
    if "days" in payload:
        new_days = int(payload["days"])
        if new_days != old_days:
            needs_recalculation = True
        trip.days = new_days
    if "travelers_count" in payload:
        new_travelers = int(payload["travelers_count"])
        if new_travelers != old_travelers:
            needs_recalculation = True
        trip.travelers_count = new_travelers
    if "travel_type" in payload:
        trip.travel_type = payload["travel_type"]
    if "comfort_score" in payload:
        new_comfort = int(payload["comfort_score"])
        if new_comfort != old_comfort:
            needs_recalculation = True
        trip.comfort_score = new_comfort
    if "status" in payload:
        trip.status = payload["status"]
    if "start_date" in payload:
        trip.start_date = payload["start_date"]
    
    # Recalculate costs if necessary parameters changed
    if needs_recalculation:
        # Get destination for cost calculation
        destination = db.query(models.Destination).filter(
            models.Destination.id == trip.destination_id
        ).first()
        
        if destination:
            # Get user's default starting city or use empty string
            starting_city = current_user.default_starting_city or ""
            
            # Recalculate costs based on new parameters
            # Note: calculate_costs uses 'travelers' parameter, not 'travelers_count'
            costs = calculate_costs(
                dest=destination,
                days=trip.days,
                travelers=trip.travelers_count,
                comfort_score=trip.comfort_score,
                starting_city=starting_city
            )
            
            # Update trip with new costs
            trip.total_estimated_cost = costs["total_estimated_cost"]
            trip.hotel_tier = costs["hotel_tier"]
            trip.transport_mode = costs["transport_mode"]
            
            # Update budget allocation if it exists
            if trip.budget_allocation:
                alloc = trip.budget_allocation
                alloc.transport_cost = costs["transport_cost"]
                alloc.local_transport_cost = costs["local_transport_cost"]
                alloc.hotel_cost = costs["hotel_cost"]
                alloc.food_cost = costs["food_cost"]
                alloc.activities_cost = costs["activities_cost"]
                alloc.taxes_fees_cost = costs["taxes_fees_cost"]
                alloc.emergency_reserve = costs["emergency_reserve"]
        
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(trip)
    
    attach_trip_intelligence(trip, db)
    return trip

@router.patch("/{trip_id}/status", response_model=schemas.TripOut)
def update_trip_status_endpoint(
    trip_id: int,
    payload: dict,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
        models.Trip.id == trip_id,
        models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
        
    status_val = payload.get("status")
    if not status_val:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Status value is required")
        
    valid_statuses = ["Draft", "Planned", "In Progress", "Completed", "Cancelled"]
    if status_val not in valid_statuses:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid status value. Must be one of {valid_statuses}")
        
    trip.status = status_val
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(trip)
    
    attach_trip_intelligence(trip, db)
    return trip

@router.post("/{trip_id}/duplicate", response_model=schemas.TripOut)
def duplicate_trip(
    trip_id: int,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    orig = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
        models.Trip.id == trip_id,
        models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    if not orig:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip to duplicate not found")
        
    dup_trip = models.Trip(
        user_id=current_user.id,
        destination_id=orig.destination_id,
        budget=orig.budget,
        days=orig.days,
        travelers_count=orig.travelers_count,
        travel_type=orig.travel_type,
        comfort_score=orig.comfort_score,
        total_estimated_cost=orig.total_estimated_cost,
        hotel_tier=orig.hotel_tier,
        transport_mode=orig.transport_mode,
        status="Draft",
        start_date=orig.start_date,
        is_public=False,
        share_token=uuid.uuid4().hex
    )
    db.add(dup_trip)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(dup_trip)
    
    if orig.budget_allocation:
        dup_alloc = models.BudgetAllocation(
            trip_id=dup_trip.id,
            transport_cost=orig.budget_allocation.transport_cost,
            hotel_cost=orig.budget_allocation.hotel_cost,
            food_cost=orig.budget_allocation.food_cost,
            activities_cost=orig.budget_allocation.activities_cost,
            local_transport_cost=orig.budget_allocation.local_transport_cost,
            taxes_fees_cost=orig.budget_allocation.taxes_fees_cost,
            emergency_reserve=orig.budget_allocation.emergency_reserve
        )
        db.add(dup_alloc)
        
    for it in orig.itineraries:
        dup_it = models.Itinerary(
            trip_id=dup_trip.id,
            day_number=it.day_number,
            activities=it.activities,
            description=it.description
        )
        db.add(dup_it)
        
    # Duplicate packing checklist
    for item in orig.packing_items:
        dup_item = models.PackingItem(
            trip_id=dup_trip.id,
            name=item.name,
            checked=item.checked
        )
        db.add(dup_item)
        
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(dup_trip)
    
    attach_trip_intelligence(dup_trip, db)
    return dup_trip

@router.post("/{trip_id}/checklist", response_model=schemas.PackingItemOut)
def add_checklist_item(

    trip_id: int,
    payload: dict,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):

    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
        models.Trip.id == trip_id,
        models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
        
    # Update costs
    costs = payload.get("costs")
    if costs:
        trip.total_estimated_cost = costs.get("total_estimated_cost", trip.total_estimated_cost)
        trip.hotel_tier = costs.get("hotel_tier", trip.hotel_tier)
        trip.transport_mode = costs.get("transport_mode", trip.transport_mode)
        
        # Update allocation
        alloc = trip.budget_allocation
        if alloc:
            alloc.transport_cost = costs.get("transport_cost", alloc.transport_cost)
            alloc.hotel_cost = costs.get("hotel_cost", alloc.hotel_cost)
            alloc.food_cost = costs.get("food_cost", alloc.food_cost)
            alloc.activities_cost = costs.get("activities_cost", alloc.activities_cost)
            alloc.local_transport_cost = costs.get("local_transport_cost", alloc.local_transport_cost)
            alloc.taxes_fees_cost = costs.get("taxes_fees_cost", alloc.taxes_fees_cost)
            alloc.emergency_reserve = costs.get("emergency_reserve", alloc.emergency_reserve)
            
    # Update itinerary
    itinerary_days = payload.get("itineraries")
    if itinerary_days:
        # Delete old itinerary days
        db.query(models.Itinerary).filter(models.Itinerary.trip_id == trip.id).delete()
        
        # Insert new itinerary days
        for it_day in itinerary_days:
            db_itinerary = models.Itinerary(
                trip_id=trip.id,
                day_number=it_day["day_number"],
                activities=it_day["activities"],
                description=it_day.get("description", "")
            )
            db.add(db_itinerary)
            
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Trip updated successfully"}

    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(models.Trip.id == trip_id, models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id).first()
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
    name = payload.get("name")
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Item name is required")
        
    db_item = models.PackingItem(
        trip_id=trip_id,
        name=name,
        checked=False
    )
    db.add(db_item)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_item)
    return db_item

@router.put("/{trip_id}/checklist/{item_id}", response_model=schemas.PackingItemOut)
def toggle_checklist_item(
    trip_id: int,
    item_id: int,
    payload: dict,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(models.Trip.id == trip_id, models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id).first()
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
        
    item = db.query(models.PackingItem).filter(models.PackingItem.id == item_id, models.PackingItem.trip_id == trip_id).first()
    if not item:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Packing item not found")
        
    if "checked" in payload:
        item.checked = bool(payload["checked"])
    if "name" in payload:
        item.name = payload["name"]
        
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(item)

    # Check for checklist completion notification
    all_items = db.query(models.PackingItem).filter(models.PackingItem.trip_id == trip_id).all()
    if all_items:
        total_items = len(all_items)
        packed_items = sum([1 for pi in all_items if pi.checked])
        if packed_items == total_items:
            comp_msg = f"Congratulations! Your packing checklist for trip to {trip.destination.name} is 100% complete."
            exists = db.query(models.Notification).filter(
                models.Notification.user_id == current_user.id,
                models.Notification.message == comp_msg
            ).first()
            if not exists:
                db.add(models.Notification(
                    user_id=current_user.id,
                    type="Checklist Completed",
                    message=comp_msg
                ))
                db.commit()
        elif packed_items == 1:
            # Packing started
            start_msg = f"Packing checklist for your trip to {trip.destination.name} has been initiated."
            exists = db.query(models.Notification).filter(
                models.Notification.user_id == current_user.id,
                models.Notification.message == start_msg
            ).first()
            if not exists:
                db.add(models.Notification(
                    user_id=current_user.id,
                    type="Packing Reminder",
                    message=start_msg
                ))
                db.commit()
    return item

def delete_checklist_item(

    trip_id: int,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(models.Trip.id == trip_id, models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id).first()

        db.add(models.Notification(
            user_id=current_user.id,
            type="Trip Shared Successfully",
            message=share_msg
        ))
        db.commit()
        
    attach_trip_intelligence(trip, db)
    return trip

@router.get("/share/{share_token}", response_model=schemas.TripOut)
def get_shared_trip_details(
    share_token: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
        models.Trip.share_token == share_token,
        models.Trip.is_public == True
    ).first()
    
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Shared trip not found or this trip is set to private.")
        
    # Auto-update status
    if trip.status in ["Planned", "In Progress"] and trip.start_date:
        try:
            start_dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(trip.start_date, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
            today = datetime.date.today()
            end_dt = start_dt + datetime.timedelta(days=trip.days)
            
            new_status = trip.status
            if today >= end_dt:
                new_status = "Completed"
            elif today >= start_dt:
                new_status = "In Progress"
                
            if new_status != trip.status:
                trip.status = new_status
                db.commit()
                db.refresh(trip)
        except Exception:
            pass
    
    # Calculate spending/savings
    actual_spent = sum([e.amount for e in trip.expenses])
    trip.actual_spending = round(actual_spent, 2)
    # Savings = money left if you stick to the estimated cost (projected savings)
    trip.savings = round(max(0.0, trip.budget - trip.total_estimated_cost), 2)
    
    # Calculate weather intelligence
    month_val = None
    if trip.start_date:
        try:
            month_val = int(trip.start_date.split("-")[1])
        except Exception:
            pass
    trip.destination.weather_intelligence = calculate_weather_intelligence(trip.destination, month_val)
    
    # Calculate carbon footprint
    cost_val = trip.budget_allocation.transport_cost if trip.budget_allocation else (trip.total_estimated_cost * 0.25)
    trip.carbon_footprint = calculate_carbon_footprint(trip.transport_mode, cost_val)
    
    return trip



@router.get("/reverse/search", response_model=List[schemas.DestinationSearchScore])
def reverse_travel_search(
    budget: float = Query(...),
    days: int = Query(...),
    travel_type: str = Query(...),
    travelers_count: int = Query(1),
    starting_city: Optional[str] = Query("Your City"),
    comfort_score: Optional[int] = Query(50),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    # Fetch all destinations
    destinations = db.query(models.Destination).all()
    if not destinations:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=404,
            detail="Destination dataset is empty. Please seed the database first."
        )

    comfort = comfort_score or 50
    city = starting_city or ""

    all_scored = []
    for dest in destinations:
        costs = calculate_costs(dest, days, travelers_count, comfort, city)
        est_cost = costs["total_estimated_cost"]
        score = calculate_weighted_score(dest, costs, budget, days, travel_type, comfort)
        budget_fit_pct = round((est_cost / budget) * 100, 1)
        breakdown = calculate_score_breakdown(dest, costs, budget, days, travel_type, comfort)
        all_scored.append({
            "destination": dest,
            "estimated_cost": est_cost,
            "budget_fit": budget_fit_pct,
            "rating": dest.rating,
            "value_score": score,
            "breakdown": breakdown
        })

    # --- HARD BUDGET CONSTRAINT ---
    # Step 1: Keep only destinations whose estimated cost is within budget.
    under_budget = [s for s in all_scored if s["estimated_cost"] <= budget]

    # Step 2: If nothing fits, return a 422 with the cheapest available option.
    if not under_budget:
        all_scored.sort(key=lambda x: x["estimated_cost"])
        cheapest = all_scored[0]
        cheapest_cost = round(cheapest["estimated_cost"], 0)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=(
                f"No destination found within your selected budget of â‚¹{budget:,.0f}. "
                f"The most affordable option is {cheapest['destination'].name} "
                f"at approximately â‚¹{cheapest_cost:,.0f}. "
                f"Try increasing your budget, reducing trip duration, or lowering comfort score."
            )
        )

    # Step 3: Rank the under-budget destinations by value_score.
    under_budget.sort(key=lambda x: x["value_score"], reverse=True)
    return under_budget[:5]  # Return top 5 matches

@router.post("/{trip_id}/optimize", response_model=schemas.OptimizationResponse)
def optimize_trip(
    trip_id: int,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
        models.Trip.id == trip_id,
        models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")

    dest = trip.destination
    alloc = trip.budget_allocation
    if not alloc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Trip does not have budget allocation")

    options = []

    # Option 1: Reduce Hotel Cost (Switch hotel tier down)
    if trip.hotel_tier == "Luxury":
        # New hotel cost at Mid-range
        new_hotel_cost = dest.avg_hotel_cost * 1.0 * trip.days
        diff = alloc.hotel_cost - new_hotel_cost
        if diff > 100:
            options.append(
                schemas.OptimizationOption(
                    action_key="reduce_hotel",
                    label="Downgrade Hotel to Mid-Range",
                    cost_difference=-diff,
                    description="Switch accommodation from luxury resort to a highly rated 3-star hotel.",
                    new_allocation=schemas.BudgetAllocationBase(
                        transport_cost=alloc.transport_cost,
                        hotel_cost=new_hotel_cost,
                        food_cost=alloc.food_cost,
                        activities_cost=alloc.activities_cost,
                        local_transport_cost=alloc.local_transport_cost,
                        taxes_fees_cost=alloc.taxes_fees_cost * 0.9, # reduced taxes
                        emergency_reserve=alloc.emergency_reserve * 0.95,
                        emergency_reserve_cost=alloc.emergency_reserve * 0.95 # legacy helper support
                    )
                )
            )
    elif trip.hotel_tier == "Mid-Range":
        # New hotel cost at Budget
        new_hotel_cost = dest.avg_hotel_cost * 0.65 * trip.days
        diff = alloc.hotel_cost - new_hotel_cost
        if diff > 100:
            options.append(
                schemas.OptimizationOption(
                    action_key="reduce_hotel",
                    label="Switch to Budget Hotel / Homestay",
                    cost_difference=-diff,
                    description="Opt for cozy local homestays or premium hostels instead of mid-tier hotels.",
                    new_allocation=schemas.BudgetAllocationBase(
                        transport_cost=alloc.transport_cost,
                        hotel_cost=new_hotel_cost,
                        food_cost=alloc.food_cost,
                        activities_cost=alloc.activities_cost,
                        local_transport_cost=alloc.local_transport_cost,
                        taxes_fees_cost=alloc.taxes_fees_cost * 0.85,
                        emergency_reserve=alloc.emergency_reserve * 0.92
                    )
                )
            )

    # Option 2: Switch flight to train (Reduce Travel Cost)
    if trip.transport_mode == "Flight":
        new_train_cost = max(1000.0, dest.avg_travel_cost * 0.4) * trip.travelers_count
        diff = alloc.transport_cost - new_train_cost
        if diff > 100:
            options.append(
                schemas.OptimizationOption(
                    action_key="reduce_travel",
                    label="Switch Transport from Flight to Train",
                    cost_difference=-diff,
                    description="Travel by AC Sleeper trains instead of flights. Adds travel time but heavily cuts costs.",
                    new_allocation=schemas.BudgetAllocationBase(
                        transport_cost=new_train_cost,
                        hotel_cost=alloc.hotel_cost,
                        food_cost=alloc.food_cost,
                        activities_cost=alloc.activities_cost,
                        local_transport_cost=alloc.local_transport_cost,
                        taxes_fees_cost=alloc.taxes_fees_cost * 0.7,
                        emergency_reserve=alloc.emergency_reserve * 0.9
                    )
                )
            )

    # Option 3: Increase Comfort (Upgrade hotel if they have lots of savings)
    current_savings = trip.budget - trip.total_estimated_cost
    if current_savings > 3000.0:
        if trip.hotel_tier == "Budget":
            new_hotel_cost = dest.avg_hotel_cost * 1.0 * trip.days
            diff = new_hotel_cost - alloc.hotel_cost
            options.append(
                schemas.OptimizationOption(
                    action_key="increase_comfort",
                    label="Upgrade Hotel to Mid-Range",
                    cost_difference=diff,
                    description="Upgrade your accommodation for better services, private pool and complimentary breakfast.",
                    new_allocation=schemas.BudgetAllocationBase(
                        transport_cost=alloc.transport_cost,
                        hotel_cost=new_hotel_cost,
                        food_cost=alloc.food_cost * 1.1, # slightly better meals
                        activities_cost=alloc.activities_cost,
                        local_transport_cost=alloc.local_transport_cost,
                        taxes_fees_cost=alloc.taxes_fees_cost * 1.15,
                        emergency_reserve=alloc.emergency_reserve * 1.05
                    )
                )
            )
        elif trip.hotel_tier == "Mid-Range":
            new_hotel_cost = dest.avg_hotel_cost * 1.85 * trip.days
            diff = new_hotel_cost - alloc.hotel_cost
            options.append(
                schemas.OptimizationOption(
                    action_key="increase_comfort",
                    label="Upgrade Hotel to Premium Luxury Resort",
                    cost_difference=diff,
                    description="Immerse in luxury. Premium room upgrades, spa sessions, and infinity pools.",
                    new_allocation=schemas.BudgetAllocationBase(
                        transport_cost=alloc.transport_cost,
                        hotel_cost=new_hotel_cost,
                        food_cost=alloc.food_cost * 1.3,
                        activities_cost=alloc.activities_cost,
                        local_transport_cost=alloc.local_transport_cost,
                        taxes_fees_cost=alloc.taxes_fees_cost * 1.35,
                        emergency_reserve=alloc.emergency_reserve * 1.2
                    )
                )
            )

    # Option 4: Cut down activities
    if alloc.activities_cost > 1000.0:
        new_act = alloc.activities_cost * 0.5
        diff = alloc.activities_cost - new_act
        options.append(
            schemas.OptimizationOption(
                action_key="reduce_activities",
                label="Streamline Activities Schedule",
                cost_difference=-diff,
                description="Reduce pre-booked activities by 50%. Focus on free natural sights and self-guided exploration.",
                new_allocation=schemas.BudgetAllocationBase(
                    transport_cost=alloc.transport_cost,
                    hotel_cost=alloc.hotel_cost,
                    food_cost=alloc.food_cost,
                    activities_cost=new_act,
                    local_transport_cost=alloc.local_transport_cost,
                    taxes_fees_cost=alloc.taxes_fees_cost * 0.95,
                    emergency_reserve=alloc.emergency_reserve * 0.95
                )
            )
        )

    # Format current allocations to match BaseSchema
    current_alloc = schemas.BudgetAllocationBase(
        transport_cost=alloc.transport_cost,
        hotel_cost=alloc.hotel_cost,
        food_cost=alloc.food_cost,
        activities_cost=alloc.activities_cost,
        emergency_reserve=alloc.emergency_reserve,
        local_transport_cost=alloc.local_transport_cost,
        taxes_fees_cost=alloc.taxes_fees_cost
    )

    return {
        "current_cost": trip.total_estimated_cost,
        "budget": trip.budget,
        "allocations": current_alloc,
        "options": options
    }

@router.post("/{trip_id}/optimize/apply")
def apply_optimization(
    trip_id: int,
    payload: dict,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
        models.Trip.id == trip_id,
        models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")

    alloc = trip.budget_allocation
    if not alloc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Budget allocation not found")

    dest = trip.destination
    action_key = payload.get("action_key")

    if action_key == "reduce_hotel":
        if trip.hotel_tier == "Luxury":
            trip.hotel_tier = "Mid-Range"
            alloc.hotel_cost = dest.avg_hotel_cost * 1.0 * trip.days
        elif trip.hotel_tier == "Mid-Range":
            trip.hotel_tier = "Budget"
            alloc.hotel_cost = dest.avg_hotel_cost * 0.65 * trip.days
        alloc.taxes_fees_cost *= 0.9
        alloc.emergency_reserve *= 0.95
    elif action_key == "reduce_travel":
        if trip.transport_mode == "Flight":
            trip.transport_mode = "Train"
            alloc.transport_cost = max(1000.0, dest.avg_travel_cost * 0.4) * trip.travelers_count
        alloc.taxes_fees_cost *= 0.75
        alloc.emergency_reserve *= 0.9
    elif action_key == "increase_comfort":
        if trip.hotel_tier == "Budget":
            trip.hotel_tier = "Mid-Range"
            alloc.hotel_cost = dest.avg_hotel_cost * 1.0 * trip.days
            alloc.food_cost *= 1.1
        elif trip.hotel_tier == "Mid-Range":
            trip.hotel_tier = "Luxury"
            alloc.hotel_cost = dest.avg_hotel_cost * 1.85 * trip.days
            alloc.food_cost *= 1.3
        alloc.taxes_fees_cost *= 1.2
        alloc.emergency_reserve *= 1.15
    elif action_key == "reduce_activities":
        alloc.activities_cost *= 0.5
        alloc.taxes_fees_cost *= 0.95
        alloc.emergency_reserve *= 0.95

    trip.total_estimated_cost = round(
        alloc.transport_cost + alloc.hotel_cost + alloc.food_cost +
        alloc.activities_cost + alloc.local_transport_cost +
        alloc.taxes_fees_cost + alloc.emergency_reserve,
        2
    )

    db.commit()
    return {
        "status": "success",
        "message": "Optimization applied successfully",
        "new_cost": trip.total_estimated_cost
    }

@router.get("/{trip_id}/pdf")
def download_trip_pdf(
    trip_id: int,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    """Download trip itinerary as premium branded PDF."""
    try:
        trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
            models.Trip.id == trip_id,
            models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id
        ).first()
        
        if not trip:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")

        # Generate premium PDF
        pdf_bytes = generate_premium_trip_pdf(trip, current_user)
        
        return Response(
            content=pdf_bytes,
            media_type="application/pdf",
            headers={
                "Content-Disposition": f"attachment; filename=budgetbound_{trip.destination.name.replace(' ', '_').lower()}.pdf"
            }
        )
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"PDF Generation Error: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"PDF generation failed: {str(e)}")


@router.put("/{trip_id}/allocations", response_model=schemas.TripOut)
def update_trip_allocations(
    trip_id: int,
    payload: dict,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
        models.Trip.id == trip_id,
        models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")

    alloc = trip.budget_allocation
    if not alloc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Trip does not have budget allocation")

    # Categories from allocation editor
    alloc.transport_cost = float(payload.get("transport_cost", alloc.transport_cost))
    alloc.hotel_cost = float(payload.get("hotel_cost", alloc.hotel_cost))
    alloc.food_cost = float(payload.get("food_cost", alloc.food_cost))
    alloc.activities_cost = float(payload.get("activities_cost", alloc.activities_cost))
    alloc.emergency_reserve = float(payload.get("emergency_reserve", alloc.emergency_reserve))
    
    # Reset helper columns to 0.0 if custom edit is applied
    alloc.local_transport_cost = float(payload.get("local_transport_cost", 0.0))
    alloc.taxes_fees_cost = float(payload.get("taxes_fees_cost", 0.0))

    # Recalculate trip total estimated cost
    trip.total_estimated_cost = round(
        alloc.transport_cost + alloc.hotel_cost + alloc.food_cost +
        alloc.activities_cost + alloc.emergency_reserve +
        alloc.local_transport_cost + alloc.taxes_fees_cost,
        2
    )

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(trip)
    return trip

@router.post("/{trip_id}/allocations/reset", response_model=schemas.TripOut)
def reset_trip_allocations(
    trip_id: int,
    payload: Optional[dict] = None,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    trip = db.query(models.Trip).filter(
        models.Trip.id == trip_id,
        models.Trip.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    if not trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")

    alloc = trip.budget_allocation
    if not alloc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Trip does not have budget allocation")

    starting_city = ""
    if payload:
        starting_city = payload.get("starting_city", "")

    # Re-calculate default costs
    dest = trip.destination
    costs = calculate_costs(
        dest=dest,
        days=trip.days,
        travelers=trip.travelers_count,
        comfort_score=trip.comfort_score,
        starting_city=starting_city
    )

    # Apply default values
    alloc.transport_cost = costs["transport_cost"]
    alloc.hotel_cost = costs["hotel_cost"]
    alloc.food_cost = costs["food_cost"]
    alloc.activities_cost = costs["activities_cost"]
    alloc.local_transport_cost = costs["local_transport_cost"]
    alloc.taxes_fees_cost = costs["taxes_fees_cost"]
    alloc.emergency_reserve = costs["emergency_reserve"]

    trip.total_estimated_cost = costs["total_estimated_cost"]

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(trip)
    return trip

@router.post("/multistop", response_model=schemas.MultiStopTripOut)
def save_multistop_trip(
    req: schemas.MultiStopTripCreate,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    """
    Saves an AI-generated multi-stop trip to the user's account.
    Stores the raw JSON result deeply so it can be rehydrated directly on the frontend.
    """
    print(f"DEBUG: Saving multistop trip - name={req.trip_name}, budget={req.total_budget}")
    
    new_ms_trip = models.MultiStopTrip(
        user_id=current_user.id,
        trip_name=req.trip_name,
        total_budget=req.total_budget,
        total_days=req.total_days,
        destinations_str=req.destinations_str,
        raw_json=req.raw_json
    )
    db.add(new_ms_trip)
    
    # Optional: could create a notification
    notif = models.Notification(
        user_id=current_user.id,
        type="Trip Saved",
        message=f"Your multi-stop journey '{req.trip_name}' has been securely saved."
    )
    db.add(notif)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(new_ms_trip)
    
    print(f"DEBUG: Multistop trip saved with id={new_ms_trip.id}")
    return new_ms_trip

):
    """
    Returns all dynamically saved multi-stop trips for the authenticated user.
    """
    trips = db.query(models.MultiStopTrip).filter(models.MultiStopTrip.user_id == current_user.id).order_by(models.MultiStopTrip.created_at.desc()).all()
    return trips

def delete_multistop_trip(
    trip_id: int,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    ms_trip = db.query(models.MultiStopTrip).filter(
        models.MultiStopTrip.id == trip_id,
        models.MultiStopTrip.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    
    if not ms_trip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Multi-stop trip not found")
        
    db.delete(ms_trip)
    db.commit()
    return None

"""
Destination-specific activity database for fallback itinerary generation.
Provides real attractions, dining, transport options, and cost estimates for Indian destinations.
"""

from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Activity:
    """A specific destination activity."""
    title: str
    description: str
    location: str  # Specific neighborhood or landmark
    estimated_cost: float
    duration_minutes: int
    best_time: str  # "morning", "afternoon", "evening"
    category: str  # "heritage", "nature", "food", "culture", "adventure", "market", "leisure"
    vegetarian_friendly: bool = False
    requires_booking: bool = False
    wheelchair_accessible: bool = False


@dataclass
class Restaurant:
    """A specific restaurant or dining venue."""
    name: str
    location: str
    cuisine: str
    avg_cost_per_person: float
    vegetarian_options: bool
    specialties: List[str]  # e.g., ["Butter Chicken", "Chole Bhature"]


@dataclass  
class TransferRoute:
    """Transport between two cities."""
    origin: str
    destination: str
    transport_modes: List[Dict[str, any]]  # [{"mode": "train", "duration_hours": 3.5, "cost_per_person": 400}, ...]

def get_destination_info(destination: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Get database entry for a destination (case-insensitive, fuzzy match)."""
    dest_lower = destination.lower().strip()
    
    # Exact match
    if dest_lower in DESTINATIONS_DB:
        return DESTINATIONS_DB[dest_lower]
    
    # Fuzzy match on common names
    for db_key, db_entry in DESTINATIONS_DB.items():
        common_names = db_entry.get("common_names", [])
        if dest_lower in common_names:
            return db_entry
        # Partial match
        for name in common_names:
            if dest_lower in name or name in dest_lower:
                return db_entry
    
    return None


def get_activities_for_destination(destination: str, category: Optional[str] = None, 
                                  vegetarian_only: bool = False, count: int = 3) -> List[Activity]:
    """Get activities for a destination, filtered by preferences."""
    db_entry = get_destination_info(destination)
    if not db_entry:
        return []
    
    activities = db_entry.get("activities", [])
    
    # Filter by category if specified
    if category:
        activities = [a for a in activities if a.category == category]
    
    # Filter by vegetarian if specified
    if vegetarian_only:
        activities = [a for a in activities if a.vegetarian_friendly]
    
    # Return up to `count` activities
    return activities[:count]


def get_restaurants_for_destination(destination: str, vegetarian_only: bool = False) -> List[Restaurant]:
    """Get restaurants for a destination."""
    db_entry = get_destination_info(destination)
    if not db_entry:
        return []
    
    restaurants = db_entry.get("restaurants", [])
    
    if vegetarian_only:
        restaurants = [r for r in restaurants if r.vegetarian_options]
    
    return restaurants


def get_must_try_food(destination: str, vegetarian: bool = True) -> List[str]:
    """Get must-try foods for a destination based on dietary preference."""
    db_entry = get_destination_info(destination)
    if not db_entry:
        return []
    
    if vegetarian:
        return db_entry.get("must_try_food_veg", [])
    else:
        return db_entry.get("must_try_food_non_veg", [])

FILE: backend/app/services/explainability.py

"""
Explainability Service: Grounds AI-generated explanations in actual decision data.

This service:
1. Traces actual decisions from calculate_costs, comfort scoring, and preferences
2. Assembles decision metadata (inputs, factors, alternatives)
3. Validates financial reconciliation
4. Produces structured explanations immune to AI hallucination
5. Optionally enhances explanations with LLM-powered summarization
"""

import logging
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional, Tuple
from decimal import Decimal

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def get_transport_alternatives(
    comfort_score: int,
    distance_multiplier: float,
    travelers: int,
    base_train_cost: float,
    base_flight_cost: float
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Generate alternative transport options with calculated costs.
    
    Returns list of [{"mode": "Train", "cost": X, "duration": "Y hrs", "notes": "..."}]
    """
    # These are realistic Indian transport cost estimates
    alternatives = []
    
    train_cost = max(600.0, base_train_cost) * travelers
    flight_cost = max(2500.0, base_flight_cost) * travelers
    
    # Train: cheaper, longer, more comfortable sleeper options
    if base_train_cost > 0:
        alternatives.append({
            "mode": "Train (Sleeper)",
            "cost": round(train_cost, 2),
            "estimated_duration": "12-24 hours (depending on distance)",
            "comfort_level": "Basic to Comfort",
            "notes": "Most budget-friendly for long distances; overnight travel saves accommodation"
        })
    
    # Flight: expensive, fast
    if base_flight_cost > 0:
        alternatives.append({
            "mode": "Flight",
            "cost": round(flight_cost, 2),
            "estimated_duration": "2-4 hours",
            "comfort_level": "Premium",
            "notes": "Fastest option; consider cost difference vs. time saved"
        })
    
    # Bus as tertiary option
    bus_cost = max(400.0, base_train_cost * 0.7) * travelers  # buses typically 30% cheaper than trains
    alternatives.append({
        "mode": "Bus (Luxury Coach)",
        "cost": round(bus_cost, 2),
        "estimated_duration": "14-36 hours (depending on distance)",
        "comfort_level": "Basic",
        "notes": "Budget option; consider overnight travel for extra comfort"
    })
    
    return alternatives


def get_accommodation_alternatives(
    destination_avg_hotel_cost: float,
    days: int,
    comfort_score: int
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Generate accommodation tier options with calculated costs per night.
    """
    budget_per_night = destination_avg_hotel_cost * 0.65
    midrange_per_night = destination_avg_hotel_cost * 1.0
    luxury_per_night = destination_avg_hotel_cost * 1.85
    
    alternatives = [
        {
            "tier": "Budget",
            "cost_per_night": round(budget_per_night, 2),
            "total_cost": round(budget_per_night * days, 2),
            "description": "Hostels, guesthouses, basic hotels",
            "comfort_level": "Basic (30/100)",
            "amenities": ["WiFi", "Fan/AC", "Basic bathroom"]
        },
        {
            "tier": "Mid-Range",
            "cost_per_night": round(midrange_per_night, 2),
            "total_cost": round(midrange_per_night * days, 2),
            "description": "3-star hotels, nice resorts",
            "comfort_level": "Comfortable (60/100)",
            "amenities": ["WiFi", "AC", "En-suite bathroom", "TV"]
        },
        {
            "tier": "Luxury",
            "cost_per_night": round(luxury_per_night, 2),
            "total_cost": round(luxury_per_night * days, 2),
            "description": "5-star resorts, premium experiences",
            "comfort_level": "Premium (90/100)",
            "amenities": ["WiFi", "AC", "Luxury bathroom", "Concierge", "Restaurant"]
        }
    ]
    
    return alternatives


def calculate_budget_reconciliation(
    transport_cost: float,
    hotel_cost: float,
    food_cost: float,
    activities_cost: float,
    local_transport_cost: float,
    taxes_fees_cost: float,
    emergency_reserve: float,
    total_budget: float
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Verify that all costs reconcile to the total and compute percentages.
    
    Returns: {
        "subtotal": X,
        "total_with_contingency": Y,
        "remaining_after_contingency": Z,
        "allocations": {...},
        "is_balanced": True/False,
        "variance_percent": 0.5 (how much under/over budget)
    }
    """
    allocations = {
        "Accommodation": hotel_cost,
        "Inter-city Transport": transport_cost,
        "Local Transport": local_transport_cost,
        "Food & Dining": food_cost,
        "Activities & Admissions": activities_cost,
        "Taxes & Fees": taxes_fees_cost,
    }
    
    subtotal = sum(allocations.values())
    total_with_contingency = subtotal + emergency_reserve
    remaining = total_budget - total_with_contingency
    
    variance_percent = abs(remaining) / total_budget * 100.0 if total_budget > 0 else 0.0
    is_balanced = variance_percent < 5.0  # Within 5% is acceptable
    
    return {
        "subtotal": round(subtotal, 2),
        "total_with_contingency": round(total_with_contingency, 2),
        "remaining_after_contingency": round(remaining, 2),
        "allocations": {k: round(v, 2) for k, v in allocations.items()},
        "is_balanced": is_balanced,
        "variance_percent": round(variance_percent, 2),
        "variance_rupees": round(remaining, 2)
    }


def build_accommodation_explanation(
    hotel_tier: str,
    hotel_cost: float,
    days: int,
    comfort_score: int,
    destination_avg: float
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Build grounded explanation for accommodation choice.
    """
    selected_per_night = hotel_cost / days if days > 0 else 0
    
    decision_factors = [
        f"Comfort score: {comfort_score}/100",
        f"Trip duration: {days} days",
        f"Destination average: â‚¹{destination_avg:,.0f}/night (mid-range)"
    ]
    
    # Determine which tier was selected
    budget_threshold = destination_avg * 0.65
    luxury_threshold = destination_avg * 1.85
    
    if selected_per_night <= budget_threshold * 1.1:
        tier_reason = "Budget-conscious travelers or low comfort scores typically choose hostels/guesthouses"
    elif selected_per_night >= luxury_threshold * 0.9:
        tier_reason = "High comfort score (>70) justifies premium resorts and full-service hotels"
    else:
        tier_reason = "Mid-range balance between cost and comfort; standard 3-star hotels"
    
    # Alternatives
    alternatives = get_accommodation_alternatives(destination_avg, days, comfort_score)
    
    return {
        "category": "Accommodation",
        "selected_option": f"{hotel_tier} Hotel/Resort",
        "selected_cost": round(hotel_cost, 2),
        "estimated_cost": round(hotel_cost, 2),
        "cost_per_night": round(selected_per_night, 2),
        "allocation_percentage": 0.0,  # Will be calculated from budget
        "decision_factors": decision_factors,
        "alternatives": alternatives,
        "explanation": tier_reason
    }


def build_transport_explanation(
    transport_mode: str,
    transport_cost: float,
    comfort_score: int,
    travelers: int,
    starting_city: Optional[str],
    destination_name: str,
    base_train_cost: float,
    base_flight_cost: float
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Build grounded explanation for transport mode choice.
    """
    cost_per_person = transport_cost / travelers if travelers > 0 else 0
    
    decision_factors = [
        f"Comfort score: {comfort_score}/100",
        f"Travelers: {comfort_score}",
        f"Route: {starting_city or 'Unknown'} â†’ {destination_name}"
    ]
    
    # Why was this mode selected?
    if transport_mode.lower() == "train":
        mode_reason = (
            "Train selected due to lower comfort score (<50). Sleeper trains offer "
            "better budget-to-comfort ratio; overnight travel also saves accommodation costs."
        )
    else:  # Flight
        mode_reason = (
            "Flight selected due to higher comfort score (â‰¥50). Faster travel preserves "
            "more time for destination experiences."
        )
    
    # Calculate alternatives
    alternatives = get_transport_alternatives(
        comfort_score=comfort_score,
        distance_multiplier=1.0,  # Placeholder
        travelers=travelers,
        base_train_cost=base_train_cost,
        base_flight_cost=base_flight_cost
    )
    
    return {
        "category": "Inter-city Transportation",
        "selected_option": transport_mode,
        "selected_cost": round(transport_cost, 2),
        "estimated_cost": round(transport_cost, 2),
        "cost_per_person": round(cost_per_person, 2),
        "allocation_percentage": 0.0,
        "decision_factors": decision_factors,
        "alternatives": alternatives,
        "explanation": mode_reason
    }


def build_food_explanation(
    food_cost: float,
    days: int,
    travelers: int,
    comfort_score: int,
    destination_name: str
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Build grounded explanation for food allocation.
    """
    daily_per_person = (food_cost / (days * travelers)) if (days * travelers) > 0 else 0
    
    decision_factors = [
        f"Trip duration: {days} days",
        f"Comfort score: {comfort_score}/100",
        f"Travelers: {travelers}",
        f"Destination: {destination_name}"
    ]
    
    if comfort_score < 50:
        food_reason = (
            f"Budget dining: ~â‚¹{daily_per_person:,.0f}/person/day. Emphasizes street food, "
            "local eateries, and self-catering options."
        )
    elif comfort_score <= 70:
        food_reason = (
            f"Mid-range dining: ~â‚¹{daily_per_person:,.0f}/person/day. Mix of restaurants, "
            "casual dining, and local specialties."
        )
    else:
        food_reason = (
            f"Premium dining: ~â‚¹{daily_per_person:,.0f}/person/day. Includes fine dining, "
            "restaurant meals, and culinary experiences."
        )
    
    return {
        "category": "Food & Dining",
        "selected_option": f"Daily allocation â‚¹{daily_per_person:,.0f}/person",
        "selected_cost": round(food_cost, 2),
        "estimated_cost": round(food_cost, 2),
        "daily_per_person": round(daily_per_person, 2),
        "allocation_percentage": 0.0,
        "decision_factors": decision_factors,
        "alternatives": None,
        "explanation": food_reason
    }


def build_activities_explanation(

    decision_factors = [

    activities_reason = (

        f"activity(ies) per day at â‚¹{avg_per_activity:,.0f} per activity. This covers "
        f"entry fees, guided tours, and adventure activities."
    )
    
    return {
        "category": "Activities & Admissions",
        "selected_option": f"{activities_per_day} activity(ies)/day",
        "selected_cost": round(activities_cost, 2),
        "estimated_cost": round(activities_cost, 2),
        "avg_per_activity": round(avg_per_activity, 2),
        "allocation_percentage": 0.0,
        "decision_factors": decision_factors,
        "alternatives": None,
        "explanation": activities_reason
    }

    }


def assemble_cost_explanations(
    trip: Any,  # sqlalchemy Trip model
    costs_dict: Dict[str, Any],  # Output from calculate_costs
    budget: float,
    days: int,
    travelers: int,
    comfort_score: int,
    travel_type: str,
    starting_city: Optional[str],
    destination: Any  # sqlalchemy Destination model
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Assemble all cost explanations and normalize percentages.
    
    Returns: List of cost explanations with percentages calculated against total budget.
    """
    explanations = [
        build_accommodation_explanation(
            hotel_tier=costs_dict["hotel_tier"],
            hotel_cost=costs_dict["hotel_cost"],
            days=days,
            comfort_score=comfort_score,
            destination_avg=destination.avg_hotel_cost
        ),
        build_transport_explanation(
            transport_mode=costs_dict["transport_mode"],
            transport_cost=costs_dict["transport_cost"],
            comfort_score=comfort_score,
            travelers=travelers,
            starting_city=starting_city,
            destination_name=destination.name,
            base_train_cost=costs_dict["transport_cost"] / travelers * 0.45,  # Approximation
            base_flight_cost=costs_dict["transport_cost"] / travelers * 1.25  # Approximation
        ),
        build_food_explanation(
            food_cost=costs_dict["food_cost"],
            days=days,
            travelers=travelers,
            comfort_score=comfort_score,
            destination_name=destination.name
        ),
        build_activities_explanation(
            activities_cost=costs_dict["activities_cost"],
            days=days,
            travelers=travelers,
            comfort_score=comfort_score,
            destination_name=destination.name
        ),
        {
            "category": "Local Transportation",
            "selected_option": "Local transit & taxis",
            "selected_cost": round(costs_dict["local_transport_cost"], 2),
            "estimated_cost": round(costs_dict["local_transport_cost"], 2),
            "per_day_per_person": round(costs_dict["local_transport_cost"] / (days * travelers), 2),
            "allocation_percentage": 0.0,
            "decision_factors": [f"Trip duration: {days} days", f"Travelers: {travelers}"],
            "alternatives": None,
            "explanation": f"â‚¹{costs_dict['local_transport_cost']/days:,.0f}/day for local buses, autos, metro. Varies by destination."
        },
        {
            "category": "Taxes & Fees",
            "selected_option": "GST & service charges",
            "selected_cost": round(costs_dict["taxes_fees_cost"], 2),
            "estimated_cost": round(costs_dict["taxes_fees_cost"], 2),
            "percentage_of_pretax": round(costs_dict["taxes_fees_cost"] / (costs_dict["transport_cost"] + costs_dict["hotel_cost"] + costs_dict["activities_cost"]) * 100, 2) if (costs_dict["transport_cost"] + costs_dict["hotel_cost"] + costs_dict["activities_cost"]) > 0 else 0.0,
            "allocation_percentage": 0.0,
            "decision_factors": [],
            "alternatives": None,
            "explanation": "12% GST applied to transport, accommodation, and activities."
        },
        build_contingency_explanation(
            emergency_reserve=costs_dict["emergency_reserve"],
            subtotal=sum([costs_dict[k] for k in ["transport_cost", "hotel_cost", "food_cost", "activities_cost", "local_transport_cost", "taxes_fees_cost"]]),
            total_budget=budget
        )
    ]
    
    # Normalize percentages relative to total budget
    for exp in explanations:
        exp["allocation_percentage"] = round(exp["selected_cost"] / budget * 100.0, 1)
    
    return explanations

"""
Financial validator for personalized travel plans.

Implements a declarative accounting convention to ensure:
- No negative expense categories
- No double-counting
- Perfect reconciliation between daily, category, and total costs
- Clear remaining budget or overspend calculation
"""

from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional
from decimal import Decimal
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class FinancialValidator:
    """
    Validates financial consistency in travel itineraries.
    
    Accounting Convention:
    - All costs in INR (Indian Rupees), represented as Decimal for precision
    - Trip-level costs (accommodation, transport): allocated per day or across trip
    - Daily costs (food, activities): summed per day
    - Contingency: trip-level reserve, not included in daily sums
    - estimated_total_cost = sum(accommodation) + sum(food) + sum(activities) + transport + contingency
    """
    
    def __init__(self, budget_limit: float, num_days: int):
        self.budget_limit = Decimal(str(budget_limit))
        self.num_days = num_days
        self.errors: List[str] = []
        self.warnings: List[str] = []
    
    def validate_expense_item(self, value: float, category: str) -> bool:
        """Check that a single expense is non-negative."""
        if value < 0:
            self.errors.append(f"{category}: negative cost Rs. {value:.2f}")
            return False
        return True
    
    def validate_daily_costs(self, days: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[float, bool]:
        """
        Validate and sum daily costs from activity-level details.
        
        Each day: {"day_number": int, "activities": [{"cost": float, ...}, ...]}
        
        Returns: (total_daily_cost, is_valid)
        """
        total = Decimal('0')
        is_valid = True
        
        for day in days:
            day_num = day.get('day_number')
            activities = day.get('activities', [])
            
            day_total = Decimal('0')
            for activity in activities:
                cost = activity.get('cost', 0)
                if not self.validate_expense_item(cost, f"Day {day_num} activity"):
                    is_valid = False
                day_total += Decimal(str(cost))
            
            # Log daily total
            logger.debug(f"Day {day_num} total: Rs. {day_total}")
            total += day_total
        
        return float(total), is_valid
    
    def validate_budget_breakdown(
        self,
        accommodation_per_night: float,
        food_per_day: float,
        activities_per_day: float,
        transport: float,
        contingency: float,
    ) -> Tuple[float, bool]:
        """
        Validate and sum budget breakdown categories.
        
        Returns: (calculated_total, is_valid)
        """
        is_valid = True
        
        # Validate each category is non-negative
        for name, value in [
            ("accommodation_per_night", accommodation_per_night),
            ("food_per_day", food_per_day),
            ("activities_per_day", activities_per_day),
            ("transport", transport),
            ("contingency", contingency),
        ]:
            if not self.validate_expense_item(value, name):
                is_valid = False
        
        # Calculate total from breakdown
        accommodation_total = Decimal(str(accommodation_per_night)) * self.num_days
        food_total = Decimal(str(food_per_day)) * self.num_days
        activities_total = Decimal(str(activities_per_day)) * self.num_days
        transport_total = Decimal(str(transport))
        contingency_total = Decimal(str(contingency))
        
        calculated_total = (
            accommodation_total + food_total + activities_total + transport_total + contingency_total
        )
        
        return float(calculated_total), is_valid
    
    def reconcile_costs(
        self,
        daily_activity_total: float,
        budget_breakdown_total: float,
        estimated_total_cost: float,
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Check that daily costs, breakdown, and estimated total reconcile.
        
        Tolerance: 2% of budget or Rs. 100, whichever is larger (for rounding).
        """
        daily = Decimal(str(daily_activity_total))
        breakdown = Decimal(str(budget_breakdown_total))
        estimated = Decimal(str(estimated_total_cost))
        
        # Calculate tolerance
        tolerance = max(
            self.budget_limit * Decimal('0.02'),  # 2% of budget
            Decimal('100')  # Or Rs. 100 minimum
        )
        
        is_valid = True
        
        # Check breakdown vs estimated
        if abs(breakdown - estimated) > tolerance:
            self.errors.append(
                f"Budget breakdown total (Rs. {breakdown}) does not match "
                f"estimated total (Rs. {estimated}). Difference: Rs. {abs(breakdown - estimated)}"
            )
            is_valid = False
        
        # Check daily vs breakdown (as a warning, since daily may not include all trip-level costs)
        if abs(daily - breakdown) > tolerance:
            self.warnings.append(
                f"Daily activity costs (Rs. {daily}) differ from breakdown total (Rs. {breakdown}). "
                f"Difference: Rs. {abs(daily - breakdown)}. This may be intentional if trip-level "
                f"expenses (transport, contingency) are not included in daily costs."
            )
        
        return is_valid
    
    def validate_budget_compliance(self, estimated_total_cost: float) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[float]]:
        """
        Check that estimated total is within budget.
        
        Returns: (is_within_budget, overspend_amount_or_None)
        """
        estimated = Decimal(str(estimated_total_cost))
        
        if estimated <= self.budget_limit:
            remaining = self.budget_limit - estimated
            logger.debug(f"Within budget: Rs. {estimated} â‰¤ Rs. {self.budget_limit}, remaining: Rs. {remaining}")
            return True, None
        else:
            overspend = estimated - self.budget_limit
            self.errors.append(
                f"Estimated total (Rs. {estimated}) exceeds budget (Rs. {self.budget_limit}). "
                f"Overspend: Rs. {overspend}"
            )
            return False, float(overspend)
    
    def validate_itinerary(
        self,
        days: List[Dict],
        accommodation_per_night: float,
        food_per_day: float,
        activities_per_day: float,
        transport: float,
        contingency: float,
        estimated_total_cost: float,
    ) -> Dict:
        """
        Perform complete financial validation of an itinerary.
        
        Returns: {
            "is_valid": bool,
            "estimated_total_cost": float,
            "budget_limit": float,
            "remaining_budget": float or None,
            "overspend": float or None,
            "errors": [str, ...],
            "warnings": [str, ...],
            "daily_activity_total": float,
            "breakdown_total": float,
        }
        """
        self.errors = []
        self.warnings = []
        
        # Validate daily costs from activities
        daily_total, daily_valid = self.validate_daily_costs(days)
        
        # Validate budget breakdown
        breakdown_total, breakdown_valid = self.validate_budget_breakdown(
            accommodation_per_night, food_per_day, activities_per_day, transport, contingency
        )
        
        # Reconcile the two approaches
        reconcile_valid = self.reconcile_costs(daily_total, breakdown_total, estimated_total_cost)
        
        # Check budget compliance
        within_budget, overspend = self.validate_budget_compliance(estimated_total_cost)
        
        remaining_budget = None
        if within_budget:
            remaining_budget = float(self.budget_limit - Decimal(str(estimated_total_cost)))
        
        is_valid = daily_valid and breakdown_valid and reconcile_valid and within_budget
        
        return {
            "is_valid": is_valid,
            "estimated_total_cost": estimated_total_cost,
            "budget_limit": float(self.budget_limit),
            "remaining_budget": remaining_budget,
            "overspend": overspend,
            "errors": self.errors,
            "warnings": self.warnings,
            "daily_activity_total": daily_total,
            "breakdown_total": breakdown_total,
        }
