# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
# PDF GENERATOR CLASS
# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class DetailedTravelItineraryPDF:
    """Generate a professional, formally-typeset travel itinerary and budget report."""
    
    # Page dimensions (A4 = 210 x 297 mm)
    PAGE_WIDTH = 210 * mm
    PAGE_HEIGHT = 297 * mm
    MARGIN = 20 * mm
    CONTENT_WIDTH = PAGE_WIDTH - (2 * MARGIN)  # 170 mm
    
    def __init__(self, trip, user, styles):
        self.trip = trip
        self.user = user
        self.styles = styles
    
    def generate(self) -> bytes:
        """Generate and return PDF bytes."""
        buffer = io.BytesIO()
        
        doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
            buffer,
            pagesize=A4,
            rightMargin=self.MARGIN / mm * cm / 10,
            leftMargin=self.MARGIN / mm * cm / 10,
            topMargin=20,
            bottomMargin=20,
            title=f"Travel Itinerary - {self.trip.destination.name}",
            author="BudgetBound",
        )
        
        story = []
        
        # Page 1: Cover + Destination + Budget (combined when possible)
        story.extend(self._build_cover_and_summary())
        story.extend(self._build_destination_info())
        story.extend(self._build_budget_section())
        
        # Intelligent break before itinerary
        story.append(CondPageBreak(height=5 * cm))
        
        # Daily Itinerary (may span multiple pages)
        story.extend(self._build_daily_itinerary())
        
        # Optional sections
        if self.trip.packing_items:
            story.append(CondPageBreak(height=3 * cm))
            story.extend(self._build_packing_section())
        
        if self.trip.documents:
            story.append(CondPageBreak(height=3 * cm))
            story.extend(self._build_documents_section())
        
        # Build PDF
        doc.build(
            story,
            canvasmaker=lambda fname, **kw: DetailedTravelCanvas(
                fname,
                trip_title=self.trip.destination.name,
                **kw
            )
        )
        
        buffer.seek(0)
        return buffer.getvalue()

    # COVER PAGE - Balanced, formal composition

    def _build_cover_and_summary(self) -> List[Flowable]:
        """Build balanced cover page with trip summary."""
        story = []
        
        # Compact spacing (not wasteful)
        story.append(Spacer(1, 0.8 * cm))
        
        # BudgetBound branding (subtle)
        story.append(Paragraph("BudgetBound", ParagraphStyle(
            'BrandName',
            fontName='Helvetica-Bold',
            fontSize=11,
            textColor=COLOR_PINK,
            alignment=TA_CENTER,
            spaceAfter=3,
        )))
        
        # Main title (24pt, not 32pt)
        story.append(Paragraph(
            "Travel Itinerary & Budget Report",
            self.styles['CoverTitle']
        ))
        
        # Blue divider line
        divider_table = Table([['']], colWidths=[17 * cm])
        divider_table.setStyle(TableStyle([
            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (0, 0), COLOR_BLUE),
            ('ROWBACKGROUNDS', (0, 0), (0, 0), [COLOR_BLUE]),
            ('LINEABOVE', (0, 0), (0, 0), 2, COLOR_BLUE),
            ('LINEBELOW', (0, 0), (0, 0), 0, colors.white),
            ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (0, 0), 'MIDDLE'),
            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (0, 0), 2),
            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (0, 0), 2),
        ]))
        story.append(divider_table)
        
        story.append(Spacer(1, 0.5 * cm))
        
        # Destination and location
        story.append(Paragraph(
            self.trip.destination.name.upper(),
            self.styles['DestinationTitle']
        ))
        
        story.append(Paragraph(
            f"{self.trip.destination.state}, India",
            self.styles['LocationSubtitle']
        ))
        
        # Trip summary: Compact, full-width table
        summary_data = [
            [
                Paragraph("<b>Duration</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                Paragraph(f"{self.trip.days} days", self.styles['TableCell']),
                Paragraph("<b>Travelers</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                Paragraph(str(self.trip.travelers_count), self.styles['TableCell']),
            ],
        ]
        
        if self.trip.start_date or self.trip.transport_mode or self.trip.hotel_tier:
            summary_data.append([
                Paragraph("<b>Transport</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                Paragraph(self.trip.transport_mode or "-", self.styles['TableCell']),
                Paragraph("<b>Hotel Tier</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                Paragraph(self.trip.hotel_tier or "-", self.styles['TableCell']),
            ])
        
        if self.trip.travel_type:
            summary_data.append([
                Paragraph("<b>Travel Type</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                Paragraph(self.trip.travel_type, self.styles['TableCell']),
                Paragraph("", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                Paragraph("", self.styles['TableCell']),
            ])
        
        summary_table = Table(summary_data, colWidths=[2.4 * cm, 3.8 * cm, 2.4 * cm, 3.8 * cm])
        summary_table.setStyle(TableStyle([
            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (0, -1), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
            ('BACKGROUND', (2, 0), (2, -1), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
            ('BACKGROUND', (1, 0), (1, -1), colors.white),
            ('BACKGROUND', (3, 0), (3, -1), colors.white),
            ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, COLOR_GREY_BORDER),
            ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'MIDDLE'),
            ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.15 * cm),
            ('RIGHTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.15 * cm),
            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
            ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 9),
        ]))
        
        story.append(summary_table)
        
        story.append(Spacer(1, 0.6 * cm))
        
        # Budget Overview (concise, inline)
        story.append(Paragraph("<b>Budget Overview</b>", self.styles['SubsectionHeader']))
        
        planned = self.trip.budget
        estimated = self.trip.total_estimated_cost
        remaining = planned - estimated
        
        budget_data = [
            [
                Paragraph(format_currency(planned), self.styles['TableCellBold']),
                Paragraph(format_currency(estimated), self.styles['TableCellBold']),
                Paragraph(format_currency(abs(remaining)), self.styles['TableCellBold']),
            ]
        ]
        
        budget_table = Table(budget_data, colWidths=[5.7 * cm, 5.7 * cm, 5.7 * cm])
        budget_table.setStyle(TableStyle([
            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
            ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, COLOR_GREY_BORDER),
            ('ALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'RIGHT'),
            ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.2 * cm),
            ('RIGHTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.2 * cm),
            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.15 * cm),
            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.15 * cm),
        ]))
        
        # Header above budget values
        story.append(Table([[
            Paragraph("Planned Budget", self.styles['TableHeader']),
            Paragraph("Estimated Cost", self.styles['TableHeader']),
            Paragraph("Remaining", self.styles['TableHeader']),
        ]], colWidths=[5.7 * cm, 5.7 * cm, 5.7 * cm], style=TableStyle([
            ('ALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 'RIGHT'),
            ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 0.2 * cm),
            ('RIGHTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 0.2 * cm),

        story.append(budget_table)
        
        return story

    # BUDGET SECTION - Full-width tables, intelligent layout
    # â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    
    def _build_budget_section(self) -> List[Flowable]:
        """Build budget summary and breakdown on same page."""
        story = []
        
        story.append(Spacer(1, 0.4 * cm))
        story.append(Paragraph("Budget Analysis", self.styles['SectionHeader']))
        story.append(Spacer(1, 0.2 * cm))
        
        # Summary: Concise, full-width
        planned = self.trip.budget
        estimated = self.trip.total_estimated_cost
        remaining = planned - estimated
        utilization = (estimated / planned * 100) if planned > 0 else 0
        
        summary_data = [
            [
                Paragraph("<b>Planned Budget</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                Paragraph(format_currency(planned), self.styles['TableCellBold']),
                Paragraph("<b>Estimated Cost</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                Paragraph(format_currency(estimated), self.styles['TableCellBold']),
                Paragraph("<b>Utilization</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                Paragraph(f"{utilization:.0f}%", self.styles['TableCellBold']),
            ]
        ]
        
        summary_table = Table(summary_data, colWidths=[2.6 * cm, 2.5 * cm, 2.6 * cm, 2.5 * cm, 2.4 * cm, 2.0 * cm])
        summary_table.setStyle(TableStyle([
            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (0, 0), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
            ('BACKGROUND', (2, 0), (2, 0), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
            ('BACKGROUND', (4, 0), (4, 0), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
            ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, COLOR_GREY_BORDER),
            ('ALIGN', (1, 0), (1, 0), 'RIGHT'),
            ('ALIGN', (3, 0), (3, 0), 'RIGHT'),
            ('ALIGN', (5, 0), (5, 0), 'RIGHT'),
            ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 0.15 * cm),
            ('RIGHTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 0.15 * cm),
            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 0.12 * cm),
            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 0.12 * cm),
        ]))
        
        story.append(summary_table)
        
        story.append(Spacer(1, 0.3 * cm))
        
        # Category breakdown: Full-width table
        if self.trip.budget_allocation:
            story.append(Paragraph("<b>Expense Breakdown</b>", self.styles['SubsectionHeader']))
            
            alloc = self.trip.budget_allocation
            categories = [
                ("Accommodation", alloc.hotel_cost),
                ("Food & Dining", alloc.food_cost),
                ("Activities", alloc.activities_cost),
                ("Local Transport", alloc.local_transport_cost),
                ("Long-Distance Transport", alloc.transport_cost),
                ("Taxes & Fees", alloc.taxes_fees_cost),
                ("Emergency Reserve", alloc.emergency_reserve),
            ]
            
            total = sum(cost for _, cost in categories)
            
            breakdown_data = [
                [
                    Paragraph("<b>Expense Category</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                    Paragraph("<b>Estimated Amount</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                    Paragraph("<b>Share of Budget</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                ]
            ]
            
            for cat_name, cat_cost in categories:
                pct = (cat_cost / total * 100) if total > 0 else 0
                breakdown_data.append([
                    Paragraph(cat_name, self.styles['TableCell']),
                    Paragraph(format_currency(cat_cost), self.styles['TableCellRight']),
                    Paragraph(f"{pct:.1f}%", self.styles['TableCellRight']),
                ])
            
            breakdown_table = Table(breakdown_data, colWidths=[6.0 * cm, 4.0 * cm, 4.0 * cm])
            breakdown_table.setStyle(TableStyle([
                ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
                ('BACKGROUND', (0, 1), (-1, -1), colors.white),
                ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, COLOR_GREY_BORDER),
                ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'MIDDLE'),
                ('ALIGN', (1, 0), (2, -1), 'RIGHT'),
                ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.2 * cm),
                ('RIGHTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.2 * cm),
                ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
                ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
            ]))
            
            story.append(breakdown_table)
        
        return story
    
    # â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    # DAILY ITINERARY - Properly-sized columns, consistent formatting
    # â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    
    def _build_daily_itinerary(self) -> List[Flowable]:
        """Build day-by-day itinerary with calculated column widths."""
        story = []
        
        story.append(Paragraph("Daily Itinerary", self.styles['SectionHeader']))
        story.append(Spacer(1, 0.2 * cm))
        
        # Table width: 170mm (full content width)
        # Column proportions: Time 20% | Activity 65% | Cost 15%
        time_width = 3.4 * cm
        activity_width = 11.05 * cm
        cost_width = 2.55 * cm
        
        itineraries = sorted(self.trip.itineraries, key=lambda x: x.day_number)
        
        for itinerary in itineraries:
            day_num = itinerary.day_number
            day_title = itinerary.description or "Exploration"
            
            # Day header: Compact, not overly long
            day_text = f"DAY {day_num:02d}"
            if day_title:
                # Truncate title if too long
                if len(day_title) > 45:
                    day_title = day_title[:42] + "..."
                day_text = f"{day_text} - {day_title.upper()}"
            
            story.append(Paragraph(
                day_text,
                self.styles['DayHeader']
            ))
            
            # Activities table
            activities = itinerary.activities if isinstance(itinerary.activities, list) else []
            
            if activities:
                # Build table with explicit column widths
                activity_data = [
                    [
                        Paragraph("<b>Time</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                        Paragraph("<b>Activity and Details</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                        Paragraph("<b>Cost</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                    ]
                ]
                
                for activity in activities:
                    time_str = activity.get('time', '')
                    title_str = activity.get('title', 'Activity')
                    cost_val = activity.get('cost', 0)
                    notes_str = activity.get('notes', '')
                    
                    # Combine title and notes for activity
                    activity_text = title_str
                    if notes_str:
                        activity_text = f"{title_str}\n{notes_str}"
                    
                    cost_text = format_currency(cost_val) if cost_val > 0 else "Included"
                    
                    activity_data.append([
                        Paragraph(time_str, self.styles['TableCell']),
                        Paragraph(activity_text, self.styles['TableCell']),
                        Paragraph(cost_text, self.styles['TableCellRight']),
                    ])
                
                # Table with explicit column widths (total: 170mm)
                activity_table = Table(
                    activity_data,
                    colWidths=[time_width, activity_width, cost_width]
                )
                
                activity_table.setStyle(TableStyle([
                    ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
                    ('BACKGROUND', (0, 1), (-1, -1), colors.white),
                    ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, COLOR_GREY_BORDER),
                    ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'TOP'),
                    ('ALIGN', (0, 0), (0, -1), 'LEFT'),
                    ('ALIGN', (2, 0), (2, -1), 'RIGHT'),
                    ('FONTNAME', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 'Helvetica-Bold'),
                    ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 9),
                    ('FONTNAME', (0, 1), (-1, -1), 'Helvetica'),
                    ('FONTSIZE', (0, 1), (-1, -1), 9),
                    ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.2 * cm),
                    ('RIGHTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.2 * cm),
                    ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
                    ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
                    ('ROWHEIGHT', (0, 1), (-1, -1), None),  # Allow natural row height
                ]))
                
                story.append(activity_table)
            
            story.append(Spacer(1, 0.25 * cm))
        
        return story
    
    # â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    # PACKING CHECKLIST - Compact, two-column layout
    # â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    
    def _build_packing_section(self) -> List[Flowable]:
        """Build packing checklist with compact layout."""
        story = []
        
        story.append(Paragraph("Packing Checklist", self.styles['SectionHeader']))
        story.append(Spacer(1, 0.2 * cm))
        
        if self.trip.packing_items:
            items = list(self.trip.packing_items)
            mid_point = (len(items) + 1) // 2
            
            # Two-column packing list
            packing_data = [
                [
                    Paragraph("<b>Item</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                    Paragraph("<b>âœ“</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                    Paragraph("<b>Item</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                    Paragraph("<b>âœ“</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                ]
            ]
            
            for i in range(mid_point):
                left_item = items[i]
                left_status = "âœ“" if left_item.checked else "-"
                
                if i + mid_point < len(items):
                    right_item = items[i + mid_point]
                    right_status = "âœ“" if right_item.checked else "-"
                else:
                    right_item = None
                    right_status = ""
                
                row = [
                    Paragraph(left_item.name, self.styles['TableCell']),
                    Paragraph(left_status, self.styles['TableCell']),
                    Paragraph(right_item.name if right_item else "", self.styles['TableCell']),
                    Paragraph(right_status, self.styles['TableCell']),
                ]
                packing_data.append(row)
            
            packing_table = Table(packing_data, colWidths=[4.5 * cm, 0.7 * cm, 4.5 * cm, 0.7 * cm])
            packing_table.setStyle(TableStyle([
                ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
                ('BACKGROUND', (0, 1), (-1, -1), colors.white),
                ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, COLOR_GREY_BORDER),
                ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'MIDDLE'),
                ('ALIGN', (1, 0), (1, -1), 'CENTER'),
                ('ALIGN', (3, 0), (3, -1), 'CENTER'),
                ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
                ('RIGHTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
                ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.1 * cm),
                ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.1 * cm),
                ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 9),
            ]))
            
            story.append(packing_table)
        
        return story
    
    # â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    # TRAVEL DOCUMENTS - Compact table
    # â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    
    def _build_documents_section(self) -> List[Flowable]:
        """Build travel documents section."""
        story = []
        
        story.append(Paragraph("Travel Documents", self.styles['SectionHeader']))
        story.append(Spacer(1, 0.2 * cm))
        
        if self.trip.documents:
            docs_data = [
                [
                    Paragraph("<b>Category</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                    Paragraph("<b>Filename</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                    Paragraph("<b>Uploaded</b>", self.styles['TableHeader']),
                ]
            ]
            
            for doc in self.trip.documents:
                upload_date = doc.uploaded_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if doc.uploaded_at else "-"
                docs_data.append([
                    Paragraph(doc.category, self.styles['TableCell']),
                    Paragraph(doc.filename, self.styles['TableCell']),
                    Paragraph(upload_date, self.styles['TableCell']),
                ])
            
            docs_table = Table(docs_data, colWidths=[2.8 * cm, 8.2 * cm, 2.8 * cm])
            docs_table.setStyle(TableStyle([
                ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), COLOR_LIGHT_GREY),
                ('BACKGROUND', (0, 1), (-1, -1), colors.white),
                ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, COLOR_GREY_BORDER),
                ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'MIDDLE'),
                ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.15 * cm),
                ('RIGHTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.15 * cm),
                ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
                ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.12 * cm),
            ]))
            
            story.append(docs_table)
        
        return story

def generate_premium_trip_pdf(trip, user) -> bytes:
    """
    Generate a comprehensive travel itinerary and budget PDF.
    
    Args:
        trip: Trip model instance
        user: User model instance
    
    Returns:
        bytes: PDF file content
    """
    styles = create_styles()
    generator = DetailedTravelItineraryPDF(trip, user, styles)
    return generator.generate()

"""
Validation and quality checking for personalized travel plans.

Checks:
- Structural correctness (day count, numbering, fields)
- Financial soundness (costs non-negative, totals reconcile)
- Requirement coverage (user requirements met)
- Semantic quality (activities relevant to destination, coherent schedule)
"""

from typing import List, Dict, Tuple, Optional
import re
from app.schemas import PersonalizedPlanResponse, PersonalizedPlanValidationResult, Requirement


class PersonalizedPlanValidator:
    """Validates generated personalized plans for quality and correctness."""
    
    # Placeholder words that indicate generic content
    GENERIC_PLACEHOLDERS = [
        "local restaurant", "favorite restaurant", "favorite spot",
        "main attraction", "orientation tour", "scenic viewpoint",
        "last-minute shopping", "explore", "sightseeing", "local market",
        "local lunch", "local food", "local experience", "local area"
    ]
    
    def __init__(self, plan: PersonalizedPlanResponse):
        """Initialize validator with a plan."""
        self.plan = plan
        self.errors: List[str] = []
        self.warnings: List[str] = []
        self.checks_passed: Dict[str, bool] = {}
    
    def validate(self) -> PersonalizedPlanValidationResult:
        """
        Run all validation checks and return overall result.
        
        Returns:
            PersonalizedPlanValidationResult with all check results
        """
        # Structural checks
        self._check_day_count()
        self._check_day_numbering()
        self._check_day_titles()
        self._check_activity_presence()
        
        # Financial checks
        self._check_activity_costs()
        self._check_budget_reconciliation()
        self._check_budget_limit()
        
        # Semantic checks
        self._check_for_placeholders()
        self._check_activity_variety()
        self._check_activity_timing()
        
        # Requirement coverage
        requirements_met, requirements_total = self._check_requirement_coverage()
        
        # Calculate quality scores
        semantic_score = self._calculate_semantic_score()
        feasibility_score = self._calculate_feasibility_score()
        requirement_coverage_score = self._calculate_requirement_coverage_score(requirements_met, requirements_total)
        
        # Determine overall validity
        is_valid = len(self.errors) == 0
        
        # Calculate composite score (0-100)
        composite_score = (semantic_score + feasibility_score + requirement_coverage_score) / 3.0 if is_valid else 0.0
        
        return PersonalizedPlanValidationResult(
            is_valid=is_valid,
            score=composite_score,
            errors=self.errors,
            warnings=self.warnings,
            checks_passed=self.checks_passed,
            requirements_met=requirements_met,
            requirements_total=requirements_total,
            semantic_score=semantic_score,
            feasibility_score=feasibility_score,
            requirement_coverage_score=requirement_coverage_score,
        )
    
    # ========== STRUCTURAL CHECKS ==========
    
    def _check_day_count(self) -> None:
        """Check that the number of days matches the requested duration."""
        expected = self.plan.num_days
        actual = len(self.plan.days)
        
        if actual != expected:
            self.errors.append(f"Day count mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual}")
            self.checks_passed["day_count"] = False
        else:
            self.checks_passed["day_count"] = True
    
    def _check_day_numbering(self) -> None:
        """Check that days are numbered 1, 2, 3, ... without gaps or duplicates."""
        day_numbers = [day.day_number for day in self.plan.days]
        
        # Check for duplicates
        if len(day_numbers) != len(set(day_numbers)):
            self.errors.append("Duplicate day numbers found")
            self.checks_passed["day_numbering"] = False
            return
        
        # Check for continuous sequence starting from 1
        expected_numbers = list(range(1, self.plan.num_days + 1))
        if day_numbers != expected_numbers:
            self.errors.append(f"Day numbering not continuous: got {day_numbers}, expected {expected_numbers}")
            self.checks_passed["day_numbering"] = False
        else:
            self.checks_passed["day_numbering"] = True
    
    def _check_day_titles(self) -> None:
        """Check that day titles are unique and not generic."""
        titles = [day.title for day in self.plan.days]
        
        # Check for duplicates
        if len(titles) != len(set(titles)):
            self.errors.append("Duplicate day titles found")
            self.checks_passed["day_titles"] = False
            return
        
        # Check for generic titles (e.g., "Day 1 - Day 1", "DAY 01 - Day 1")
        generic_count = 0
        for title in titles:
            if re.search(r"day\s+\d+.*day\s+\d+|DAY\s+\d+.*DAY\s+\d+", title, re.IGNORECASE):
                generic_count += 1
                self.warnings.append(f"Generic title format: '{title}'")
        
        if generic_count > 0:
            self.checks_passed["day_titles"] = False
        else:
            self.checks_passed["day_titles"] = True
    
    def _check_activity_presence(self) -> None:
        """Check that each day has activities."""
        days_without_activities = [day.day_number for day in self.plan.days if not day.activities]
        
        if days_without_activities:
            self.errors.append(f"Days without activities: {days_without_activities}")
            self.checks_passed["activity_presence"] = False
        else:
            self.checks_passed["activity_presence"] = True
    
    # ========== FINANCIAL CHECKS ==========
    
    def _check_activity_costs(self) -> None:
        """Check that all activity costs are non-negative."""
        negative_activities = []
        
        for day in self.plan.days:
            for activity in day.activities:
                if activity.cost < 0:
                    negative_activities.append({
                        "day": day.day_number,
                        "activity": activity.title,
                        "cost": activity.cost
                    })
        
        if negative_activities:
            self.errors.append(f"Negative activity costs found: {negative_activities}")
            self.checks_passed["activity_costs"] = False
        else:
            self.checks_passed["activity_costs"] = True
    
    def _check_budget_reconciliation(self) -> None:
        """Check that daily totals and breakdown reconcile with estimated total."""
        # Sum all activity costs
        total_activity_costs = 0.0
        for day in self.plan.days:
            for activity in day.activities:
                total_activity_costs += activity.cost
        
        # Compare with estimated_total_cost
        tolerance = max(self.plan.budget_limit * 0.02, 100.0)  # 2% or Rs. 100
        
        if abs(total_activity_costs - self.plan.estimated_total_cost) > tolerance:
            self.warnings.append(
                f"Activity costs (Rs. {total_activity_costs:.2f}) differ from estimated total "
                f"(Rs. {self.plan.estimated_total_cost:.2f}) by more than tolerance (Rs. {tolerance:.2f})"
            )
        
        # Check budget breakdown sums correctly
        breakdown = self.plan.budget_breakdown
        breakdown_total = (
            breakdown.accommodation_per_night * self.plan.num_days +
            breakdown.food_per_day * self.plan.num_days +
            breakdown.activities_per_day * self.plan.num_days +
            breakdown.transport +
            breakdown.contingency
        )
        
        if abs(breakdown_total - self.plan.estimated_total_cost) > tolerance:
            self.errors.append(
                f"Budget breakdown (Rs. {breakdown_total:.2f}) doesn't match estimated total "
                f"(Rs. {self.plan.estimated_total_cost:.2f})"
            )
            self.checks_passed["budget_reconciliation"] = False
        else:
            self.checks_passed["budget_reconciliation"] = True
    
    def _check_budget_limit(self) -> None:
        """Check that estimated total does not exceed budget limit."""
        if self.plan.estimated_total_cost > self.plan.budget_limit:
            self.errors.append(
                f"Estimated total (Rs. {self.plan.estimated_total_cost:.2f}) exceeds budget limit "
                f"(Rs. {self.plan.budget_limit:.2f})"
            )
            self.checks_passed["budget_limit"] = False
        else:
            self.checks_passed["budget_limit"] = True
    
    # ========== SEMANTIC CHECKS ==========
    
    def _check_for_placeholders(self) -> None:
        """Check for generic placeholder text in activities."""
        placeholder_count = 0
        
        for day in self.plan.days:
            for activity in day.activities:
                title_lower = activity.title.lower()
                location_lower = (activity.location or "").lower()
                description_lower = activity.description.lower()
                
                for placeholder in self.GENERIC_PLACEHOLDERS:
                    if placeholder in title_lower or placeholder in location_lower or placeholder in description_lower:
                        placeholder_count += 1
                        self.warnings.append(f"Generic placeholder '{placeholder}' found in: {activity.title}")
        
        if placeholder_count > (self.plan.num_days * 2):  # Allow some generic text
            self.checks_passed["placeholder_check"] = False
        else:
            self.checks_passed["placeholder_check"] = True
    
    def _check_activity_variety(self) -> None:
        """Check that activities vary across days (no repetitive templates)."""
        # Collect activity titles
        all_titles = []
        for day in self.plan.days:
            for activity in day.activities:
                all_titles.append(activity.title.lower())
        
        # Check if more than 50% are similar/duplicated
        unique_ratio = len(set(all_titles)) / len(all_titles) if all_titles else 1.0
        
        if unique_ratio < 0.7:  # Less than 70% unique
            self.warnings.append(f"Low activity variety: only {unique_ratio*100:.0f}% unique titles")
            self.checks_passed["activity_variety"] = False
        else:
            self.checks_passed["activity_variety"] = True
    
    def _check_activity_timing(self) -> None:
        """Check that activity times are coherent and don't overlap."""
        time_sequence = ["morning", "afternoon", "evening"]
        
        for day in self.plan.days:
            day_times = [activity.time.lower() for activity in day.activities]
            
            # Check if times are in logical order
            for i in range(len(day_times) - 1):
                current_idx = time_sequence.index(day_times[i]) if day_times[i] in time_sequence else -1
                next_idx = time_sequence.index(day_times[i + 1]) if day_times[i + 1] in time_sequence else -1
                
                if current_idx > next_idx:
                    self.warnings.append(f"Day {day.day_number}: times not in logical order")
        
        self.checks_passed["activity_timing"] = True  # Non-blocking warning
    
    # ========== REQUIREMENT COVERAGE ==========
    
    def _check_requirement_coverage(self) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        """
        Check if generated plan covers user requirements.
        
        Returns:
            Tuple of (requirements_met, requirements_total)
        """
        if not self.plan.requirements_extracted:
            return (0, 0)
        
        requirements_met = 0
        requirements_total = len(self.plan.requirements_extracted)
        
        # Check each requirement
        for requirement in self.plan.requirements_extracted:
            if self._check_requirement_in_itinerary(requirement):
                requirements_met += 1
                requirement.coverage_status = "covered"
            else:
                if requirement.mandatory:
                    self.errors.append(f"Mandatory requirement not met: {requirement.key}")
                else:
                    self.warnings.append(f"Optional requirement not met: {requirement.key}")
                requirement.coverage_status = "not_covered"
        
        self.checks_passed["requirements"] = (requirements_met == requirements_total)
        return (requirements_met, requirements_total)
    
    def _check_requirement_in_itinerary(self, requirement: Requirement) -> bool:
        """Check if a specific requirement is satisfied in the itinerary."""
        # Convert requirement to searchable terms
        search_terms = self._get_search_terms_for_requirement(requirement)
        
        # Search through all activities and descriptions
        for day in self.plan.days:
            day_text = (day.title + " " + day.description).lower()
            
            for activity in day.activities:
                activity_text = (
                    activity.title + " " +
                    activity.description + " " +
                    (activity.location or "")
                ).lower()
                
                # Check if any search term appears
                for term in search_terms:
                    if term in activity_text or term in day_text:
                        return True
        
        # Also check plan summary
        if self.plan.summary:
            for term in search_terms:
                if term in self.plan.summary.lower():
                    return True
        
        return False
    
    def _get_search_terms_for_requirement(self, requirement: Requirement) -> List[str]:
        """Get searchable terms for a requirement."""
        terms = [requirement.value, requirement.value.replace("_", " ")]
        
        # Add aliases for common cuisine requirements
        if requirement.key == "cuisine:bengali":
            terms.extend(["bengal", "bengali cuisine", "bengali food", "luchi", "fish curry"])
        elif requirement.key == "cuisine:south_indian":
            terms.extend(["south india", "south indian cuisine", "south indian food", "dosa", "idli", "sambar", "spice market"])
        elif requirement.key == "cuisine:north_indian":
            terms.extend(["north india", "north indian cuisine", "north indian food", "biryani", "tandoori", "naan"])
        elif requirement.key == "cuisine:seafood":
            terms.extend(["fish", "prawn", "shrimp", "shellfish", "coastal", "fishing"])
        elif requirement.key == "cuisine:vegetarian":
            terms.extend(["veg", "vegetable", "plant-based", "dal", "paneer"])
        
        # Add aliases for common activity requirements
        elif requirement.key == "activity:river_cruise":
            terms.extend(["river", "cruise", "boat", "hooghly", "ganges", "ferry"])
        elif requirement.key == "activity:trekking":
            terms.extend(["trek", "hike", "hiking", "trail", "mountain", "peak"])
        elif requirement.key == "activity:heritage":
            terms.extend(["heritage", "historic", "monument", "archaeology", "fort", "palace"])
        
        # Add aliases for comfort requirements
        elif requirement.key == "comfort:luxury":
            terms.extend(["luxury", "premium", "upscale", "fancy", "5-star", "deluxe"])
        elif requirement.key == "comfort:budget":
            terms.extend(["budget", "affordable", "economical", "backpack"])
        
        return terms
    
    # ========== SCORING ==========
    
    def _calculate_semantic_score(self) -> float:
        """Calculate semantic quality score (0-100)."""
        if not self.checks_passed.get("placeholder_check", True):
            return 40.0
        if not self.checks_passed.get("activity_variety", True):
            return 50.0
        if not self.checks_passed.get("day_titles", True):
            return 60.0
        return 85.0
    
    def _calculate_feasibility_score(self) -> float:
        """Calculate feasibility/structural score (0-100)."""
        score = 100.0
        
        if not self.checks_passed.get("day_count", True):
            score -= 20
        if not self.checks_passed.get("day_numbering", True):
            score -= 15
        if not self.checks_passed.get("activity_timing", True):
            score -= 5
        if not self.checks_passed.get("activity_presence", True):
            score -= 20
        
        return max(0.0, score)
    
    def _calculate_requirement_coverage_score(self, met: int, total: int) -> float:
        """Calculate requirement coverage score (0-100)."""
        if total == 0:
            return 100.0  # No requirements, so full score
        return (met / total) * 100.0

"""
Requirement extractor for personalized travel planning.

Converts unstructured user input (special/preferences field) into structured requirements.
"""

from typing import List, Dict, Tuple
import re
from app.schemas import Requirement


class RequirementExtractor:
    """
    Extracts and parses user requirements from free-form text.
    
    Maps user input to structured requirements and provides activity templates
    that satisfy those requirements.
    """
    
    # Mapping of keywords to structured requirement keys
    CUISINE_KEYWORDS = {
        "bengali": "cuisine:bengali",
        "south indian": "cuisine:south_indian",
        "north indian": "cuisine:north_indian",
        "chinese": "cuisine:chinese",
        "continental": "cuisine:continental",
        "seafood": "cuisine:seafood",
        "vegetarian": "cuisine:vegetarian",
        "vegan": "cuisine:vegan",
        "thai": "cuisine:thai",
        "mexican": "cuisine:mexican",
        "italian": "cuisine:italian",
        "japanese": "cuisine:japanese",
        "non-vegetarian": "cuisine:non_vegetarian",
        "meat": "cuisine:meat",
    }
    
    COMFORT_KEYWORDS = {
        "luxury": "comfort:luxury",
        "premium": "comfort:premium",
        "fancy": "comfort:luxury",
        "upscale": "comfort:premium",
        "deluxe": "comfort:luxury",
        "budget": "comfort:budget",
        "budget travel": "comfort:budget",
        "backpacker": "comfort:budget",
        "mid-range": "comfort:mid_range",
        "comfortable": "comfort:mid_range",
    }
    
    ACTIVITY_KEYWORDS = {
        "river cruise": "activity:river_cruise",
        "water sports": "activity:water_sports",
        "trekking": "activity:trekking",
        "hiking": "activity:hiking",
        "adventure": "activity:adventure",
        "beach": "activity:beach",
        "heritage": "activity:heritage",
        "museums": "activity:museums",
        "shopping": "activity:shopping",
        "nightlife": "activity:nightlife",
        "spa": "activity:spa",
        "yoga": "activity:yoga",
        "meditation": "activity:meditation",
        "cooking class": "activity:cooking_class",
        "cultural": "activity:cultural",
    }
    
    TRAVEL_STYLE_KEYWORDS = {
        "delicious food": "travel_style:food_lover",
        "food lover": "travel_style:food_lover",
        "culinary": "travel_style:food_lover",
        "fancy travel": "travel_style:luxury_travel",
        "adventure travel": "travel_style:adventure",
        "cultural tour": "travel_style:cultural",
        "solo travel": "travel_style:solo",
        "family": "travel_style:family",
        "couple": "travel_style:romantic",
        "romantic": "travel_style:romantic",
        "group travel": "travel_style:group",
    }
    
    OTHER_KEYWORDS = {
        "slow travel": "pace:slow",
        "fast-paced": "pace:fast",
        "off-season": "timing:off_season",
        "peak season": "timing:peak_season",
    }
    
    def __init__(self):
        """Initialize extractor with all keyword mappings."""
        self.all_keywords = {
            **self.CUISINE_KEYWORDS,
            **self.COMFORT_KEYWORDS,
            **self.ACTIVITY_KEYWORDS,
            **self.TRAVEL_STYLE_KEYWORDS,
            **self.OTHER_KEYWORDS,
        }
    
    def extract(self, text: str) -> List[Requirement]:
        """
        Extract structured requirements from user input text.
        
        Args:
            text: User's free-form preference/special requirements text
            
        Returns:
            List of Requirement objects
        """
        if not text or not text.strip():
            return []
        
        requirements: List[Requirement] = []
        text_lower = text.lower().strip()
        
        # Track which phrases we've matched to avoid duplicates
        matched_phrases: Dict[str, bool] = {}
        
        # Check each keyword phrase (longest first to avoid partial matches)
        for phrase in sorted(self.all_keywords.keys(), key=len, reverse=True):
            if phrase in text_lower and phrase not in matched_phrases:
                # Extract the requirement key
                req_key = self.all_keywords[phrase]
                category, value = req_key.split(":", 1)
                
                # Determine if this is a mandatory or optional requirement
                # Heuristic: if user explicitly says "please", "must", "need", it's mandatory
                mandatory = self._is_mandatory(text_lower, phrase)
                
                # Check if this requirement is already in the list (avoid duplicates within same category)
                existing = next((r for r in requirements if r.category == category), None)
                if not existing:
                    requirements.append(Requirement(
                        key=req_key,
                        value=value,
                        category=category,
                        mandatory=mandatory,
                        coverage_status=None
                    ))
                
                matched_phrases[phrase] = True
        
        return requirements
    
    def get_activity_hints(self, requirements: List[Requirement]) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
        """
        Generate activity suggestions based on extracted requirements.
        
        Returns: {
            "cuisine": ["Bengali restaurant", "Fish curry", ...],
            "activity": ["River cruise", "Heritage tour", ...],
            "comfort": ["Luxury hotel", "Premium transport", ...],
            ...
        }
        """
        hints: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        
        for req in requirements:
            category = req.category
            value = req.value
            
            if category not in hints:
                hints[category] = []
            
            # Map requirements to specific activity suggestions
            if category == 'cuisine':
                suggestions = self._get_cuisine_activities(value)
            elif category == 'activity':
                suggestions = self._get_activity_suggestions(value)
            elif category == 'comfort':
                suggestions = self._get_comfort_activities(value)
            elif category == 'travel_style':
                suggestions = self._get_travel_style_activities(value)
            else:
                suggestions = []
            
            hints[category].extend(suggestions)
        
        return hints
    
    def _get_cuisine_activities(self, cuisine: str) -> List[str]:
        """Generate dining/activity suggestions for a cuisine."""
        cuisine_map = {
            'bengali': ['Breakfast with luchi-alur dom', 'Fish curry tasting', 'Bengali sweets workshop', 'River fish market visit'],
            'seafood': ['Seafood restaurant visit', 'Fish market tour', 'Coastal fishing community', 'Seafood cooking class'],
            'vegetarian': ['Vegetarian restaurant', 'Temple food experience', 'Organic market visit', 'Vegetarian cooking class'],
            'north_indian': ['North Indian restaurant', 'Street food tour', 'Food market exploration'],
            'south_indian': ['South Indian restaurant', 'Spice market visit', 'Dosa tasting'],
        }
        return cuisine_map.get(cuisine, [f'{cuisine.replace("_", " ").title()} dining experience'])
    
    def _get_activity_suggestions(self, activity: str) -> List[str]:
        """Generate activity suggestions."""
        activity_map = {
            'river_cruise': ['Sunset river cruise', 'Morning river tour', 'Boat ride with breakfast'],
            'trekking': ['Day trek', 'Guided mountain hike', 'Peak sunrise trek'],
            'beach': ['Beach time', 'Beach walk', 'Beach sunset activity'],
            'heritage': ['Heritage walk', 'Historical site visit', 'Architecture tour'],
            'shopping': ['Local market exploration', 'Artisan shopping', 'Street shopping'],
        }
        return activity_map.get(activity, [f'{activity.replace("_", " ").title()} experience'])
    
    def _get_comfort_activities(self, comfort: str) -> List[str]:
        """Generate comfort level activity suggestions."""
        comfort_map = {
            'luxury': ['5-star dining', 'Spa and wellness', 'Premium hotel stay'],
            'budget': ['Street food experience', 'Budget-friendly restaurants', 'Local transit'],
            'mid_range': ['Mid-range dining', 'Comfortable hotel', 'Organized tours'],
        }
        return comfort_map.get(comfort, [])
    
    def _get_travel_style_activities(self, style: str) -> List[str]:
        """Generate travel style activity suggestions."""
        style_map = {
            'food_lover': ['Food market tour', 'Restaurant hopping', 'Street food tasting', 'Cooking class'],
            'adventure': ['Outdoor activities', 'Trekking', 'Water sports', 'Adventure tour'],
            'cultural': ['Museum visits', 'Temple tours', 'Cultural performances', 'Local community visits'],
            'luxury_travel': ['Premium accommodations', 'Fine dining', 'Private transport'],
            'family': ['Family-friendly attractions', 'Parks', 'Educational activities'],
        }
        return style_map.get(style, [])
    
    
    def _is_mandatory(self, text: str, phrase: str) -> bool:
        """
        Determine if a requirement is mandatory based on context.
        
        Args:
            text: The full text (lowercase)
            phrase: The requirement phrase that was matched
            
        Returns:
            True if requirement appears mandatory, False if optional
        """
        # Find the phrase in the text
        idx = text.find(phrase)
        if idx < 0:
            return True  # Default to mandatory
        
        # Look at surrounding context (50 chars before and after)
        context_start = max(0, idx - 50)
        context = text[context_start:idx + len(phrase) + 50]
        
        # Mandatory indicators
        mandatory_words = ["must", "need", "require", "essential", "important", "cannot miss"]
        for word in mandatory_words:
            if word in context:
                return True
        
        # Optional indicators
        optional_words = ["prefer", "like", "enjoy", "interested", "would like", "possibly"]
        for word in optional_words:
            if word in context:
                return False
        
        # Default to mandatory for explicit requirements
        return True
    
    def format_for_prompt(self, requirements: List[Requirement]) -> str:
        """
        Format extracted requirements for inclusion in LLM prompt.
        
        Args:
            requirements: List of extracted requirements
            
        Returns:
            Formatted requirement string for prompt
        """
        if not requirements:
            return "No specific requirements"
        
        mandatory = [r for r in requirements if r.mandatory]
        optional = [r for r in requirements if not r.mandatory]
        
        lines = []
        if mandatory:
            lines.append("MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS (must be included):")
            for req in mandatory:
                lines.append(f"  - {req.category.upper()}: {req.value.replace('_', ' ')}")
        
        if optional:
            lines.append("OPTIONAL PREFERENCES (include if feasible):")
            for req in optional:
                lines.append(f"  - {req.category.upper()}: {req.value.replace('_', ' ')}")
        
        return "\n".join(lines)


def extract_requirements(text: str) -> List[Requirement]:
    """Convenience function to extract requirements from text."""
    extractor = RequirementExtractor()
    return extractor.extract(text)


def format_requirements_for_prompt(text: str) -> str:
    """Convenience function to format requirements for prompt."""
    extractor = RequirementExtractor()
    requirements = extractor.extract(text)
    return extractor.format_for_prompt(requirements)

"""

Provides realistic transport modes, durations, and costs for Indian city pairs.

from typing import Dict, List, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class TransferOption:

def get_transfer_options(origin: str, destination: str) -> List[TransferOption]:
    """
    Get available transport options between two cities.
    
    Args:
        origin: City name (case-insensitive)
        destination: City name (case-insensitive)
    
    Returns:
        List of TransferOption objects sorted by recommended order
    """
    origin_normalized = origin.lower().strip()
    dest_normalized = destination.lower().strip()
    
    # Direct match
    key = (origin_normalized, dest_normalized)
    if key in TRANSFER_ROUTES:
        options = TRANSFER_ROUTES[key]
        # Sort by recommended order: train first, then bus, then flight
        order = {"train": 0, "bus": 1, "car": 2, "flight": 3}
        return sorted(options, key=lambda x: order.get(x.mode, 99))
    
    # No data available
    return []


def estimate_transfer(origin: str, destination: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, any]]:
    """
    Estimate the most recommended transfer option between cities.
    
    Returns:
        Dictionary with mode, duration_hours, cost_per_person, and notes
        Or None if route is not in database
    """
    options = get_transfer_options(origin, destination)
    
    if not options:
        return None
    
    # Return the first (recommended) option
    opt = options[0]
    return {
        "mode": opt.mode,
        "duration_hours": opt.duration_hours,
        "duration_display": f"{opt.duration_hours:.1f} hours" if opt.duration_hours < 10 else f"{int(opt.duration_hours // 24)} days" if opt.duration_hours >= 24 else f"{opt.duration_hours:.1f} hours",
        "cost_per_person": opt.approximate_cost_per_person,
        "frequency": opt.frequency,
        "comfort_level": opt.comfort_level,
        "notes": opt.notes,
        "all_options": [
            {
                "mode": o.mode,
                "duration_hours": o.duration_hours,
                "cost_per_person": o.approximate_cost_per_person,
                "frequency": o.frequency,
                "comfort_level": o.comfort_level,
            }
            for o in options
        ]
    }


def estimate_transfer_cost(origin: str, destination: str, num_travelers: int = 1) -> Optional[float]:
    """
    Estimate total transfer cost for a group.
    """
    transfer = estimate_transfer(origin, destination)
    if not transfer:
        return None
    return transfer["cost_per_person"] * num_travelers

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js

        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],

])
```

"""
Fix CompareDestinations.tsx encoding and score display issues
"""

import re

# Read the file
with open('src/pages/CompareDestinations.tsx', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Fix 1: Replace corrupted arrow characters with proper Unicode
content = content.replace('Ã¢â€ Â³', 'â†³')

# Fix 2: Replace empty quote marks with em dash
content = content.replace('""', 'â€”')

# Fix 3: Fix score displays (multiply by 100 for percentages)
# Find patterns like: plans[idx].breakdown.budget_compatibility}%
score_patterns = [
    (r'plans\[idx\]\.breakdown\.budget_compatibility\}%',
     'Math.round(plans[idx].breakdown.budget_compatibility * 100)}%'),
    (r'plans\[idx\]\.breakdown\.trip_type_match\}%',
     'Math.round(plans[idx].breakdown.trip_type_match * 100)}%'),
    (r'plans\[idx\]\.breakdown\.comfort_match\}%',
     'Math.round(plans[idx].breakdown.comfort_match * 100)}%'),
    (r'plans\[idx\]\.breakdown\.duration_suitability\}%',
     'Math.round(plans[idx].breakdown.duration_suitability * 100)}%'),
]

for pattern, replacement in score_patterns:
    content = re.sub(pattern, replacement, content)

# Fix 4: Fix value_score display (already 0-100, just needs to be rounded)
content = re.sub(
    r'plans\[idx\]\.value_score\.toFixed\(1\)',
    'Math.round(plans[idx].value_score)',
    content
)

# Write back
with open('src/pages/CompareDestinations.tsx', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("âœ… Fixed CompareDestinations.tsx:")
print("  - Replaced corrupted arrow characters (Ã¢â€ Â³ â†’ â†³)")
print("  - Replaced empty quote marks ("" â†’ â€”)")
print("  - Fixed score display formatting (0.9 â†’ 90%)")
print("  - Rounded value_score display")

import React, { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from './context/AuthContext';
import { Layout } from './components/Layout';
import { Loader } from 'lucide-react';

// Dynamic lazy page imports for optimized code-splitting (Phase 4 Performance)
const LandingPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/LandingPage').then(m => ({ default: m.LandingPage })));
const Login = lazy(() => import('./pages/Login').then(m => ({ default: m.Login })));
const Register = lazy(() => import('./pages/Register').then(m => ({ default: m.Register })));
const Dashboard = lazy(() => import('./pages/Dashboard').then(m => ({ default: m.Dashboard })));
const BudgetPlanner = lazy(() => import('./pages/BudgetPlanner').then(m => ({ default: m.BudgetPlanner })));
const DestinationExplorer = lazy(() => import('./pages/DestinationExplorer').then(m => ({ default: m.DestinationExplorer })));
const DestinationDetail = lazy(() => import('./pages/DestinationDetail').then(m => ({ default: m.DestinationDetail })));
const BudgetOptimizer = lazy(() => import('./pages/BudgetOptimizer').then(m => ({ default: m.BudgetOptimizer })));
const ExpenseTracker = lazy(() => import('./pages/ExpenseTracker').then(m => ({ default: m.ExpenseTracker })));
const AICompanion = lazy(() => import('./pages/AICompanion').then(m => ({ default: m.AICompanion })));
const SavedTrips = lazy(() => import('./pages/SavedTrips').then(m => ({ default: m.SavedTrips })));
const CompareDestinations = lazy(() => import('./pages/CompareDestinations').then(m => ({ default: m.CompareDestinations })));
const SharedTripView = lazy(() => import('./pages/SharedTripView').then(m => ({ default: m.SharedTripView })));
const NotificationsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/NotificationsPage').then(m => ({ default: m.NotificationsPage })));
const UserProfilePage = lazy(() => import('./pages/UserProfilePage').then(m => ({ default: m.UserProfilePage })));
const AdminAnalyticsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/AdminAnalyticsPage').then(m => ({ default: m.AdminAnalyticsPage })));
const MultiStopPlanner = lazy(() => import('./pages/MultiStopPlanner').then(m => ({ default: m.MultiStopPlanner })));
const CurrencyConverter = lazy(() => import('./pages/CurrencyConverter').then(m => ({ default: m.CurrencyConverter })));

// Loading Spinner Indicator (Phase 3 Loader State)
const RouteFallbackLoader = () => (
  <div className="min-h-screen bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-paper-900 dark:text-paper-100 gap-4">
    <Loader className="h-10 w-10 text-marigold-700 animate-spin" />
    <span className="text-sm font-bold tracking-wider text-paper-400 uppercase">Synchronizing BudgetBound...</span>
  </div>
);

// Protected Route Wrapper Component
const ProtectedRoute: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const { isAuthenticated, loading } = useAuth();

  if (loading) {
    return <RouteFallbackLoader />;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  return <Layout>{children}</Layout>;
};

// Anonymous Route Wrapper Component (Redirects to dashboard if already logged in)
const AnonymousRoute: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const { isAuthenticated, loading } = useAuth();

  if (loading) {
    return <RouteFallbackLoader />;
  }

  if (isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
};

function App() {
  return (
    <AuthProvider>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <Suspense fallback={<RouteFallbackLoader />}>
          <Routes>
            {/* Public / Auth Routes */}
            <Route path="/" element={<AnonymousRoute><LandingPage /></AnonymousRoute>} />
            <Route path="/login" element={<AnonymousRoute><Login /></AnonymousRoute>} />
            <Route path="/register" element={<AnonymousRoute><Register /></AnonymousRoute>} />

            {/* Protected Dashboard/App Routes */}
            <Route path="/dashboard" element={<ProtectedRoute><Dashboard /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/planner" element={<ProtectedRoute><BudgetPlanner /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/my-trips" element={<ProtectedRoute><SavedTrips /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/compare" element={<ProtectedRoute><CompareDestinations /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/reverse-search" element={<ProtectedRoute><BudgetPlanner initialMode="discover" /></ProtectedRoute>} />

            <Route path="/explorer" element={<ProtectedRoute><DestinationExplorer /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/explorer/:id" element={<ProtectedRoute><DestinationDetail /></ProtectedRoute>} />

            <Route path="/optimizer/:tripId" element={<ProtectedRoute><BudgetOptimizer /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/expenses/:tripId" element={<ProtectedRoute><ExpenseTracker /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/ai-companion" element={<ProtectedRoute><AICompanion /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/multi-stop" element={<ProtectedRoute><MultiStopPlanner /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/currency-converter" element={<ProtectedRoute><CurrencyConverter /></ProtectedRoute>} />

            <Route path="/notifications" element={<ProtectedRoute><NotificationsPage /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/profile" element={<ProtectedRoute><UserProfilePage /></ProtectedRoute>} />
            <Route path="/admin" element={<ProtectedRoute><AdminAnalyticsPage /></ProtectedRoute>} />

            {/* Public Shared Trip Route */}
            <Route path="/share/:shareToken" element={<SharedTripView />} />

            {/* Catch-all route */}
            <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
          </Routes>
        </Suspense>
      </BrowserRouter>
    </AuthProvider>
  );
}

export default App;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Sliders, RefreshCw, Save, Check } from 'lucide-react';

interface AllocationData {
  transport_cost: number;
  hotel_cost: number;
  food_cost: number;
  activities_cost: number;
  emergency_reserve: number;
  local_transport_cost?: number;
  taxes_fees_cost?: number;
}

interface BudgetAllocationEditorProps {
  budget: number;
  initialAllocations: AllocationData;
  onSave: (updatedAllocations: AllocationData, isCustom: boolean) => void;
  onReset?: () => void;
  isSaving?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const BudgetAllocationEditor: React.FC<BudgetAllocationEditorProps> = ({
  budget,
  initialAllocations,
  onSave,
  onReset,
  isSaving = false,
  className = '',
}) => {
  // 5 main categories
  const [transportPercent, setTransportPercent] = useState(0);
  const [accommodationPercent, setAccommodationPercent] = useState(0);
  const [foodPercent, setFoodPercent] = useState(0);
  const [activitiesPercent, setActivitiesPercent] = useState(0);
  const [emergencyPercent, setEmergencyPercent] = useState(0);

  const [isCustomMode, setIsCustomMode] = useState(false);
  const [saveSuccess, setSaveSuccess] = useState(false);

  // Grouped recommended values helper
  const getGroupedRecommended = () => {
    const t = initialAllocations.transport_cost + (initialAllocations.local_transport_cost || 0);
    const a = initialAllocations.hotel_cost;
    const f = initialAllocations.food_cost;
    const ac = initialAllocations.activities_cost;
    const e = initialAllocations.emergency_reserve + (initialAllocations.taxes_fees_cost || 0);
    const sum = t + a + f + ac + e;
    return { t, a, f, ac, e, sum };
  };

  const syncSlidersWithProps = () => {
    const { t, a, f, ac, e, sum } = getGroupedRecommended();
    
    // If it's a custom allocation or we want to normalize it to 100% of the budget
    const denominator = isCustomMode ? budget : sum;
    const safeDenominator = denominator || 1;

    setTransportPercent((t / safeDenominator) * 100);
    setAccommodationPercent((a / safeDenominator) * 100);
    setFoodPercent((f / safeDenominator) * 100);
    setActivitiesPercent((ac / safeDenominator) * 100);
    setEmergencyPercent((e / safeDenominator) * 100);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    syncSlidersWithProps();
  }, [initialAllocations, isCustomMode, budget]);

  const getPercentagesMap = () => {
    return {
      transport: transportPercent,
      accommodation: accommodationPercent,
      food: foodPercent,
      activities: activitiesPercent,
      emergency: emergencyPercent,
    };
  };

  const handleSliderChange = (key: string, newValue: number) => {
    if (!isCustomMode) {
      // Switch to custom mode first, which normalizes recommended to 100% of the budget
      setIsCustomMode(true);
      return;
    }

    const percentages = getPercentagesMap();
    const oldValue = percentages[key as keyof typeof percentages];
    const diff = newValue - oldValue;

    const otherKeys = Object.keys(percentages).filter((k) => k !== key);
    const sumOthers = otherKeys.reduce(
      (sum, k) => sum + percentages[k as keyof typeof percentages],
      0
    );

    const updated = { ...percentages, [key]: newValue };

    if (sumOthers > 0) {
      otherKeys.forEach((k) => {
        const val = percentages[k as keyof typeof percentages];
        const delta = diff * (val / sumOthers);
        updated[k as keyof typeof percentages] = Math.max(0, val - delta);
      });
    } else {
      otherKeys.forEach((k) => {
        updated[k as keyof typeof percentages] = Math.max(
          0,
          (100 - newValue) / otherKeys.length
        );
      });
    }

    // Normalize to ensure total is exactly 100%
    const totalSum = Object.values(updated).reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0);
    if (Math.abs(totalSum - 100) > 0.01) {
      const error = 100 - totalSum;
      const adjustKey = otherKeys[0];
      updated[adjustKey as keyof typeof percentages] = Math.max(
        0,
        updated[adjustKey as keyof typeof percentages] + error
      );
    }

    setTransportPercent(updated.transport);
    setAccommodationPercent(updated.accommodation);
    setFoodPercent(updated.food);
    setActivitiesPercent(updated.activities);
    setEmergencyPercent(updated.emergency);
  };

  // Recalculated values for preview display
  const currentDenominator = isCustomMode ? budget : getGroupedRecommended().sum;
  const currentTotal = isCustomMode ? budget : getGroupedRecommended().sum;

  const previewTransport = (transportPercent / 100) * currentDenominator;
  const previewAccommodation = (accommodationPercent / 100) * currentDenominator;
  const previewFood = (foodPercent / 100) * currentDenominator;
  const previewActivities = (activitiesPercent / 100) * currentDenominator;
  const previewEmergency = (emergencyPercent / 100) * currentDenominator;

  const currentSumPercent =
    transportPercent +
    accommodationPercent +
    foodPercent +
    activitiesPercent +
    emergencyPercent;

  const handleSave = () => {
    const updated: AllocationData = {
      transport_cost: previewTransport,
      hotel_cost: previewAccommodation,
      food_cost: previewFood,
      activities_cost: previewActivities,
      emergency_reserve: previewEmergency,
      local_transport_cost: 0.0, // merged
      taxes_fees_cost: 0.0, // merged
    };
    onSave(updated, isCustomMode);
    setSaveSuccess(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaveSuccess(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleResetClick = () => {
    setIsCustomMode(false);
    if (onReset) {
      onReset();
    }
  };

  const sliderClass = "w-full h-2 bg-paper-200 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-marigold-600 focus:outline-none disabled:opacity-50";

  return (
    <div className={`bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-6 ${className}`}>
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700 pb-4">
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Sliders className="text-marigold-500" size={18} />
            Budget Allocation Editor
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 mt-0.5">
            Manually customize how your trip budget is distributed
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase">
            Mode:
          </span>
          <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
            isCustomMode 
              ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400' 
              : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400'
          }`}>
            {isCustomMode ? 'Custom' : 'Recommended'}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sliders Container */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {[
          { key: 'transport', label: 'Transportation', value: transportPercent, cost: previewTransport, color: 'accent-blue-500' },
          { key: 'accommodation', label: 'Accommodation', value: accommodationPercent, cost: previewAccommodation, color: 'accent-marigold-500' },
          { key: 'food', label: 'Food & Dining', value: foodPercent, cost: previewFood, color: 'accent-emerald-500' },
          { key: 'activities', label: 'Activities', value: activitiesPercent, cost: previewActivities, color: 'accent-pink-500' },
          { key: 'emergency', label: 'Emergency Reserve', value: emergencyPercent, cost: previewEmergency, color: 'accent-amber-500' },
        ].map((slider) => (
          <div key={slider.key} className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-300">
              <span>{slider.label}</span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-paper-400 dark:text-paper-500">{slider.value.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                <span className="text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{slider.cost.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="0"
              max="100"
              step="0.1"
              value={slider.value}
              onChange={(e) => handleSliderChange(slider.key, parseFloat(e.target.value))}
              onClick={() => {
                if (!isCustomMode) {
                  // Initialize custom mode by locking to budget and scaling
                  setIsCustomMode(true);
                }
              }}
              className={`${sliderClass} ${slider.color}`}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Total Verification */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900/50 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-800 text-xs font-bold">
        <span className="text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400">Total Allocations</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className={Math.abs(currentSumPercent - 100) < 0.1 ? "text-emerald-500" : "text-rose-500"}>
            {currentSumPercent.toFixed(0)}%
          </span>
          <span className="text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
            â‚¹{currentTotal.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Action Buttons */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleResetClick}
          disabled={!isCustomMode}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-paper-500 hover:text-paper-800 dark:text-paper-400 dark:hover:text-white disabled:opacity-40 transition-colors"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={13} />
          Reset to Recommended
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleSave}
          disabled={isSaving || (isCustomMode && Math.abs(currentSumPercent - 100) > 0.5)}
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-marigold-600 to-petrol-600 hover:from-marigold-500 hover:to-petrol-500 text-white font-bold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {isSaving ? (
            'Saving...'
          ) : saveSuccess ? (
            <>
              <Check size={14} />
              Saved!
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Save size={14} />
              Save Custom Allocation
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

interface BudgetHealthMeterProps {
  budget: number;
  estimatedCost: number;
  actualExpenses?: number;
  className?: string;
}

export const BudgetHealthMeter: React.FC<BudgetHealthMeterProps> = ({
  budget,
  estimatedCost,
  actualExpenses,
  className = '',
}) => {
  const isActualAvailable = typeof actualExpenses === 'number' && actualExpenses > 0;
  const currentSpent = isActualAvailable ? actualExpenses : estimatedCost;
  
  // Prevent division by zero
  const safeBudget = budget || 1;
  const percentage = (currentSpent / safeBudget) * 100;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, budget - currentSpent);

  // Status colors & messages
  let statusColor = 'text-emerald-500';
  let progressColor = 'stroke-emerald-500';
  let bgColor = 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20';
  let borderColor = 'border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/30';
  let message = 'Excellent budget health';

  if (percentage >= 90 && percentage < 100) {
    statusColor = 'text-amber-500';
    progressColor = 'stroke-amber-500';
    bgColor = 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20';
    borderColor = 'border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/30';
    message = 'Approaching budget limit';
  } else if (percentage >= 100) {
    statusColor = 'text-rose-500';
    progressColor = 'stroke-rose-500';
    bgColor = 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/20';
    borderColor = 'border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/30';
    message = 'Budget exceeded';
  } else if (percentage >= 80) {
    statusColor = 'text-amber-500';
    progressColor = 'stroke-amber-500';
    bgColor = 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20';
    borderColor = 'border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/30';
    message = 'Good budget utilization';
  }

  // SVG Circular math
  const radius = 40;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const strokeDashoffset = circumference - (Math.min(100, percentage) / 100) * circumference;

  return (
    <div className={`p-6 rounded-2xl border ${bgColor} ${borderColor} flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-6 shadow-sm transition-all ${className}`}>
      
      {/* Circular Progress Gauge */}
      <div className="relative w-28 h-28 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">
        <svg className="w-full h-full -rotate-90">
          {/* Background Circle */}
          <circle
            cx="56"
            cy="56"
            r={radius}
            className="stroke-paper-200 dark:stroke-paper-700 fill-none"
            strokeWidth="8"
          />
          {/* Progress Circle */}
          <circle
            cx="56"
            cy="56"
            r={radius}
            className={`${progressColor} fill-none transition-all duration-500 ease-out`}
            strokeWidth="8"
            strokeDasharray={circumference}
            strokeDashoffset={strokeDashoffset}
            strokeLinecap="round"
          />
        </svg>
        {/* Inner Text Label */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
          <span className="text-xl font-extrabold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">
            {percentage.toFixed(0)}%
          </span>
          <span className="text-[9px] text-paper-400 dark:text-paper-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
            Used
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Description */}
      <div className="flex-1 space-y-3.5 w-full text-left">
        <div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400 dark:text-paper-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest block">
            Budget Health
          </span>
          <h4 className={`text-base font-extrabold ${statusColor} flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5`}>
            {message}
          </h4>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs">
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <span className="text-paper-400 dark:text-paper-500 font-semibold block">Target Budget</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-300">â‚¹{budget.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <span className="text-paper-400 dark:text-paper-500 font-semibold block">Remaining</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-300">â‚¹{remaining.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <span className="text-paper-400 dark:text-paper-500 font-semibold block">Estimated Cost</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-300">â‚¹{estimatedCost.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>

          {isActualAvailable && (
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <span className="text-paper-400 dark:text-paper-500 font-semibold block">Actual Spent</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-300">â‚¹{actualExpenses.toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
};
