import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import api from '../services/api';
import { 
  FileText, 
  Upload, 
  Download, 
  Trash2, 
  Edit3, 
  Loader, 
  Eye, 
  FolderOpen,
  Calendar,
  Layers,
  X,
  File
} from 'lucide-react';

interface Document {
  id: number;
  trip_id: number;
  category: string;
  filename: string;
  filepath: string;
  filesize: number;
  uploaded_at: string;
}

interface DocumentManagerProps {
  tripId: number;
}

export const DocumentManager: React.FC<DocumentManagerProps> = ({ tripId }) => {
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState<Document[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('Hotel Booking');
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [previewDoc, setPreviewDoc] = useState<Document | null>(null);

  const fetchDocuments = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await api.get(`/api/trips/${tripId}/documents`);
      setDocuments(response.data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load documents:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDocuments();
  }, [tripId]);

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      setSelectedFile(e.target.files[0]);
    }
  };

  const handleUploadSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedFile) return;

    try {
      setUploading(true);
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', selectedFile);
      formData.append('category', category);

      const response = await api.post(`/api/trips/${tripId}/documents`, formData, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' }
      });
      
      setDocuments(prev => [...prev, response.data]);
      setSelectedFile(null);
      
      // Reset input element
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('document-file-input') as HTMLInputElement;
      if (fileInput) fileInput.value = '';

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to upload file:', err);
      alert('Error uploading document. Check size and parameters.');
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRename = async (doc: Document) => {
    const nextName = prompt('Enter a new filename:', doc.filename);
    if (!nextName || !nextName.trim() || nextName === doc.filename) return;

    try {
      const response = await api.put(`/api/trips/${tripId}/documents/${doc.id}`, {
        filename: nextName.trim()
      });
      setDocuments(prev => prev.map(d => d.id === doc.id ? response.data : d));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to rename document.');
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (docId: number) => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this document? This cannot be undone.')) return;

    try {
      await api.delete(`/api/trips/${tripId}/documents/${docId}`);
      setDocuments(prev => prev.filter(d => d.id !== docId));
      if (previewDoc?.id === docId) setPreviewDoc(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to delete document.');
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = (doc: Document) => {
    // Open FastAPI FileResponse in a new window/tab to trigger immediate browser save
    const downloadUrl = `${api.defaults.baseURL || ''}/api/trips/${tripId}/documents/${doc.id}`;
    
    // Append Authorization token manually if standard GET requires headers
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (token) {
      window.open(`${downloadUrl}?token=${token}`, '_blank');
    } else {
      window.open(downloadUrl, '_blank');
    }
  };

  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number) => {
    if (bytes >= 1048576) {
      return `${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`;
    }
    return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`;
  };

  const getCategoryColor = (cat: string) => {
    switch (cat) {
      case 'Hotel Booking': return 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950/40 dark:text-sky-400 border-sky-200';
      case 'Flight Ticket': return 'bg-marigold-100 text-marigold-900 dark:bg-marigold-950/40 dark:text-marigold-400 border-marigold-200';
      case 'Train Ticket': return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-200';
      case 'Passport': return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-200';
      case 'Visa': return 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-900 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-200';
      case 'Insurance': return 'bg-petrol-100 text-petrol-900 dark:bg-petrol-950/40 dark:text-petrol-400 border-petrol-200';
      default: return 'bg-paper-100 text-paper-700 dark:bg-paper-800 dark:text-paper-300 border-paper-200';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
          <FolderOpen size={16} className="text-marigold-500" />
          Trip Document Manager
        </h3>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-paper-400 uppercase">
          {documents.length} Attachments
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Upload Box */}
      <form onSubmit={handleUploadSubmit} className="p-4 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 border border-dashed border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-800 rounded-xl space-y-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="block text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[9px]">Document Category</label>
            <select
              value={category}
              onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-lg bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
            >
              {["Hotel Booking", "Train Ticket", "Flight Ticket", "Bus Ticket", "Passport", "Visa", "Insurance", "Other"].map((cat) => (
                <option key={cat} value={cat}>{cat}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="block text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[9px]">Upload File Attachment</label>
            <input
              type="file"
              id="document-file-input"
              onChange={handleFileChange}
              className="w-full text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 file:mr-3 file:py-1.5 file:px-3 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-[10px] file:font-bold file:uppercase file:bg-marigold-50 file:text-marigold-600 dark:file:bg-marigold-950/40 dark:file:text-marigold-400 hover:file:bg-marigold-100"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={uploading || !selectedFile}
          className="w-full bg-marigold-600 hover:bg-marigold-500 text-white font-extrabold text-[10px] uppercase py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-md flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {uploading ? <Loader size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : <Upload size={12} />}
          {uploading ? 'Uploading File...' : 'Upload Document'}
        </button>
      </form>

      {/* Attachments list */}
      {loading && documents.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-6 text-paper-400 gap-2 text-xs">
          <Loader size={14} className="animate-spin text-marigold-500" />
          <span>Syncing files...</span>
        </div>
      ) : documents.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-paper-400 text-xs italic">
          No files attached to this trip yet.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {documents.map((doc) => (
            <div 
              key={doc.id}
              className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700/60 p-3 rounded-xl hover:border-paper-200 dark:hover:border-paper-600 transition-all text-xs"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0">
                <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg bg-marigold-50 dark:bg-marigold-950/40 flex items-center justify-center text-marigold-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                  <FileText size={16} />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-paper-200 block truncate" title={doc.filename}>
                    {doc.filename}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center mt-1 text-[10px] text-paper-400 font-semibold">
                    <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[8px] font-extrabold uppercase shrink-0 ${getCategoryColor(doc.category)}`}>
                      {doc.category}
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0"><Calendar size={10} /> {new Date(doc.uploaded_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                    <span className="shrink-0">â€¢ {formatFileSize(doc.filesize)}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Actions row */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 justify-end sm:border-0 border-t border-paper-50 dark:border-paper-800 pt-2 sm:pt-0">
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleRename(doc)}
                  className="p-1.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-paper-100 text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 transition-colors"
                  title="Rename File"
                >
                  <Edit3 size={13} />
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleDownload(doc)}
                  className="p-1.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-paper-100 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400 transition-colors"
                  title="Download / View"
                >
                  <Download size={13} />
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleDelete(doc.id)}
                  className="p-1.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/20 rounded-lg text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-100 transition-colors"
                  title="Delete Document"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={13} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

interface EmptyStateProps {

}

export const EmptyState: React.FC<EmptyStateProps> = ({

  title,
  description,
  actionLabel,
  onAction
}) => {
  return (
    <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-2xl p-10 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-4 max-w-md mx-auto shadow-sm">
      <div className="h-14 w-14 rounded-full bg-marigold-50 dark:bg-marigold-950 flex items-center justify-center text-marigold-700 dark:text-marigold-400">

        </p>
      </div>

      {onAction && actionLabel && (
        <button

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, Loader, Mail, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import api from '../services/api';

interface ForgotPasswordModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const ForgotPasswordModal: React.FC<ForgotPasswordModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<'email' | 'reset'>('email');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  const handleVerifyEmail = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    if (!email) {
      setError('Please enter your email address.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await api.post('/api/auth/forgot-password', { email });
      setStep('reset');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.detail || 
        'Email not found. Please check and try again.'
      );
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    if (!newPassword || !confirmPassword) {
      setError('Please fill in all fields.');
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword.length < 6) {
      setError('Password must be at least 6 characters long.');
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setError('Passwords do not match.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await api.post('/api/auth/reset-password', {
        email,
        new_password: newPassword,
        confirm_password: confirmPassword,
      });
      setSuccess(true);
      // Auto-close after 2 seconds
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
        resetForm();
      }, 2000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.detail || 
        'Failed to reset password. Please try again.'
      );
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setStep('email');
    setEmail('');
    setNewPassword('');
    setConfirmPassword('');
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(false);
    setShowPassword(false);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    onClose();
    resetForm();
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-ink-900 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full p-8 relative">
        {/* Close button */}
        <button
          onClick={handleClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-2 hover:bg-paper-200 dark:hover:bg-ink-800 rounded-lg transition-colors"
          title="Close"
        >
          <X size={20} className="text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400" />
        </button>

        {!success ? (
          <>
            <div className="mb-6">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-marigold-100 dark:bg-marigold-950 rounded-lg">
                  {step === 'email' ? (
                    <Mail size={20} className="text-marigold-600" />
                  ) : (
                    <Lock size={20} className="text-marigold-600" />
                  )}
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-50">
                  {step === 'email' ? 'Reset Password' : 'Create New Password'}
                </h2>
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400">
                {step === 'email'
                  ? 'Enter your email address to reset your password.'
                  : 'Enter your new password below.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {error && (
              <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-lg bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 text-sm flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <AlertCircle size={16} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <span>{error}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {step === 'email' ? (
              <form onSubmit={handleVerifyEmail} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400 mb-2">
                    Email address
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="name@example.com"
                    className="w-full bg-paper-100 dark:bg-ink-800/60 border border-paper-300 dark:border-ink-600 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-marigold-500 text-ink-900 dark:text-white transition-all"
                    disabled={loading}
                  />
                </div>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="w-full mt-2 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-marigold-500 hover:bg-marigold-400 text-ink-950 font-semibold py-3 rounded-xl transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {loading ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader size={16} className="animate-spin" />
                      Verifying...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    'Continue'
                  )}
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleClose}
                  className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl border border-paper-300 dark:border-ink-600 text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100 font-semibold hover:bg-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-ink-800 transition-colors"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </form>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={handleResetPassword} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400 mb-2">
                    New Password
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    value={newPassword}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"
                    className="w-full bg-paper-100 dark:bg-ink-800/60 border border-paper-300 dark:border-ink-600 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-marigold-500 text-ink-900 dark:text-white transition-all"
                    disabled={loading}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400 mb-2">
                    Confirm Password
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    value={confirmPassword}
                    onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"
                    className="w-full bg-paper-100 dark:bg-ink-800/60 border border-paper-300 dark:border-ink-600 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-marigold-500 text-ink-900 dark:text-white transition-all"
                    disabled={loading}
                  />
                </div>

                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400 cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={showPassword}
                    onChange={(e) => setShowPassword(e.target.checked)}
                    className="rounded"
                  />
                  Show passwords
                </label>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="w-full mt-2 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-marigold-500 hover:bg-marigold-400 text-ink-950 font-semibold py-3 rounded-xl transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {loading ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader size={16} className="animate-spin" />
                      Resetting...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    'Reset Password'
                  )}
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setStep('email');
                    setError(null);
                  }}
                  className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl border border-paper-300 dark:border-ink-600 text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100 font-semibold hover:bg-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-ink-800 transition-colors"
                >
                  Back
                </button>
              </form>
            )}

            <p className="text-center text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 mt-6">
              Remember your password?{' '}
              <button
                onClick={handleClose}
                className="text-marigold-700 dark:text-marigold-400 hover:underline font-semibold"
              >
                Back to login
              </button>
            </p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-8">
            <div className="flex justify-center mb-4">
              <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950 rounded-full">
                <CheckCircle size={32} className="text-emerald-600" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-50 mb-2">
              Password Reset Success
            </h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400">
              Your password has been updated. You can now log in with your new password.

        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const Layout: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const { darkMode, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [sidebarOpen, setSidebarOpen] = useState(false);
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);

  const fetchUnreadCount = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.get('/api/notifications/unread-count');
      setUnreadCount(response.data.unread_count);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch unread count:', err);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      fetchUnreadCount();
      const interval = setInterval(fetchUnreadCount, 30000); // Poll every 30s
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }
  }, [user, location]);

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
  };

  const renderAvatar = () => {

      <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full bg-marigold-100 dark:bg-marigold-950 flex items-center justify-center text-marigold-700 dark:text-marigold-300 font-display font-semibold uppercase text-sm">
        {user?.name ? user.name[0] : 'T'}

    );
  };

    { to: '/dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', icon: <LayoutDashboard size={19} /> },

    { to: '/currency-converter', label: 'Currency Converter', icon: <DollarSign size={19} /> },
    { to: '/notifications', label: 'Notifications', icon: <Bell size={19} />, badgeCount: unreadCount },

  if (user?.is_admin) {

  }

  if (location.pathname.startsWith('/share/')) {
    return <>{children}</>;
  }

  return (

      {/* Mobile Header */}

        <Link to="/" className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Wallet className="h-6 w-6 text-marigold-600" />
          <span className="font-display font-semibold text-xl tracking-tight text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-50">
            BudgetBound
          </span>
        </Link>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button
            onClick={toggleTheme}
            className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-paper-200 dark:bg-ink-700 text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-300 hover:bg-paper-300"
          >
            {darkMode ? <Sun size={18} /> : <Moon size={18} />}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(!sidebarOpen)}

FILE: frontend/src/components/LocationPickerModal.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, useMapEvents } from 'react-leaflet';
import L from 'leaflet';
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';
import { Search, MapPin, X, Loader } from 'lucide-react';
import axios from 'axios';

// Fix for default marker icon in react-leaflet
import icon from 'leaflet/dist/images/marker-icon.png';
import iconShadow from 'leaflet/dist/images/marker-shadow.png';

let DefaultIcon = L.icon({
    iconUrl: icon,
    shadowUrl: iconShadow,
    iconAnchor: [12, 41]
});

L.Marker.prototype.options.icon = DefaultIcon;

interface LocationPickerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSelectLocation: (city: string) => void;
  initialCity?: string;
}

// Center of India roughly
const DEFAULT_CENTER: [number, number] = [20.5937, 78.9629];
const DEFAULT_ZOOM = 4;

const LocationMarker = ({ position, setPosition, setCityName, setLoadingCity }: any) => {
  const map = useMapEvents({
    click(e) {
      setPosition(e.latlng);
      fetchCityFromCoords(e.latlng.lat, e.latlng.lng, setCityName, setLoadingCity);
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (position) {
      map.flyTo(position, map.getZoom());
    }
  }, [position, map]);

  return position === null ? null : (
    <Marker position={position} />
  );
};

const fetchCityFromCoords = async (lat: number, lon: number, setCityName: any, setLoadingCity: any) => {
  setLoadingCity(true);
  try {
    const response = await axios.get(`https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?format=json&lat=${lat}&lon=${lon}&zoom=10&addressdetails=1`);
    const address = response.data.address;
    const city = address.city || address.town || address.village || address.state_district || address.county;
    if (city) {
      setCityName(city);
    } else {
      setCityName('Unknown Location');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error reverse geocoding:", error);
    setCityName('Error resolving location');
  } finally {
    setLoadingCity(false);
  }
};


export const LocationPickerModal: React.FC<LocationPickerModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onSelectLocation, initialCity }) => {
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<L.LatLng | null>(null);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [cityName, setCityName] = useState(initialCity || '');
  const [loadingSearch, setLoadingSearch] = useState(false);
  const [loadingCity, setLoadingCity] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
     if (isOpen && initialCity && !position) {
        setSearchQuery(initialCity);
        handleSearch(null, initialCity);
     }
  }, [isOpen]);


  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSearch = async (e: React.FormEvent | null, queryOverride?: string) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    const query = queryOverride || searchQuery;
    if (!query.trim()) return;

    setLoadingSearch(true);
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=1`);
      if (response.data && response.data.length > 0) {
        const result = response.data[0];
        const newPos = new L.LatLng(parseFloat(result.lat), parseFloat(result.lon));
        setPosition(newPos);
        fetchCityFromCoords(newPos.lat, newPos.lng, setCityName, setLoadingCity);
      } else {
         // handle not found
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error searching location:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoadingSearch(false);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (cityName && cityName !== 'Unknown Location' && cityName !== 'Error resolving location') {
      onSelectLocation(cityName);
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-paper-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-3xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-[80vh] max-h-[800px]">
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-paper-800 dark:text-white">
            <div className="p-1.5 bg-marigold-100 dark:bg-marigold-900/40 text-marigold-600 rounded-lg">
              <MapPin size={18} />
            </div>
            <h2 className="font-bold text-lg">Select Starting Location</h2>
          </div>
          <button 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 text-paper-400 hover:text-paper-600 dark:hover:text-paper-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-paper-200 dark:hover:bg-paper-700 transition-colors"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <div className="p-4 flex flex-col gap-4 flex-1 overflow-hidden">
          
          {/* Search bar */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="flex gap-2">
            <div className="relative flex-1">
              <Search className="absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-paper-400" size={16} />
              <input 
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search for a city..."
                className="w-full bg-paper-100 dark:bg-paper-900 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-marigold-500 text-paper-900 dark:text-white"
              />
            </div>
            <button 
              type="submit"
              disabled={loadingSearch}
              className="bg-paper-900 hover:bg-paper-800 dark:bg-paper-700 dark:hover:bg-paper-600 text-white px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              {loadingSearch ? <Loader size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : 'Search'}
            </button>
          </form>

          {/* Map */}
          <div className="flex-1 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 relative z-0">
             <MapContainer center={DEFAULT_CENTER} zoom={DEFAULT_ZOOM} scrollWheelZoom={true} style={{ height: '100%', width: '100%' }}>
                <TileLayer
                  attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
                  url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
                />
                <LocationMarker 
                    position={position} 
                    setPosition={setPosition} 
                    setCityName={setCityName}
                    setLoadingCity={setLoadingCity}
                />
             </MapContainer>
          </div>

          {/* Result Footer */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl">
             <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Selected City</span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {loadingCity ? (
                        <Loader size={14} className="animate-spin text-marigold-500" />
                    ) : (
                        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">
                            {cityName || 'Click on map to select'}
                        </span>
                    )}
                </div>
             </div>
             
             <button
               onClick={handleConfirm}
               disabled={!cityName || cityName === 'Unknown Location' || cityName === 'Error resolving location' || loadingCity}
               className="bg-marigold-600 hover:bg-marigold-500 text-white px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shadow-md shadow-marigold-600/20"
             >
               Confirm Location
             </button>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx
================================================
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import QRCode from 'qrcode';
import { 
  X, 
  Globe, 
  Lock, 
  Copy, 
  Check, 
  Download, 
  QrCode, 
  Link2,
  Loader
} from 'lucide-react';
import api from '../services/api';

interface ShareModalProps {
  tripId: number;
  isPublic: boolean;
  shareToken: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdate: (updatedTrip: any) => void;
}

export const ShareModal: React.FC<ShareModalProps> = ({
  tripId,
  isPublic: initialIsPublic,
  shareToken: initialShareToken,
  onClose,
  onUpdate
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(initialIsPublic);
  const [shareToken, setShareToken] = useState(initialShareToken);
  const [toggling, setToggling] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const shareUrl = shareToken 
    ? `${window.location.origin}/share/${shareToken}`
    : '';

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsPublic(initialIsPublic);
    setShareToken(initialShareToken);
  }, [initialIsPublic, initialShareToken]);

  // Generate QR Code locally when isPublic and shareUrl are active
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPublic && shareUrl && canvasRef.current) {
      QRCode.toCanvas(
        canvasRef.current,
        shareUrl,
        {
          width: 180,
          margin: 1.5,
          color: {
            dark: '#1e1b4b', // Deep petrol
            light: '#ffffff'
          }
        },
        (error) => {
          if (error) console.error('Error drawing local QR code:', error);
        }
      );
    }
  }, [isPublic, shareUrl]);

  const handleToggleShare = async () => {
    try {
      setToggling(true);
      const response = await api.post(`/api/trips/${tripId}/share/toggle`);
      setIsPublic(response.data.is_public);
      setShareToken(response.data.share_token);
      onUpdate(response.data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to update trip visibility settings.');
    } finally {
      setToggling(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    if (!shareUrl) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownloadQR = () => {
    if (!canvasRef.current) return;
    const dataUrl = canvasRef.current.toDataURL('image/png');
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.download = `budgetbound_trip_share_${tripId}.png`;
    a.href = dataUrl;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-paper-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-6 z-50 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md p-6 shadow-2xl relative">
        {/* Close Button */}
        <button 
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-paper-400 hover:text-paper-700 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors"
        >
          <X size={18} />
        </button>

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="mb-6">
          <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-paper-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <QrCode className="text-marigold-500" size={18} />
            Share Travel Plan
          </h3>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-paper-400 mt-0.5">
            Generate read-only shared links and QR codes to share with friends.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Sharing Settings Toggle Panel */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Status Row */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900/40 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-800 rounded-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className={`h-9 w-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center ${isPublic ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/20' : 'bg-paper-100 text-paper-500 dark:bg-paper-900'}`}>
                {isPublic ? <Globe size={18} /> : <Lock size={18} />}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs">
                <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white block">
                  {isPublic ? 'Public View Enabled' : 'Private Travel Plan'}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400">
                  {isPublic ? 'Accessible by anyone with the link' : 'Owner authentication required'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <button
              onClick={handleToggleShare}
              disabled={toggling}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold uppercase transition-all shadow-sm ${
                isPublic 
                  ? 'bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-950/20 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/30' 
                  : 'bg-marigold-600 hover:bg-marigold-500 text-white'
              }`}
            >
              {toggling ? <Loader size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : (isPublic ? 'Make Private' : 'Publish')}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Public Sharing Elements */}
          {isPublic && shareToken ? (
            <div className="space-y-5 animate-fade-in text-xs">
              
              {/* Copy URL Row */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[10px]">Public Sharing Link</label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <div className="flex-1 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-300 truncate select-all flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Link2 size={12} className="text-paper-400 shrink-0" />
                    {shareUrl}
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleCopyLink}
                    className="bg-paper-100 hover:bg-paper-200 dark:bg-paper-700 dark:hover:bg-paper-600 text-paper-700 dark:text-white p-2.5 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-sm border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-600 shrink-0"
                    title="Copy Link"
                  >
                    {copied ? <Check size={16} className="text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy size={16} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 mt-2">
                  Share this link with friends and family. They can view your trip details without logging in.
                </p>
              </div>

            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-6 text-paper-400 dark:text-paper-600 text-xs italic flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
              <Lock size={20} className="text-paper-400" />
              <span>Enable public sharing mode to generate QR codes and reader links.</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: frontend/src/components/TimelineItinerary.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { 
  Plane, 
  Building, 
  Utensils, 
  Camera, 
  Clock, 
  Compass, 
  ChevronDown, 
  ChevronUp,
  MapPin,
  Car
} from 'lucide-react';

interface Activity {
  time: string;
  title: string;
  cost: number;
  duration?: string;
  category?: string;
}

interface ItineraryDay {
  day_number: number;
  description?: string;
  activities: Activity[];
}

interface TimelineItineraryProps {
  itineraries: ItineraryDay[];
  expandedDays: Record<number, boolean>;
  toggleDay: (dayNumber: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const TimelineItinerary: React.FC<TimelineItineraryProps> = ({
  itineraries,
  expandedDays,
  toggleDay,
  className = '',
}) => {

  const getCategoryIcon = (category?: string, title: string = '') => {
    const term = (category || title).toLowerCase();
    if (term.includes('hotel') || term.includes('stay') || term.includes('check-in') || term.includes('accommodation')) {
      return { icon: <Building size={14} />, bg: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400' };
    }
    if (term.includes('lunch') || term.includes('dinner') || term.includes('food') || term.includes('breakfast') || term.includes('eat') || term.includes('restaurant')) {
      return { icon: <Utensils size={14} />, bg: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400' };
    }
    if (term.includes('flight') || term.includes('train') || term.includes('arrival') || term.includes('departure') || term.includes('travel') || term.includes('cab')) {
      return { icon: <Plane size={14} />, bg: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-400' };
    }
    return { icon: <Camera size={14} />, bg: 'bg-marigold-100 text-marigold-600 dark:bg-marigold-950/40 dark:text-marigold-400' };
  };

  const formatActivityTime = (timeStr: string) => {
    if (timeStr === 'Morning') return '08:00';
    if (timeStr === 'Afternoon') return '13:00';
    if (timeStr === 'Evening') return '17:00';
    if (timeStr === 'Night') return '20:00';
    return timeStr;
  };

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-4 w-full ${className}`}>
      {itineraries.map((day) => {
        const isOpen = !!expandedDays[day.day_number];
        return (
          <div 
            key={day.day_number} 
            className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow"
          >
            {/* Header Accordion Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => toggleDay(day.day_number)}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-paper-50/50 dark:bg-paper-900/10 text-left font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-300 focus:outline-none"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                  {day.activities.map((act, actIdx) => {
                    const formattedTime = formatActivityTime(act.time);
                    const { icon, bg } = getCategoryIcon(act.category, act.title);
                    const duration = act.duration || "2.0h";
                    const costStr = act.cost > 0 ? `â‚¹${act.cost.toLocaleString()}` : 'Included / Free';

                    return (
                      <div key={actIdx} className="relative flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs group">
                        
                        {/* Timeline Node Point */}

                          {icon}

                          {costStr}
                        </div>

                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

FILE: frontend/src/components/TripChecklist.tsx
================================================
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import api from '../services/api';
import { 
  CheckSquare, 
  Square, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  Loader, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertCircle,
  Package
} from 'lucide-react';

interface PackingItem {
  id: number;
  trip_id: number;
  name: string;
  checked: boolean;
}

interface TripChecklistProps {
  tripId: number;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  initialItems?: PackingItem[];
  onChange?: () => void;
}

export const TripChecklist: React.FC<TripChecklistProps> = ({
  tripId,
  readOnly = false,
  initialItems,
  onChange
}) => {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<PackingItem[]>(initialItems || []);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [newItemName, setNewItemName] = useState('');
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);

  const fetchChecklist = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await api.get(`/api/trips/${tripId}/checklist`);
      setItems(response.data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch checklist:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialItems) {
      fetchChecklist();
    } else {
      setItems(initialItems);
    }
  }, [tripId, initialItems]);

  const handleToggle = async (item: PackingItem) => {
    if (readOnly) return;
    const nextChecked = !item.checked;
    
    // Optimistic update
    setItems(prev => prev.map(i => i.id === item.id ? { ...i, checked: nextChecked } : i));
    
    try {
      await api.put(`/api/trips/${tripId}/checklist/${item.id}`, {
        checked: nextChecked
      });
      if (onChange) onChange();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      // Revert on error
      setItems(prev => prev.map(i => i.id === item.id ? { ...i, checked: !nextChecked } : i));
      alert('Failed to save checklist state.');
    }
  };

  const handleAddItem = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newItemName.trim() || readOnly) return;
    
    try {
      setAdding(true);
      const response = await api.post(`/api/trips/${tripId}/checklist`, {
        name: newItemName.trim()
      });
      setItems(prev => [...prev, response.data]);
      setNewItemName('');
      if (onChange) onChange();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to add checklist item.');
    } finally {
      setAdding(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteItem = async (itemId: number) => {
    if (readOnly) return;
    try {
      await api.delete(`/api/trips/${tripId}/checklist/${itemId}`);
      setItems(prev => prev.filter(i => i.id !== itemId));
      if (onChange) onChange();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to delete checklist item.');
    }
  };

  // Completion calculation
  const totalCount = items.length;
  const packedCount = items.filter(i => i.checked).length;
  const percentage = totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((packedCount / totalCount) * 100) : 0;

  if (loading && items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 text-paper-400 gap-2 text-xs">
        <Loader size={14} className="animate-spin text-marigold-500" />
        <span>Loading packing checklist...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
      {/* Title */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
          <Package size={16} className="text-marigold-500" />
          Smart Packing Checklist
        </h3>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-paper-400">
          {packedCount}/{totalCount} Items Packed
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Progress Bar */}
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-extrabold text-paper-500 uppercase">
          <span>Packing Progress</span>
          <span className={percentage === 100 ? "text-emerald-500" : ""}>{percentage}% Complete</span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-2 w-full bg-paper-100 dark:bg-paper-900 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
          <div 
            className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${percentage === 100 ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-marigold-600'}`}
            style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Checklist items */}
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-6 text-paper-400 text-xs italic">
          No packing items yet. Add custom ones below.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto pr-1 space-y-2.5">
          {items.map((item) => (
            <div 
              key={item.id} 
              className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                item.checked 
                  ? 'bg-paper-50/50 dark:bg-paper-900/10 border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-800 text-paper-400' 
                  : 'bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700/60 text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-200'
              }`}
            >
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={readOnly}
                onClick={() => handleToggle(item)}
                className={`flex items-start gap-2.5 text-left font-medium transition-colors ${readOnly ? 'cursor-default' : 'hover:text-marigold-600'}`}
              >
                <span className="shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-marigold-500">
                  {item.checked ? <CheckSquare size={16} fill="currentColor" className="text-white dark:text-paper-800" /> : <Square size={16} />}
                </span>
                <span className={item.checked ? 'line-through' : ''}>
                  {item.name}
                </span>
              </button>

              {!readOnly && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleDeleteItem(item.id)}
                  className="text-paper-500 hover:text-rose-500 transition-colors p-1"
                  title="Delete item"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={13} />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add Custom Item */}
      {!readOnly && (
        <form onSubmit={handleAddItem} className="flex gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700/60">
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Add custom packing item..."
            value={newItemName}
            onChange={(e) => setNewItemName(e.target.value)}
            disabled={adding}
            className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl text-xs bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-marigold-500 dark:text-white"
          />
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={adding || !newItemName.trim()}
            className="bg-marigold-600 hover:bg-marigold-500 text-white font-bold p-2.5 rounded-xl transition-all disabled:opacity-50 shrink-0"
          >
            {adding ? <Loader size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Plus size={14} />}
          </button>
        </form>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx
================================================
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import api from '../services/api';

interface User {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  created_at: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  default_budget?: number | null;
  preferred_travel_style?: string | null;
  preferred_comfort_level?: number | null;
  default_starting_city?: string | null;
  preferred_theme: string;
  is_admin: boolean;
}

interface AuthContextType {
  user: User | null;
  token: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  register: (name: string, email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => void;
  clearError: () => void;
  error: string | null;
  updateUser: (updatedUser: User) => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(localStorage.getItem('token'));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchUser = async () => {
      const storedToken = localStorage.getItem('token');
      if (storedToken) {
        try {
          const response = await api.get('/api/auth/me');
          setUser(response.data);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Token verification failed", err);
          logout();
        }
      }
      setLoading(false);
    };

    fetchUser();
  }, []);

  const login = async (email: string, password: string) => {
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Use JSON login endpoint
      const response = await api.post('/api/auth/login-json', { email, password });
      const { access_token, user: userData } = response.data;
      
      localStorage.setItem('token', access_token);
      localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(userData));
      setToken(access_token);
      setUser(userData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.detail || 
        'Login failed. Please check your credentials.'
      );
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const register = async (name: string, email: string, password: string) => {
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await api.post('/api/auth/register', { name, email, password });
      const { access_token, user: userData } = response.data;
      
      localStorage.setItem('token', access_token);
      localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(userData));
      setToken(access_token);
      setUser(userData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.detail || 
        'Registration failed. Email might already be taken.'
      );
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const logout = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    localStorage.removeItem('user');
    setToken(null);
    setUser(null);
    setError(null);
    window.location.href = '/';
  };

  const clearError = () => setError(null);

  const updateUser = (updatedUser: User) => {
    localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
    setUser(updatedUser);
  };

  const value = {
    user,
    token,
    loading,
    isAuthenticated: !!token,
    login,
    register,
    logout,
    error,
    clearError,
    updateUser
  };

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

FILE: frontend/src/context/ThemeContext.tsx

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface ThemeContextType {
  darkMode: boolean;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [darkMode, setDarkMode] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    if (saved) return saved === 'dark';
    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (darkMode) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
      localStorage.setItem('theme', 'dark');
      console.log('Theme changed to: dark');
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
      localStorage.setItem('theme', 'light');
      console.log('Theme changed to: light');
    }
  }, [darkMode]);

  const toggleTheme = () => setDarkMode(!darkMode);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ darkMode, toggleTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = () => {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider');
  return context;
};

import { useEffect } from 'react';

/**
 * Custom hook to set the browser tab title for each page
 * @param title - The title to display in the browser tab
 */
export const usePageTitle = (title: string) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    // Set the document title
    document.title = title;

    // Return cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Reset to default title when component unmounts
      document.title = 'BudgetBound - Travel Budget Planner';
    };
  }, [title]);
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { usePageTitle } from '../hooks/usePageTitle';
import api from '../services/api';
import { 
  ShieldAlert, 
  TrendingDown, 
  Check, 
  ArrowLeft, 
  Loader, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Award,
  ChevronRight
} from 'lucide-react';

interface Allocation {
  transport_cost: number;
  hotel_cost: number;
  food_cost: number;
  activities_cost: number;
  emergency_reserve: number;
  local_transport_cost: number;
  taxes_fees_cost: number;
}

interface OptimizeOption {
  action_key: string;
  label: string;
  cost_difference: number;
  new_allocation: Allocation;
  description: string;
}

interface OptimizeResponse {
  current_cost: number;
  budget: number;
  allocations: Allocation;
  options: OptimizeOption[];
}

interface TripInfo {
  destination: {
    name: string;
    state: string;
  };
}

export const BudgetOptimizer: React.FC = () => {
  usePageTitle('Budget Optimizer | BudgetBound');
  const { tripId } = useParams<{ tripId: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  
  const [data, setData] = useState<OptimizeResponse | null>(null);
  const [trip, setTrip] = useState<TripInfo | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [selectedOptionIdx, setSelectedOptionIdx] = useState<number>(0);
  const [applying, setApplying] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const fetchData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const [optRes, tripRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.post(`/api/trips/${tripId}/optimize`),
        api.get(`/api/trips/${tripId}`)
      ]);
      setData(optRes.data);
      setTrip(tripRes.data);
      if (optRes.data.options.length > 0) {
        setSelectedOptionIdx(0);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError('Could not fetch optimization insights.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tripId) {
      fetchData();
    }
  }, [tripId]);

  const handleApplyOptimization = async () => {
    if (!data || data.options.length === 0 || applying) return;
    
    setApplying(true);
    const option = data.options[selectedOptionIdx];
    try {
      await api.post(`/api/trips/${tripId}/optimize/apply`, {
        action_key: option.action_key
      });
      setSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        navigate('/dashboard');
      }, 2000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError('Failed to apply optimized changes.');
      setApplying(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-[50vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 gap-4">
        <Loader className="h-10 w-10 text-marigold-500 animate-spin" />
        <span className="text-sm font-semibold">Running budget simulations...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !data || !trip) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <ShieldAlert size={24} />
          <h3 className="font-bold">Optimization Error</h3>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs">{error || 'Failed to load optimization metrics.'}</p>
        <Link to="/dashboard" className="text-xs font-bold underline mt-2 block">
          Return to Dashboard
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const hasOptions = data.options.length > 0;
  const currentOption = hasOptions ? data.options[selectedOptionIdx] : null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <Link 
          to="/dashboard" 
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-paper-400 hover:text-marigold-600 dark:hover:text-marigold-400 uppercase tracking-widest transition-colors mb-2"
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={14} />
          Back to Dashboard
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
          Budget Optimizer: {trip.destination.name}
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400">
          Analyze and adjust your trip parameters to save money or increase luxury dynamically.
        </p>
      </div>

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-3 animate-pulse">

          Optimization applied successfully! Redirecting to Dashboard...
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Overview Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        
        {/* Current Total */}
        <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">Current Total Cost</span>
            <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{data.current_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-marigold-100 dark:bg-marigold-950/40 text-marigold-600 dark:text-marigold-400 flex items-center justify-center">
            â‚¹
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Budget limit */}
        <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">Target Budget</span>
            <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{data.budget.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-petrol-100 dark:bg-petrol-950/40 text-petrol-600 dark:text-petrol-400 flex items-center justify-center">
            L
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Health status */}
        <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">Target Variance</span>
            <span className={`text-xl font-extrabold block ${data.current_cost <= data.budget ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-rose-500'}`}>
              {data.current_cost <= data.budget 
                ? `Under Budget by â‚¹${(data.budget - data.current_cost).toLocaleString()}` 
                : `Over Budget by â‚¹${(data.current_cost - data.budget).toLocaleString()}`}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {!hasOptions ? (
        <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-3xl p-12 text-center shadow-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center">

            Your current plan is already at budget limitations with sleeper transits and budget properties. No further optimizer guidelines are required.
          </p>

      ) : (

            {data.options.map((option, index) => {
              const isSelected = index === selectedOptionIdx;
              const isSaving = option.cost_difference < 0;
              return (
                <button

                  onClick={() => setSelectedOptionIdx(index)}
                  className={`w-full text-left p-4 rounded-xl border transition-all flex items-center justify-between gap-4 ${

                  }`}

                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold block">{option.label}</span>
                    <span className={`text-[10px] ${isSelected ? 'text-marigold-200' : 'text-paper-400'}`}>
                      {option.action_key.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                    <span className={`text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-paper-50/20 text-white'
                        : isSaving ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-500' : 'bg-marigold-500/15 text-marigold-500'
                    }`}>
                      {isSaving 
                        ? `-â‚¹${Math.abs(option.cost_difference).toLocaleString()}` 
                        : `+â‚¹${option.cost_difference.toLocaleString()}`}
                    </span>
                    <ChevronRight size={16} className={isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-paper-400'} />
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Option Comparison details */}
          {currentOption && (
            <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-6">
              
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-paper-900 dark:text-white mb-2">{currentOption.label}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 leading-relaxed">
                  {currentOption.description}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Side by side comparison */}
              <div className="border border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl overflow-hidden text-xs">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-12 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900/40 p-3 font-bold text-paper-500 uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700">
                  <div className="col-span-6">Category</div>
                  <div className="col-span-3 text-right">Current</div>
                  <div className="col-span-3 text-right text-marigold-600 dark:text-marigold-400">Optimized</div>
                </div>

                <div className="divide-y divide-paper-100 dark:divide-paper-700/60 font-medium">
                  {/* Transportation */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-12 p-3 items-center">
                    <div className="col-span-6 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400">Transportation</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right">â‚¹{data.allocations.transport_cost.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right font-bold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
                      â‚¹{currentOption.new_allocation.transport_cost.toLocaleString()}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Accommodation */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-12 p-3 items-center">
                    <div className="col-span-6 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400">Lodging (Hotel)</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right">â‚¹{data.allocations.hotel_cost.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right font-bold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
                      â‚¹{currentOption.new_allocation.hotel_cost.toLocaleString()}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Food */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-12 p-3 items-center">
                    <div className="col-span-6 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400">Food & Dining</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right">â‚¹{data.allocations.food_cost.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right font-bold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
                      â‚¹{currentOption.new_allocation.food_cost.toLocaleString()}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Activities */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-12 p-3 items-center">
                    <div className="col-span-6 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400">Activities</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right">â‚¹{data.allocations.activities_cost.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right font-bold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
                      â‚¹{currentOption.new_allocation.activities_cost.toLocaleString()}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Local Trans */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-12 p-3 items-center">
                    <div className="col-span-6 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400">Local Travel</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right">â‚¹{data.allocations.local_transport_cost.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right font-bold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
                      â‚¹{currentOption.new_allocation.local_transport_cost.toLocaleString()}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Taxes */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-12 p-3 items-center">
                    <div className="col-span-6 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400">Taxes & Fees</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right">â‚¹{data.allocations.taxes_fees_cost.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right font-bold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
                      â‚¹{currentOption.new_allocation.taxes_fees_cost.toLocaleString()}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Emergency */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-12 p-3 items-center">
                    <div className="col-span-6 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-400">Emergency Reserve</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right">â‚¹{data.allocations.emergency_reserve.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right font-bold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
                      â‚¹{currentOption.new_allocation.emergency_reserve.toLocaleString()}
                    </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-12 p-3 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900/30 items-center font-bold text-sm">
                    <div className="col-span-6 text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-300">Total Simulated Cost</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right">â‚¹{data.current_cost.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    <div className="col-span-3 text-right text-marigold-600 dark:text-marigold-400">
                      â‚¹{
                        (
                          currentOption.new_allocation.transport_cost +
                          currentOption.new_allocation.hotel_cost +
                          currentOption.new_allocation.food_cost +
                          currentOption.new_allocation.activities_cost +
                          currentOption.new_allocation.local_transport_cost +
                          currentOption.new_allocation.taxes_fees_cost +
                          currentOption.new_allocation.emergency_reserve
                        ).toLocaleString()
                      }
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <TrendingDown className="text-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400">
                    {currentOption.cost_difference < 0 
                      ? `Applying will save INR ${Math.abs(currentOption.cost_difference).toLocaleString()}`
                      : `Applying will cost INR ${currentOption.cost_difference.toLocaleString()} more`}

                </div>
                
                <button
                  onClick={handleApplyOptimization}
                  disabled={applying || success}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-marigold-600 hover:bg-marigold-500 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all shadow-md shadow-marigold-600/10 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {applying ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader size={14} className="animate-spin" />
                      Applying changes...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Check size={14} />
                      Apply Strategy
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>

            </div>
          )}

        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { usePageTitle } from '../hooks/usePageTitle';
import { DollarSign, ArrowRightLeft, TrendingUp, Info, MapPin, CreditCard } from 'lucide-react';
import api from '../services/api';

interface ExchangeRates {
  [key: string]: number;
}

interface RatesResponse {
  rates: ExchangeRates;
  last_updated: string | null;
  source: string;
}

export const CurrencyConverter: React.FC = () => {
  usePageTitle('Currency Converter | BudgetBound');
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState<number>(10000);
  const [fromCurrency, setFromCurrency] = useState<string>('INR');
  const [toCurrency, setToCurrency] = useState<string>('USD');
  const [convertedAmount, setConvertedAmount] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [exchangeRate, setExchangeRate] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [allRates, setAllRates] = useState<ExchangeRates>({});
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const currencies = [
    { code: 'INR', name: 'Indian Rupee', symbol: 'â‚¹', flag: 'ðŸ‡®ðŸ‡³' },
    { code: 'USD', name: 'US Dollar', symbol: '$', flag: 'ðŸ‡ºðŸ‡¸' },
    { code: 'EUR', name: 'Euro', symbol: 'â‚¬', flag: 'ðŸ‡ªðŸ‡º' },
    { code: 'GBP', name: 'British Pound', symbol: 'Â£', flag: 'ðŸ‡¬ðŸ‡§' },
    { code: 'AED', name: 'UAE Dirham', symbol: 'Ø¯.Ø¥', flag: 'ðŸ‡¦ðŸ‡ª' },
    { code: 'THB', name: 'Thai Baht', symbol: 'à¸¿', flag: 'ðŸ‡¹ðŸ‡­' },

    { code: 'MYR', name: 'Malaysian Ringgit', symbol: 'RM', flag: 'ðŸ‡²ðŸ‡¾' },
    { code: 'IDR', name: 'Indonesian Rupiah', symbol: 'Rp', flag: 'ðŸ‡®ðŸ‡©' },
    { code: 'VND', name: 'Vietnamese Dong', symbol: 'â‚«', flag: 'ðŸ‡»ðŸ‡³' },
    { code: 'NPR', name: 'Nepalese Rupee', symbol: 'à¤°à¥‚', flag: 'ðŸ‡³ðŸ‡µ' },
    { code: 'LKR', name: 'Sri Lankan Rupee', symbol: 'Rs', flag: 'ðŸ‡±ðŸ‡°' },
    { code: 'TRY', name: 'Turkish Lira', symbol: 'â‚º', flag: 'ðŸ‡¹ðŸ‡·' },

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAllRates();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (amount > 0) {
      convertCurrency();
    }
  }, [amount, fromCurrency, toCurrency]);

  const fetchAllRates = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.get('/api/currency/rates', {
        params: { base: 'INR' }
      });
      setAllRates(response.data.rates);
      setLastUpdated(response.data.last_updated);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch exchange rates:', err);
    }
  };

  const convertCurrency = async () => {
    if (amount <= 0) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const response = await api.get('/api/currency/convert', {
        params: {
          amount,
          from_currency: fromCurrency,
          to_currency: toCurrency
        }
      });

      setConvertedAmount(response.data.converted_amount);
      setExchangeRate(response.data.exchange_rate);
      if (response.data.last_updated) {
        setLastUpdated(response.data.last_updated);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError('Failed to convert currency. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const swapCurrencies = () => {
    setFromCurrency(toCurrency);
    setToCurrency(fromCurrency);
  };

  const getCurrencyInfo = (code: string) => {
    return currencies.find(c => c.code === code);
  };

  const popularConversions = [
    { from: 'INR', to: 'USD', label: 'â‚¹ to $' },
    { from: 'INR', to: 'EUR', label: 'â‚¹ to â‚¬' },
    { from: 'INR', to: 'AED', label: 'â‚¹ to Dirham' },
    { from: 'INR', to: 'THB', label: 'â‚¹ to Baht' },
    { from: 'USD', to: 'INR', label: '$ to â‚¹' },
    { from: 'EUR', to: 'INR', label: 'â‚¬ to â‚¹' }
  ];

          Currency Converter
        </h1>

          Convert currencies with live exchange rates
          {lastUpdated && (
            <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-marigold-600 dark:text-marigold-400">
              â€¢ Updated {new Date(lastUpdated).toLocaleString()}
            </span>
          )}
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {/* Main Converter */}

                Amount
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"

                step="100"

                className="w-full bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl px-6 py-4 text-2xl font-bold text-paper-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-marigold-500"
