import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { usePageTitle } from '../hooks/usePageTitle';
import api from '../services/api';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';

import { BudgetHealthMeter } from '../components/BudgetHealthMeter';
import { 
  BarChart, 
  Bar, 
  XAxis, 
  YAxis, 
  CartesianGrid, 
  Tooltip, 
  ResponsiveContainer, 
  PieChart, 
  Pie, 
  Cell, 
  Legend 
} from 'recharts';
import {
  Wallet,
  Compass,
  TrendingUp,
  Trash2,
  ArrowRight,
  AlertCircle,
  Eye,
  PlusCircle,
  PiggyBank,
  Loader,
  Download
} from 'lucide-react';

interface RecentTrip {
  id: number;
  destination: string;
  state: string;
  budget: number;
  estimated_cost: number;
  days: number;
  category: string;
  date: string;
  status?: string;
  start_date?: string;
}

interface BudgetUsagePoint {
  name: string;
  budget: number;
  estimated: number;
  actual: number;
}

interface CategoryExpensePoint {
  name: string;
  value: number;
}

interface DashboardStats {
  total_trips: number;
  planned_budget: number;
  actual_expenses: number;
  savings: number;
  trips_planned: number;
  trips_in_progress: number;
  trips_completed: number;
  trips_cancelled: number;
  trips_draft: number;
  recent_trips: RecentTrip[];
  upcoming_trips: RecentTrip[];
  budget_usage_chart: BudgetUsagePoint[];
  category_chart: CategoryExpensePoint[];
}

export const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  usePageTitle('Dashboard | BudgetBound');
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { darkMode } = useTheme();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [stats, setStats] = useState<DashboardStats | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [downloadingTripId, setDownloadingTripId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const [latestTripStats, setLatestTripStats] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [latestTripDetails, setLatestTripDetails] = useState<any | null>(null);

  const fetchLatestTripData = async (tripId: number) => {
    try {
      const [detailsRes, statsRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/api/trips/${tripId}`),
        api.get(`/api/expenses/trip/${tripId}/stats`)
      ]);
      setLatestTripDetails(detailsRes.data);
      setLatestTripStats(statsRes.data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to load latest trip details for dashboard forecast:", err);
    }
  };

  // Fetch Dashboard Stats on load
  const fetchStats = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await api.get('/api/dashboard/stats');
      setStats(response.data);
      if (response.data.recent_trips && response.data.recent_trips.length > 0) {
        await fetchLatestTripData(response.data.recent_trips[0].id);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError('Failed to load dashboard metrics.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchStats();
  }, []);

  const handleDownloadPDF = async (tripId: number, destName: string) => {
    setDownloadingTripId(tripId);
    try {
      const response = await api.get(`/api/trips/${tripId}/pdf`, {
        responseType: 'blob'
      });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([response.data], { type: 'application/pdf' }));
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.setAttribute('download', `budgetbound_${destName.replace(/\s+/g, '_').toLowerCase()}.pdf`);
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      link.parentNode?.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to download PDF:', err);
    } finally {
      setDownloadingTripId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteTrip = async (tripId: number) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this trip? All logged expenses and itineraries will be permanently removed.')) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await api.delete(`/api/trips/${tripId}`);
      // Refresh statistics
      fetchStats();
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to delete trip.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-[60vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 gap-4">
        <Loader className="h-10 w-10 text-marigold-500 animate-spin" />
        <span className="text-sm font-semibold">Analyzing your travel dashboard...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !stats) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3">
        <AlertCircle size={24} />
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-bold">Error loading dashboard</h3>
          <p className="text-xs mt-0.5">{error || 'Something went wrong.'}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Visual Colors for Charts
  const COLORS = ['#E8A33D', '#1F6F63', '#9B3A5B', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#B04066'];

  return (
    <motion.div 
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
      className="flex flex-col gap-8"
    >
      
      {/* Welcome header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="eyebrow-rule text-marigold-700 dark:text-marigold-400 text-xs font-semibold">Travel hub</p>
          <h1 className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-50 mt-1">
            Welcome back, {user?.name || 'Explorer'}
          </h1>
        </div>
        <Link
          to="/planner"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-marigold-500 hover:bg-marigold-400 text-ink-950 font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm transition-all"
        >
          <PlusCircle size={16} />
          Plan new trip
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Core Stats Cards - ticket stubs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">

        {/* Total Trips */}
        <div className="ticket p-5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 font-medium">Total trips</span>
            <h3 className="font-num text-3xl font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-50">{stats.total_trips}</h3>
          </div>
          <div className="h-11 w-11 rounded-full bg-marigold-100 dark:bg-marigold-950/40 text-marigold-600 dark:text-marigold-400 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Compass size={22} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Planned Budget */}
        <div className="ticket p-5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 font-medium">Allocated budget</span>
            <h3 className="font-num text-2xl font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-50">â‚¹{stats.planned_budget.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</h3>
          </div>
          <div className="h-11 w-11 rounded-full bg-petrol-100 dark:bg-petrol-950/40 text-petrol-600 dark:text-petrol-400 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Wallet size={22} />

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { usePageTitle } from '../hooks/usePageTitle';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import api from '../services/api';
import { TripFlowGuide } from '../components/TripFlowGuide';
import { 
  Map, 
  Search, 
  Star, 
  MapPin, 
  Loader, 
  AlertCircle,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight
} from 'lucide-react';

interface Destination {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  state: string;
  avg_travel_cost: number;
  avg_hotel_cost: number;
  avg_food_cost: number;
  avg_activity_cost: number;
  rating: number;
  category: string;
  best_season: string;
  description: string;
  attractions: string[];
}

export const DestinationExplorer: React.FC = () => {
  usePageTitle('Explore Destinations | BudgetBound');
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [destinations, setDestinations] = useState<Destination[]>([]);
  const [states, setStates] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<string[]>([]);
  
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Pagination states
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const limit = 9;

  // Filters
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('');
  const [state, setState] = useState('');
  const [maxBudget, setMaxBudget] = useState<number | ''>('');

  const fetchFilters = async () => {
    try {
      const [statesRes, catsRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get('/api/destinations/states'),
        api.get('/api/destinations/categories')
      ]);
      setStates(statesRes.data);
      setCategories(catsRes.data);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to load filter choices", e);
    }
  };

  const fetchDestinations = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const response = await api.get('/api/destinations/', {
        params: {
          search: search || undefined,
          category: category || undefined,
          state: state || undefined,
          max_budget: maxBudget || undefined,
          page: page,
          limit: limit
        }
      });
      setDestinations(response.data.destinations);
      setTotal(response.data.total);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError('Failed to fetch destinations.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFilters();
  }, []);

  // Reset page to 1 whenever filters change
  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1);
  }, [search, category, state, maxBudget]);

  // Refetch when filters or page changes
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDestinations();
  }, [search, category, state, maxBudget, page]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit) || 1;

                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-paper-400 block font-bold uppercase">Transit Fare (Avg)</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{dest.avg_travel_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Pagination Controls */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 pt-6">
            <span className="text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 font-medium">
              Showing <span className="font-bold text-paper-700 dark:text-white">{destinations.length}</span> of{' '}
              <span className="font-bold text-paper-700 dark:text-white">{total}</span> destinations (Page {page} of {totalPages})
            </span>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setPage(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, 1))}
                disabled={page === 1}
                className="p-2 rounded-xl border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-300 hover:bg-paper-50 dark:hover:bg-paper-700/50 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-all"
              >
                <ChevronLeft size={16} />
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => setPage(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, totalPages))}
                disabled={page === totalPages}
                className="p-2 rounded-xl border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-300 hover:bg-paper-50 dark:hover:bg-paper-700/50 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-all"
              >
                <ChevronRight size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

    </div>
  );
};

FILE: frontend/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx
================================================
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { usePageTitle } from '../hooks/usePageTitle';
import api from '../services/api';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { EmptyState, SkeletonList } from '../components/FeedbackStates';
import { 
  Bell, 
  Check, 
  Trash2, 
  Calendar, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Package, 
  Share2, 
  FileText, 
  CheckCircle,
  Loader,
  Clock
} from 'lucide-react';

interface Notification {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  message: string;
  is_read: boolean;
  created_at: string;
}

export const NotificationsPage: React.FC = () => {
  usePageTitle('Notifications | BudgetBound');
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actioning, setActioning] = useState(false);

  const fetchNotifications = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await api.get('/api/notifications');
      setNotifications(response.data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load notifications:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchNotifications();
  }, []);

  const handleMarkRead = async (id: number) => {
    try {
      const response = await api.put(`/api/notifications/${id}/read`);
      setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === id ? response.data : n));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkAllRead = async () => {
    try {
      setActioning(true);
      await api.post('/api/notifications/mark-all-read');
      setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({ ...n, is_read: true })));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setActioning(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: number) => {
    try {
      await api.delete(`/api/notifications/${id}`);
      setNotifications(prev => prev.filter(n => n.id !== id));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const getNotificationIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'Upcoming Trip':
      case 'Trip Reminder':
        return <Calendar className="text-sky-500" size={18} />;
      case 'Budget Warning':
      case 'Overspending Alert':
        return <AlertTriangle className="text-amber-500" size={18} />;
      case 'Packing Reminder':
        return <Package className="text-marigold-500" size={18} />;
      case 'Checklist Completed':
        return <CheckCircle className="text-emerald-500" size={18} />;
      case 'Trip Shared Successfully':
        return <Share2 className="text-petrol-500" size={18} />;
      case 'Trip Exported':
        return <FileText className="text-teal-500" size={18} />;
      default:
        return <Bell className="text-paper-400" size={18} />;
    }
  };

  const getNotificationColorClass = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'Overspending Alert':
        return 'border-rose-100 dark:border-rose-900/10 bg-rose-50/20 dark:bg-rose-950/5';
      case 'Budget Warning':
        return 'border-amber-100 dark:border-amber-900/10 bg-amber-50/15 dark:bg-amber-950/5';
      case 'Checklist Completed':
        return 'border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-900/10 bg-emerald-50/10 dark:bg-emerald-950/5';
      default:
        return 'border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-800 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800';
    }
  };

  const unreadCount = notifications.filter(n => !n.is_read).length;

  return (
    <motion.div 
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
      className="max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-6"
    >
      
      {/* Title Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
            <Bell size={20} className="text-marigold-500" />
            BudgetBound Notification Center
          </h2>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-paper-400 mt-0.5">
            Stay updated with your travel reminders, checklists, and expenditure warnings
          </p>
        </div>

        {unreadCount > 0 && (
          <button
            onClick={handleMarkAllRead}
            disabled={actioning}
            className="bg-marigold-600 hover:bg-marigold-500 text-white font-extrabold text-[10px] px-4.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl uppercase transition-all shadow-md flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0"
          >
            {actioning ? <Loader size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : <Check size={12} />}
            Mark All Read
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Notifications list */}
      {loading && notifications.length === 0 ? (
        <SkeletonList />
      ) : notifications.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<Bell size={24} />}
          title="No Notifications"
          description="You are all caught up! There are no system alerts, checklist reminders, or overspending warnings."
          actionLabel="Refresh Notifications"
          onAction={fetchNotifications}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3.5">
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {notifications.map((notif) => (
              <motion.div 
                key={notif.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                className={`border p-4.5 rounded-2xl flex items-start gap-4 transition-all ${
                  notif.is_read 
                    ? 'bg-paper-50/50 dark:bg-paper-900/10 border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-800 text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400' 
                    : 'shadow-sm text-paper-800 dark:text-paper-300 font-medium'
                } ${getNotificationColorClass(notif.type)}`}
              >
                {/* Category indicator icon */}
                <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700/60 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  {getNotificationIcon(notif.type)}
                </div>

                {/* Message text content */}
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase text-[9px] tracking-wide text-paper-400 block">
                      {notif.type}
                    </span>
                    
                    {/* Unread circle badge */}
                    {!notif.is_read && (
                      <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 mt-1 animate-pulse" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  
                  <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed">{notif.message}</p>
                  
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-paper-400 pt-1 font-semibold">
                    <Clock size={10} />
                    <span>{new Date(notif.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                    <span>{new Date(notif.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Action buttons */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 self-center">
                  {!notif.is_read && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleMarkRead(notif.id)}
                      className="p-1.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-700/60 hover:bg-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-paper-700 rounded-lg text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 transition-colors"
                      title="Mark Read"
                    >
                      <Check size={13} />
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleDelete(notif.id)}
                    className="p-1.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/20 hover:bg-rose-100 rounded-lg text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 transition-colors"
                    title="Delete Alert"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={13} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );
};

    e.preventDefault();

    clearError();

    if (!name || !email || !password || !confirmPassword) {
      setLocalError('Please fill in all fields.');
      return;

      setLocalError('Passwords do not match.');
      return;

    if (password.length < 6) {
      setLocalError('Password must be at least 6 characters long.');
      return;

import { usePageTitle } from '../hooks/usePageTitle';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import api from '../services/api';
import { TripFlowGuide } from '../components/TripFlowGuide';
import {
  Search,
  Wallet,
  Calendar,
  Compass,
  Loader,
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight,
  Star,
  Sliders,
  MapPin,
  Map
} from 'lucide-react';
import { LocationPickerModal } from '../components/LocationPickerModal';


interface DestinationResult {
  destination: {
    id: number;
    name: string;
    state: string;
    description: string;
    rating: number;
    category: string;
    best_season: string;
    attractions: string[];
    avg_travel_cost: number;
    avg_hotel_cost: number;
    avg_food_cost: number;
    avg_activity_cost: number;
  };
  estimated_cost: number;
  budget_fit: number;
  rating: number;
  value_score: number;
}

export const ReverseSearch: React.FC = () => {
  usePageTitle('Reverse Search | BudgetBound');
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [startingCity, setStartingCity] = useState('Bangalore');
  const [budget, setBudget] = useState<number>(25000);
  const [days, setDays] = useState<number>(5);
  const [travelType, setTravelType] = useState('Nature');
  const [travelersCount, setTravelersCount] = useState<number>(1);
  const [comfortScore, setComfortScore] = useState<number>(50);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [results, setResults] = useState<DestinationResult[]>([]);
  const [hasSearched, setHasSearched] = useState(false);
  const [isMapModalOpen, setIsMapModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const travelTypes = [
    'Nature', 'Adventure', 'Family', 'Religious',
    'Beach', 'City Exploration', 'Romantic', 'Solo'
  ];

  const handleSearch = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setResults([]);
    setHasSearched(false);

    if (!startingCity.trim()) {
      setError('Please enter a starting city.');
      return;
    }
    if (budget <= 0) {
      setError('Please enter a valid budget.');
      return;
    }
    if (days < 1 || days > 14) {
      setError('Duration must be between 1 and 14 days.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await api.get('/api/trips/reverse/search', {
        params: {
          budget,
          days,
          travel_type: travelType,
          travelers_count: travelersCount,
          starting_city: startingCity,
          comfort_score: comfortScore
        }
      });
      setResults(response.data);
      setHasSearched(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError('Failed to fetch reverse search results.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePlanTrip = (destName: string) => {
    sessionStorage.setItem('prefilled_planner', JSON.stringify({
      startingCity,
      budget,
      days,
      travelType,
      travelersCount,
      comfortScore,
      destName
    }));
    navigate('/planner');
  };

  const getValueScoreColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 80) return 'text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/20';
    if (score >= 50) return 'text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/20';
    return 'text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400 bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500/20';
  };

  return (

      </div>

        eyebrow="Best for users who are still deciding where to go"

        ctaLabel="Find matching destinations"
        steps={[
          { title: 'Set your limits', description: 'Tell the app your budget, starting city, days, and comfort level.' },

        ]}

                  title="Pick on map"
                >
                  <Map size={18} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>

                  placeholder="25000"

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { usePageTitle } from '../hooks/usePageTitle';
import api from '../services/api';
import { 
  Search, 
  ArrowUpDown, 
  Briefcase, 
  Calendar, 
  Wallet, 
  TrendingUp, 
  TrendingDown, 
  Download, 
  Trash2, 
  Copy, 
  Edit3, 
  Eye, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Loader, 
  X,
  Compass,
  ArrowRight,
  Share2,
  CloudSun,
  Receipt
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ShareModal } from '../components/ShareModal';
import { EmptyState, SkeletonCard } from '../components/FeedbackStates';

interface Destination {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  state: string;
  category: string;
  weather_intelligence?: {
    current_season: string;
    season_rating: string;
  };
}

interface Trip {
  id: number;
  budget: number;
  days: number;
  travelers_count: number;
  travel_type: string;
  comfort_score: number;
  total_estimated_cost: number;
  status: string;
  start_date?: string;
  created_at: string;
  destination: Destination;
  actual_spending?: number;
  savings?: number;
  is_public?: boolean;
  share_token?: string | null;
}

export const SavedTrips: React.FC = () => {
  usePageTitle('My Trips | BudgetBound');
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [trips, setTrips] = useState<Trip[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [downloadingTripId, setDownloadingTripId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Search & Filters state
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState('newest');

  // Edit Modal state
  const [editingTrip, setEditingTrip] = useState<Trip | null>(null);
  const [editBudget, setEditBudget] = useState(20000);
  const [editDays, setEditDays] = useState(4);
  const [editStartDate, setEditStartDate] = useState('');
  const [editStatus, setEditStatus] = useState('Planned');
  const [editTravelers, setEditTravelers] = useState(1);
  const [editType, setEditType] = useState('Nature');
  const [editComfort, setEditComfort] = useState(50);
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [activeShareTrip, setActiveShareTrip] = useState<Trip | null>(null);

  const fetchTrips = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await api.get('/api/trips/');
      setTrips(response.data);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError('Failed to fetch your saved trip logs.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTrips();
  }, []);

  const handleDelete = async (tripId: number) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Are you sure you want to permanently delete this travel plan? All logged expenses and itinerary logs will be deleted.')) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.delete(`/api/trips/${tripId}`);
      setTrips(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== tripId));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to delete trip.');
    }
  };

  const handleDuplicate = async (tripId: number) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      await api.post(`/api/trips/${tripId}/duplicate`);
      alert('Trip duplicated successfully!');
      await fetchTrips();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to duplicate trip.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadPDF = async (tripId: number, destName: string) => {
  const handleDownloadPDF = async (tripId: number, destName: string) => {
    setDownloadingTripId(tripId);
    try {
      const response = await api.get(`/api/trips/${tripId}/pdf`, {
        responseType: 'arraybuffer',
        headers: {
          'Accept': 'application/pdf'
        }
      });
      
      console.log('PDF response received:', response.status, response.data.byteLength);
      
      const blob = new Blob([response.data], { type: 'application/pdf' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.setAttribute('download', `budgetbound_${destName.replace(/\s+/g, '_').toLowerCase()}.pdf`);
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      console.log('PDF download completed');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to download PDF:', {
        message: err.message,
        status: err.response?.status,
        statusText: err.response?.statusText,
        data: err.response?.data
      });
      alert('Failed to download PDF. Check browser console for details.');
    } finally {
      setDownloadingTripId(null);
    }
  };
  };

  const openEditModal = (trip: Trip) => {
    setEditingTrip(trip);
    setEditBudget(trip.budget);
    setEditDays(trip.days);
    setEditStartDate(trip.start_date || '');
    setEditStatus(trip.status);
    setEditTravelers(trip.travelers_count);
    setEditType(trip.travel_type);
    setEditComfort(trip.comfort_score);
  };

  const handleSaveEdit = async () => {
    if (!editingTrip) return;
    try {
      setUpdating(true);
      const response = await api.put(`/api/trips/${editingTrip.id}`, {
        budget: editBudget,
        days: editDays,
        start_date: editStartDate || null,
        status: editStatus,
        travelers_count: editTravelers,
        travel_type: editType,
        comfort_score: editComfort
      });
      
      // Update local state list
      setTrips(prev => prev.map(t => t.id === editingTrip.id ? response.data : t));
      setEditingTrip(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to update trip.');
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  };

  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'Draft':
        return 'bg-paper-100 text-paper-700 dark:bg-paper-900/50 dark:text-paper-400 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-800';
      case 'Planned':
        return 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/20 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900/30';
      case 'In Progress':
        return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/20 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-100 dark:border-amber-900/30';
      case 'Completed':
        return 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-900/30';
      case 'Cancelled':
        return 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/20 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-100 dark:border-rose-900/30';
      default:
        return 'bg-paper-100 text-paper-700';
    }
  };

  // Filter & Sort computation
  const filteredTrips = trips.filter(trip => {
    const search = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    return (
      trip.destination.name.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
      trip.destination.state.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
      trip.travel_type.toLowerCase().includes(search)
    );
  });

  const sortedTrips = [...filteredTrips].sort((a, b) => {
    switch (sortBy) {
      case 'newest':
        return new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime();
      case 'oldest':
        return new Date(a.created_at).getTime() - new Date(b.created_at).getTime();
      case 'highest_budget':
        return b.budget - a.budget;
      case 'lowest_budget':
        return a.budget - b.budget;
      case 'dest_name':
        return a.destination.name.localeCompare(b.destination.name);
      default:
        return 0;
    }
  });

  if (loading && trips.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto p-6 md:p-10 animate-pulse">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-2 w-1/3">
            <div className="h-4 bg-paper-200 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-md w-1/2" />
            <div className="h-6 bg-paper-200 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-md w-3/4" />
          </div>
          <div className="h-10 bg-paper-200 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-md w-1/4" />
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <SkeletonCard />
          <SkeletonCard />
          <SkeletonCard />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <motion.div 
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
      className="space-y-8 relative"
    >
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-marigold-600 dark:text-marigold-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Travel History</span>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white mt-1">My Saved Trips</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400">
            View, duplicate, edit, or track expenses for all your finalized travel plans.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link 
          to="/planner"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-marigold-600 hover:bg-marigold-500 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm transition-all shadow-md shadow-marigold-600/15"
        >
          Plan New Destination
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Search & Sort Panel */}
      <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 justify-between items-center">
        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative w-full sm:max-w-xs">
          <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center text-paper-400 pointer-events-none">
            <Search size={16} />
          </span>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search by destination..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl text-xs bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-marigold-500 dark:focus:border-marigold-500 dark:text-white transition-all"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Sort dropdown */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 self-end sm:self-center">
          <ArrowUpDown size={14} className="text-paper-400" />
          <select
            value={sortBy}
            onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl text-xs px-3 py-2 text-paper-600 dark:text-paper-300 font-bold focus:outline-none transition-all"
          >
            <option value="newest">Sort: Newest</option>
            <option value="oldest">Sort: Oldest</option>
            <option value="highest_budget">Sort: Highest Budget</option>
            <option value="lowest_budget">Sort: Lowest Budget</option>
            <option value="dest_name">Sort: Destination Name</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Trips Grid list */}
      {sortedTrips.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<Compass size={24} />}
          title="No Saved Trips Found"
          description="Create or generate budget-allocated schedules to populate this log ledger list. You can start planning or discovery from the Planner."
          actionLabel="Plan a Trip Now"
          onAction={() => navigate('/planner')}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {sortedTrips.map((trip) => {
            const actualSpent = trip.actual_spending || 0.0;
            const savings = trip.savings || 0.0;
            
            return (
              <div 
                key={trip.id} 
                className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                {/* Image / Destination details */}
                <div className="p-5 border-b border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700 flex justify-between items-start">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">{trip.destination.state}</span>
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white mt-0.5">{trip.destination.name}</h3>
                    <div className="flex gap-2 items-center mt-1">
                      <span className="text-[10px] bg-paper-100 dark:bg-paper-900 text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-semibold uppercase">
                        {trip.travel_type}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide">
                        {trip.days} Days / {trip.travelers_count} Travelers
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${getStatusBadgeClass(trip.status)}`}>
                    {trip.status}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Travel Date */}
                <div className="px-5 py-3.5 bg-paper-50/50 dark:bg-paper-900/10 border-b border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700/60 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400">
                  <Calendar size={14} className="text-marigold-500 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="font-medium">
                    {trip.start_date ? `Starts: ${trip.start_date}` : 'Planned dates not set'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Weather Quick Badge */}
                {trip.destination.weather_intelligence && (
                  <div className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-paper-50/20 dark:bg-paper-900/5 border-b border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                    <span className="text-paper-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                      <CloudSun size={13} className="text-marigold-500" />
                      Season: {trip.destination.weather_intelligence.current_season}
                    </span>
                    <span className={`font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] border ${
                      trip.destination.weather_intelligence.season_rating === 'Excellent' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-200' :
                      trip.destination.weather_intelligence.season_rating === 'Good' ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-400 border-blue-200' :
                      trip.destination.weather_intelligence.season_rating === 'Fair' ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-200' :
                      'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-200'
                    }`}>
                      {trip.destination.weather_intelligence.season_rating}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Costs Summary Grid */}
                <div className="p-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs border-b border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700/60 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800">
                  <div className="space-y-0.5">
                    <span className="text-paper-400 block font-semibold">Total Target Budget</span>
                    <span className="font-extrabold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{trip.budget.toLocaleString()}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-0.5">
                    <span className="text-paper-400 block font-semibold">Estimated Cost</span>
                    <span className="font-extrabold text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-300">â‚¹{trip.total_estimated_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-0.5">
                    <span className="text-paper-400 block font-semibold">Actual Spending</span>
                    <span className="font-extrabold text-rose-500">â‚¹{actualSpent.toLocaleString()}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-0.5">
                    <span className="text-paper-400 block font-semibold">Trip Savings</span>
                    <span className="font-extrabold text-emerald-500">â‚¹{savings.toLocaleString()}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Interactive Actions Footer */}
                <div className="p-3 bg-paper-50/50 dark:bg-paper-900/15 flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => navigate(`/planner?tripId=${trip.id}`)}
                      className="p-2 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-xl hover:bg-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-paper-600 text-paper-700 dark:text-white transition-all shadow-sm border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700"
                      title="View Planner Details"
                    >
                      <Eye size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => navigate(`/expenses/${trip.id}`)}
                      className="p-2 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-xl hover:bg-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-paper-600 text-paper-700 dark:text-white transition-all shadow-sm border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700"
                      title="Manage Expenses"
                    >
                      <Receipt size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => openEditModal(trip)}
                      className="p-2 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-xl hover:bg-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-paper-600 text-paper-700 dark:text-white transition-all shadow-sm border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700"
                      title="Edit Basic Metadata"
                    >
                      <Edit3 size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleDuplicate(trip.id)}
                      className="p-2 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-xl hover:bg-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-paper-600 text-paper-700 dark:text-white transition-all shadow-sm border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700"
                      title="Duplicate Trip"
                    >
                      <Copy size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setActiveShareTrip(trip)}
                      className="p-2 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-xl hover:bg-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-paper-600 text-paper-700 dark:text-white transition-all shadow-sm border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700"
                      title="Share Trip Plan"
                    >
                      <Share2 size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleDownloadPDF(trip.id, trip.destination.name)}
                      disabled={downloadingTripId === trip.id}
                      className="p-2 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-700 rounded-xl hover:bg-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-paper-600 text-paper-700 dark:text-white transition-all shadow-sm border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                      title="Download PDF"
                    >
                      {downloadingTripId === trip.id ? <Loader size={13} className="animate-spin" /> : <Download size={13} />}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleDelete(trip.id)}
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/20 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/30 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 transition-all border border-rose-100/50 dark:border-rose-900/10"
                    title="Delete Plan"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={13} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Edit Trip Modal Popup */}
      {editingTrip && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-paper-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-6 z-50 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md p-6 shadow-2xl relative">
            <button 
              onClick={() => setEditingTrip(null)}
              className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-paper-400 hover:text-paper-600 dark:hover:text-white focus:outline-none"
            >
              <X size={18} />
            </button>

            <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-paper-900 dark:text-white mb-4">
              Edit Trip: {editingTrip.destination.name}
            </h3>

            <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-paper-500 font-bold mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wide">Target Budget (INR)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={editBudget}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditBudget(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl p-2.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-paper-500 font-bold mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wide">Duration (Days)</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={editDays}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditDays(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl p-2.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-paper-500 font-bold mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wide">Travelers</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    max="20"
                    value={editTravelers}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditTravelers(parseInt(e.target.value) || 1)}
                    className="w-full border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl p-2.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-paper-500 font-bold mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wide">Travel Date</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={editStartDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditStartDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl p-2.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-paper-500 font-bold mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wide">Trip Lifecycle</label>
                  <select
                    value={editStatus}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditStatus(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl p-2.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none font-bold"
                  >
                    {["Draft", "Planned", "In Progress", "Completed", "Cancelled"].map((st) => (
                      <option key={st} value={st}>{st}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-paper-500 font-bold mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wide">Travel Style</label>
                  <select
                    value={editType}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditType(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl p-2.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none font-bold"
                  >
                    {['Nature', 'Adventure', 'Family', 'Religious', 'Beach', 'City Exploration', 'Romantic', 'Solo'].map((st) => (
                      <option key={st} value={st}>{st}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-paper-500 font-bold mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wide">Comfort Score (0-100)</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    max="100"
                    value={editComfort}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditComfort(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl p-2.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingTrip(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs text-paper-500 hover:text-paper-800 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSaveEdit}
                disabled={updating}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-marigold-600 hover:bg-marigold-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs transition-colors"
              >
                {updating ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeShareTrip && (
        <ShareModal
          tripId={activeShareTrip.id}
          isPublic={activeShareTrip.is_public || false}
          shareToken={activeShareTrip.share_token || null}
          onClose={() => setActiveShareTrip(null)}
          onUpdate={(updatedTrip) => {
            setTrips(prev => prev.map(t => t.id === activeShareTrip.id ? {
              ...t,
              is_public: updatedTrip.is_public,
              share_token: updatedTrip.share_token
            } : t));
            setActiveShareTrip(null);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { usePageTitle } from '../hooks/usePageTitle';
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import api from '../services/api';
import { TimelineItinerary } from '../components/TimelineItinerary';
import { TripChecklist } from '../components/TripChecklist';
import { 
  Calendar, 
  MapPin, 
  Wallet, 
  Compass, 
  Loader, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Leaf, 
  CloudSun,
  Building,
  Plane,
  Train,
  Utensils,
  Camera,
  Percent,
  LifeBuoy
} from 'lucide-react';

interface Destination {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  state: string;
  category: string;
  description: string;
  best_season: string;
  weather_intelligence?: {
    current_season: string;
    best_season: string;
    season_rating: string;
    crowd_level: string;
    temperature_range: string;
    rain_probability: string;
    recommendation: string;
  };
}

interface BudgetAllocation {
  transport_cost: number;
  hotel_cost: number;
  food_cost: number;
  activities_cost: number;
  local_transport_cost: number;
  taxes_fees_cost: number;
  emergency_reserve: number;
}

interface CarbonFootprint {
  transport_mode: string;
  co2_emissions: number;
  carbon_rating: string;
  eco_score: number;
  alternative_savings: number;
}

interface Trip {
  id: number;
  budget: number;
  days: number;
  travelers_count: number;
  travel_type: string;
  comfort_score: number;
  total_estimated_cost: number;
  hotel_tier: string;
  transport_mode: string;
  status: string;
  start_date?: string;
  destination: Destination;
  itineraries: any[];
  budget_allocation?: BudgetAllocation;
  carbon_footprint?: CarbonFootprint;
  packing_items: any[];
}

export const SharedTripView: React.FC = () => {
  usePageTitle('Shared Trip | BudgetBound');
  const { shareToken } = useParams<{ shareToken: string }>();
  const [trip, setTrip] = useState<Trip | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedDays, setExpandedDays] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchSharedTrip = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const response = await api.get(`/api/trips/share/${shareToken}`);
        setTrip(response.data);
        
        // Expand all days by default for public viewing
        const allExpanded: Record<number, boolean> = {};
        response.data.itineraries.forEach((it: any) => {
          allExpanded[it.day_number] = true;
        });
        setExpandedDays(allExpanded);
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error(err);
        setError(err.response?.data?.detail || 'This travel plan is set to private or does not exist.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    if (shareToken) {
      fetchSharedTrip();
    }
  }, [shareToken]);

  const toggleDay = (dayNumber: number) => {
    setExpandedDays(prev => ({ ...prev, [dayNumber]: !prev[dayNumber] }));
  };

  const getCategoryGradient = (category: string) => {
    const cat = category.toLowerCase();
    if (cat.includes('beach')) {
      return 'from-amber-400 via-orange-500 to-blue-600';
    }
    if (cat.includes('nature') || cat.includes('hills')) {
      return 'from-emerald-400 via-teal-500 to-petrol-700';
    }
    if (cat.includes('religious') || cat.includes('temple')) {
      return 'from-orange-400 via-red-500 to-amber-600';
    }
    return 'from-marigold-500 via-berry-600 to-petrol-700';
  };

  const getWeatherRatingBadgeClass = (rating: string) => {
    switch (rating) {
      case 'Excellent':
        return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/30';
      case 'Good':
        return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/30';
      case 'Fair':
        return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/30';
      case 'Avoid':
        return 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/30';
      default:
        return 'bg-paper-100 text-paper-700';
    }
  };

  const getCarbonBadgeClass = (rating: string) => {
    if (rating === 'Eco Friendly') {
      return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-300';
    }
    if (rating === 'Moderate') {
      return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-300';
    }
    return 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-300';
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-paper-500 gap-4">
        <Loader className="h-10 w-10 text-marigold-500 animate-spin" />
        <span className="text-sm font-semibold">Retrieving shared travel plan...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !trip) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center">
        <div className="max-w-md bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 p-8 rounded-3xl border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 shadow-xl space-y-4">
          <AlertCircle className="h-14 w-14 text-rose-500 mx-auto" />
          <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">Plan Access Denied</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 leading-relaxed">
            {error || 'This itinerary is currently private. Please ask the owner to enable public sharing.'}
          </p>
          <div className="pt-2">
            <Link 
              to="/dashboard" 
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-marigold-600 hover:bg-marigold-500 text-white font-bold px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all shadow-md"
            >
              Back to Dashboard
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { destination } = trip;
  const weather = destination.weather_intelligence;
  const carbon = trip.carbon_footprint;
  const alloc = trip.budget_allocation;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 text-paper-900 dark:text-paper-100 flex flex-col items-center pb-12">
      
      {/* Category Gradient Header Banner */}
      <div className={`w-full h-64 bg-gradient-to-r ${getCategoryGradient(destination.category)} relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-end p-8 text-white shadow`}>
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-80 h-80 bg-paper-50/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="max-w-5xl w-full mx-auto space-y-2 relative z-10">
          <div className="flex gap-2 items-center">
            <span className="text-[10px] bg-paper-50/20 backdrop-blur-md px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">
              {destination.category}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] bg-marigold-600/60 backdrop-blur-md px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">
              Public Shared Plan
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-paper-200 block">{destination.state}</span>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight drop-shadow-md">{destination.name}</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-paper-100/90 max-w-xl font-medium leading-relaxed drop-shadow-sm">
            {destination.description}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Core Container */}
      <div className="max-w-5xl w-full px-6 md:px-8 mt-8 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8">
        
        {/* Left column: Itinerary */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-6">
          
          <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-4.5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm">
            <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
              <Compass className="text-marigold-500" size={18} />
              Travel Schedule Itinerary
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-paper-400 mt-0.5">Explore the daily chronological travel agenda details</p>
          </div>

          <TimelineItinerary
            itineraries={trip.itineraries}
            expandedDays={expandedDays}
            toggleDay={toggleDay}
            className="w-full animate-fade-in"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Right column: Widgets (Cost, Weather, Packing, Carbon) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          
          {/* Metadata Card */}
          <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-center">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase block">Budget</span>
              <span className="font-extrabold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{trip.budget.toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1 border-x border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase block">Days</span>
              <span className="font-extrabold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">{trip.days} Days</span>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-paper-400 font-bold uppercase block">Travelers</span>
              <span className="font-extrabold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">{trip.travelers_count} People</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Weather Intelligence Widget */}
          {weather && (
            <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CloudSun size={16} className="text-marigold-500" />
                  Weather & Season Intelligence
                </h3>
                <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${getWeatherRatingBadgeClass(weather.season_rating)}`}>
                  {weather.season_rating}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900/40 p-3 rounded-xl border border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-800">
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <span className="text-paper-400 font-semibold block">Current Season</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">{weather.current_season}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <span className="text-paper-400 font-semibold block">Temp Range</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">{weather.temperature_range}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <span className="text-paper-400 font-semibold block">Crowd Level</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">{weather.crowd_level}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <span className="text-paper-400 font-semibold block">Rain Probability</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">{weather.rain_probability}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <p className="text-xs text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 leading-relaxed italic border-l-2 border-marigold-400 pl-3">
                {weather.recommendation}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Carbon Footprint Widget */}
          {carbon && (
            <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Leaf size={16} className="text-emerald-500" />
                  Carbon Footprint Impact
                </h3>
                <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${getCarbonBadgeClass(carbon.carbon_rating)}`}>
                  {carbon.carbon_rating}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-900 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-800 rounded-xl">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  {carbon.transport_mode === 'Flight' ? <Plane size={16} className="text-rose-500" /> : <Train size={16} className="text-emerald-500" />}
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-paper-300">
                    COâ‚‚ Impact ({carbon.transport_mode})
                  </span>
                </div>
                <span className="text-sm font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white">
                  {carbon.co2_emissions} kg
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="text-[11px] text-paper-500 dark:text-paper-400 leading-normal flex items-start gap-2 bg-emerald-50/20 dark:bg-emerald-950/10 border border-emerald-100/40 p-3 rounded-xl">
                <Leaf size={14} className="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" fill="currentColor" />
                <span>
                  {carbon.transport_mode === 'Flight' 
                    ? `Choosing train instead of flight for this segment reduces emissions by ${carbon.alternative_savings} kg.`
                    : `Eco-friendly choice! Traveling by train instead of flight saved an estimated ${carbon.alternative_savings} kg of COâ‚‚.`
                  }
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Budget Breakdown Summary */}
          {alloc && (
            <div className="bg-paper-50 dark:bg-paper-800 border border-paper-200 dark:border-paper-700 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm space-y-4">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-paper-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                <Wallet size={16} className="text-marigold-500" />
                Allocated Budget Breakdown
              </h3>

              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 text-xs text-paper-700 dark:text-paper-400">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Plane size={14} /> Transportation</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{alloc.transport_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Building size={14} /> Accommodations</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{alloc.hotel_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Utensils size={14} /> Food & Dining</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{alloc.food_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Camera size={14} /> Sightseeing / Sights</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{alloc.activities_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Percent size={14} /> Taxes & Booking Fees</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">â‚¹{alloc.taxes_fees_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between border-t border-paper-100 dark:border-paper-700 pt-2 font-bold text-paper-800 dark:text-white">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><LifeBuoy size={14} /> Total Estimated Cost</span>
                  <span>â‚¹{trip.total_estimated_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Checklist Widget */}
          <TripChecklist
            tripId={trip.id}
            readOnly={true}
            initialItems={trip.packing_items}
          />

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
};

FILE: frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx
